75.s:
īśvara uvāca
arghapātrakaro yāyādagnyāgāraṃ susaṃvṛtaḥ /
yāgopakaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ divyadṛṣṭyā ca kalpayet(1) //
75.d:
ईश्वर उवाच
अर्घपात्रकरो यायादग्न्यागारं सुसंवृतः /
यागोपकरणं सर्वं दिव्यदृष्ट्या च कल्पयेत्(1) //
75.m: The Lord said: / Holding the arghya vessel in hand, well covered, one should go to the fire hall; / and one should inspect all the sacrificial implements with a divine gaze.

75.s:
udaṅmukhaḥ kuṇḍamīkṣet praokṣaṇaṃ tāḍanaṃkuśaiḥ /
vidadhyādastramantreṇa varmaṇābhyukṣaṇaṃ mataṃ //
75.d:
उदङ्मुखः कुण्डमीक्षेत् प्रओक्षणं ताडनंकुशैः /
विदध्यादस्त्रमन्त्रेण वर्मणाभ्युक्षणं मतं //
75.m: Facing north, he should view the fire-pit. Sprinkling (prokṣaṇa) and striking with kuśa grass / should be performed with the weapon mantra; moistening (abhyukṣaṇa) is prescribed with the armor mantra.

75.s:
khaḍgena khātamuddhāraṃ pūraṇaṃ samatāmapi /
kurvīta varmaṇā sekaṃ kuṭṭanantu śarātmanā(2) //
75.d:
खड्गेन खातमुद्धारं पूरणं समतामपि /
कुर्वीत वर्मणा सेकं कुट्टनन्तु शरात्मना(2) //
75.m: Excavation, removal, filling, and leveling [of the earth] should be done with the sword [mantra]; / watering should be done with the armor [mantra], and pounding with the arrow mantra.

75.s:
sammārjanaṃ samālepaṃ kalārūpaprakalpanaṃ /
trisūtrīparidhānaṃ ca varmaṇābhyarcanaṃ sadā //
75.d:
सम्मार्जनं समालेपं कलारूपप्रकल्पनं /
त्रिसूत्रीपरिधानं च वर्मणाभ्यर्चनं सदा //
75.m: Sweeping, smearing, conceiving the forms of the kalās, / encircling with three cords, and perpetual worship should be done with the armor mantra.

75.s:
rekhātrayamudak kuryādekāṃ pūrvānanāmadhaḥ /
kuśena ca śivāstreṇa yadvā tāsāṃ viparyayaḥ //
75.d:
रेखात्रयमुदक् कुर्यादेकां पूर्वाननामधः /
कुशेन च शिवास्त्रेण यद्वा तासां विपर्ययः //
75.m: One should draw three lines toward the north and one below facing east, / using a blade of kuśa grass and the Śiva-weapon mantra; or their reverse order [may be used].

75.s:
vajrīkaraṇamantreṇa hṛdā darbhaiś catuṣpathaṃ /
akṣapātrantatanutreṇa vinyasedviṣṭaraṃ hṛdā //
75.d:
वज्रीकरणमन्त्रेण हृदा दर्भैश् चतुष्पथं /
अक्षपात्रन्ततनुत्रेण विन्यसेद्विष्टरं हृदा //
75.m: With the adamantine-making (vajrīkaraṇa) mantra, the heart mantra, and darbha grass, [one constructs] the crossroad. / One should deposit the rosary vessel with the armor mantra and the seat with the heart mantra.

75.s:
hṛdā vāgīśvarīṃ tatra īśāmāvāhya pūjayet /
vahniṃ sadāśrayānītaṃ śuddhapātroparisthitaṃ //
75.d:
हृदा वागीश्वरीं तत्र ईशामावाह्य पूजयेत् /
वह्निं सदाश्रयानीतं शुद्धपात्रोपरिस्थितं //
75.m: Invoking Vāgīśvarī and the Lord there with the heart mantra, one should worship them. / The fire brought from a good source, placed upon a clean vessel,

75.s:
kravyādāṃśaṃ parityajya vīkṣaṇādiviśodhitaṃ /
audaryaṃ caindavaṃ bhautaṃ ekīkṛtyānalatrayaṃ //
75.d:
क्रव्यादांशं परित्यज्य वीक्षणादिविशोधितं /
औदर्यं चैन्दवं भौतं एकीकृत्यानलत्रयं //
75.m: freed from the portion of the corpse-eating [fire], purified through viewing and other rites, / and uniting the three fires—the stomach fire, lunar fire, and elemental fire—

75.s:
oṃ hūṃ vahnicaitanyāya vahnivījena vinyaset /
saṃhitāmantritaṃ vahniṃ dhenumudrāmṛtīkṛtaṃ //
75.d:
ओं हूं वह्निचैतन्याय वह्निवीजेन विन्यसेत् /
संहितामन्त्रितं वह्निं धेनुमुद्रामृतीकृतं //
75.m: one should deposit it with the fire seed: "oṃ hūṃ to the consciousness of fire." / The fire consecrated with the saṃhitā mantras, made immortal with the dhenumudrā,

75.s:
rakṣitaṃ hetimantreṇa kavacenāvaguṇṭhitaṃ /
pūjitantriḥ paribhrāmya kuṇḍasyordhvaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ //
:n
1 divyadṛṣṭyā vilpkayediti gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
2 śarāṇuneti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 220
75.d:
रक्षितं हेतिमन्त्रेण कवचेनावगुण्ठितं /
पूजितन्त्रिः परिभ्राम्य कुण्डस्योर्ध्वं प्रदक्षिणं //
:न्
1 दिव्यदृष्ट्या विल्प्कयेदिति घ, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
2 शराणुनेति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 220
75.m:
protected with the weapon mantra, veiled with the armor mantra, / and worshiped, should be circled clockwise three times above the fire-pit.
[Gap in text]
1. 'divyadṛṣṭyā vilokayed' is the reading of the two manuscripts marked gha and ṅa.
2. 'śarāṇunā' is the reading of the manuscript marked ṅa.
[Page 220]

75.s:
śivavījamiti dhyātvā vāgīśāgarbhagocare /
vāgīśvareṇa devena kṣipyamānaṃ vibhāvayet //
75.d:
शिववीजमिति ध्यात्वा वागीशागर्भगोचरे /
वागीश्वरेण देवेन क्षिप्यमानं विभावयेत् //
75.m: Meditating upon it as the seed of Śiva, one should visualize it / being cast into the womb of Vāgīśā by the god Vāgīśvara.

75.s:
bhūmiṣṭhajānukko mantrī hṛdātmasammukhaṃ kṣipet /
tato 'ntasthitavījasya(1) nābhideśe samūhanaṃ //
75.d:
भूमिष्ठजानुक्को मन्त्री हृदात्मसम्मुखं क्षिपेत् /
ततो ऽन्तस्थितवीजस्य(1) नाभिदेशे समूहनं //
75.m: With knees on the ground, the practitioner should cast [it] toward himself with the heart mantra. / Then [follows] the gathering together of the seed residing within, at the region of the navel,

75.s:
sambhṛtiṃ paridhānasya śaucamācamanaṃ hṛdā /
garbhāgneḥ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā tadrakṣārthaṃ śarāṇunā(2) //
75.d:
सम्भृतिं परिधानस्य शौचमाचमनं हृदा /
गर्भाग्नेः पूजनं कृत्वा तद्रक्षार्थं शराणुना(2) //
75.m: the procurement of clothing, and ritual purification and sipping of water with the heart mantra. / Having performed the worship of the fire in the womb, for its protection, with the arrow-mantra,

75.s:
badhnīyādgarbhajaṃ devyāḥ kakaṅkaṇaṃ pāṇipallave /
garbhādhānāya sampūjya sadyojātena pāvakaṃ //
75.d:
बध्नीयाद्गर्भजं देव्याः ककङ्कणं पाणिपल्लवे /
गर्भाधानाय सम्पूज्य सद्योजातेन पावकं //
75.m: one should tie the bracelet belonging to the womb on the goddess's lotus hand. / Having worshipped the fire for the impregnation rite with [the mantra of] Sadyojāta,

75.s:
tato hṛdayamantreṇa juhuyādāhutitrayaṃ /
puṃsavanāya vāmena tṛtīye yāsi pūjayet //
75.d:
ततो हृदयमन्त्रेण जुहुयादाहुतित्रयं /
पुंसवनाय वामेन तृतीये यासि पूजयेत् //
75.m: one should then offer three oblations with the heart mantra. / For the rite to produce a male child, one should worship [the fire] with Vāmadeva in the third month,

75.s:
āhutitritayaṃ dadyācchirasāmbukaṇānvitaṃ /
sīmantonnayanaṃ ṣaṣṭhe māsi sampūjya rūpiṇā //
75.d:
आहुतित्रितयं दद्याच्छिरसाम्बुकणान्वितं /
सीमन्तोन्नयनं षष्ठे मासि सम्पूज्य रूपिणा //
75.m: and offer three oblations with the head mantra, accompanied by drops of water. / Having worshipped [the fire] with the form-mantra in the sixth month for the rite of parting the hair,

75.s:
juhuyādāhutīstisraḥ śikhayā śikhayaiva tu /
vaktrāṅgakalpanāṃ kuryādvaktrodghāṭananiṣkṛtī //
75.d:
जुहुयादाहुतीस्तिस्रः शिखया शिखयैव तु /
वक्त्राङ्गकल्पनां कुर्याद्वक्त्रोद्घाटननिष्कृती //
75.m: one should offer three oblations with the tuft-mantra, indeed with the tuft-mantra alone. / One should perform the fashioning of the faces and limbs, and the expiation for the opening of the mouths.

75.s:
jātakarmanṛkarmabhyāṃ daśame māsi pūrvavat /
vahniṃ sandhukṣya darbhādyaiḥ(3) snānaṃ garbhamalāpahaṃ //
75.d:
जातकर्मनृकर्मभ्यां दशमे मासि पूर्ववत् /
वह्निं सन्धुक्ष्य दर्भाद्यैः(3) स्नानं गर्भमलापहं //
75.m: In the tenth month, with the rites of birth and rites for man, as before, / having rekindled the fire with darbha-grass and the like, [he provides] a bath removing the impurities of the womb.

75.s:
suvarṇabandhanaṃ devyā kṛtaṃ dhyātvā hṛdārcayet /
sadyaḥsūtakanāśāya prokṣayedastravāriṇā //
75.d:
सुवर्णबन्धनं देव्या कृतं ध्यात्वा हृदार्चयेत् /
सद्यःसूतकनाशाय प्रोक्षयेदस्त्रवारिणा //
75.m: Having visualized the tying of gold performed by the goddess, one should worship with the heart mantra. / For the destruction of the immediate impurity of childbirth, one should sprinkle it with water sanctified by the weapon mantra.

75.s:
kumbhantu(4) vahirastreṇa tāḍayedvarmaṇokṣayet /
astreṇottarapūrvāgrānmekhalāsu vahiḥ kuśān //
:n
1 tatontasthitadevasya iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 śarātmanā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 gandhādyair iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 kuṇḍantu iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
:p 221
75.d:
कुम्भन्तु(4) वहिरस्त्रेण ताडयेद्वर्मणोक्षयेत् /
अस्त्रेणोत्तरपूर्वाग्रान्मेखलासु वहिः कुशान् //
:न्
1 ततोन्तस्थितदेवस्य इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 शरात्मना इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 गन्धाद्यैर् इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 कुण्डन्तु इति ख, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
:प् 221
75.m:
One should strike the pot on the outside with the weapon mantra, and sprinkle it with the armour mantra. / With the weapon mantra, [placing] kuśa grasses with their tips to the northeast outside upon the girdles,
[Gap in text]
1. 'tato 'ntasthitadevasya' is the reading of the manuscript marked kha.
2. 'śarātmanā' is the reading of the manuscript marked kha.
3. 'gandhādyair' is the reading of the manuscript marked kha.
4. 'kuṇḍantu' is the reading of the two manuscripts marked kha and ṅa.
[Page 221]

75.s:
āsthāpya(1) sthāpayetteṣu hṛdā paridhivistaraṃ /
vaktāṇāmastramantreṇa tato nālāpannuttaye //
75.d:
आस्थाप्य(1) स्थापयेत्तेषु हृदा परिधिविस्तरं /
वक्ताणामस्त्रमन्त्रेण ततो नालापन्नुत्तये //
75.m: having arranged [them], one should set upon them with the heart mantra an array of enclosing sticks. / Then, with the weapon mantra of the faces, for the removal of the umbilical cord,

75.s:
samidhiḥ pañca hotavyāḥ prānte mūle ghṛtaplutāḥ /
brahmāṇaṃ śaṅkaraṃ viṣṇumanantañca hṛdārcayet //
75.d:
समिधिः पञ्च होतव्याः प्रान्ते मूले घृतप्लुताः /
ब्रह्माणं शङ्करं विष्णुमनन्तञ्च हृदार्चयेत् //
75.m: five fire-sticks soaked in clarified butter at the tip and root are to be offered into the fire. / One should worship Brahmā, Śaṅkara, Viṣṇu, and Ananta with the heart mantra,

75.s:
dūrvākṣataiś ca paryantaṃ paridhisthānanukramāt /
indrādīśānaparyantāntānviṣṭarasthānanukramāt //
75.d:
दूर्वाक्षतैश् च पर्यन्तं परिधिस्थाननुक्रमात् /
इन्द्रादीशानपर्यन्तान्तान्विष्टरस्थाननुक्रमात् //
75.m: with dūrvā grass and unbroken grain all around, in sequence, situated on the enclosing sticks, / and those situated on seats in sequence, from Indra up to Īśāna,

75.s:
agnerabhimukhībhūtān nijadikṣu hṛdārcayet /
nivārya vighnasaṅghātaṃ vālakaṃ pālayiṣyatha //
75.d:
अग्नेरभिमुखीभूतान् निजदिक्षु हृदार्चयेत् /
निवार्य विघ्नसङ्घातं वालकं पालयिष्यथ //
75.m: facing toward the fire in their respective directions, one should worship with the heart mantra: / 'Having warded off the host of obstacles, may you protect the child!'

75.s:
śaivīmājñābhimānteṣāṃ śrāvayettadanantaraṃ /
gṛhītvā sruksruvāvūrdhvavadanādhomukhaiḥ kramāt //
75.d:
शैवीमाज्ञाभिमान्तेषां श्रावयेत्तदनन्तरं /
गृहीत्वा स्रुक्स्रुवावूर्ध्ववदनाधोमुखैः क्रमात् //
75.m: Thereupon, one should recite this Śaiva command to them. / Taking up the large and small ladles, respectively with face upwards and face downwards,

75.s:
pratāpyāgnau tridhā darbhamūlamadhyāgrakaiḥ spṛśet /
kuśaspṛṣṭapradeśe tu ātmavidyāśivātmakaṃ //
75.d:
प्रताप्याग्नौ त्रिधा दर्भमूलमध्याग्रकैः स्पृशेत् /
कुशस्पृष्टप्रदेशे तु आत्मविद्याशिवात्मकं //
75.m: and heating them in the fire three times, one should touch them with the base, middle, and tip of a darbha grass. / Then, upon the area touched by the kuśa, [one visualizes] the three principles consisting of soul, knowledge, and Śiva,

75.s:
kramāttattvatrayaṃ nyasya hāṃ hīṃ hūṃ saṃ(2) ravaiḥ kramāt /
sruvi śaktiṃ sruve śambhuṃ vinyasya hṛdayāṇunā //
75.d:
क्रमात्तत्त्वत्रयं न्यस्य हां हीं हूं सं(2) रवैः क्रमात् /
स्रुवि शक्तिं स्रुवे शम्भुं विन्यस्य हृदयाणुना //
75.m: and having deposited the three principles in order with the sounds hāṃ, hīṃ, hūṃ, and saṃ in succession, / having deposited Śakti in the small ladle and Śambhu in the large ladle with the heart mantra,

75.s:
trisūtrīveṣṭitagrīvo pūjitau kusumādibhiḥ /
kuśānāmupariṣṭāttau sthāpayitvā svadakṣiṇe //
75.d:
त्रिसूत्रीवेष्टितग्रीवो पूजितौ कुसुमादिभिः /
कुशानामुपरिष्टात्तौ स्थापयित्वा स्वदक्षिणे //
75.m: their necks wound with triple cord, worshipped with flowers and the like, / having placed them upon the kuśa grasses to one's right,

75.s:
gavyamājyaṃ samādāya vīkṣaṇādiviśodhitaṃ /
svakāṃ brahmamayīṃ mūrtiṃ sañcintyādāya tadghṛtaṃ //
75.d:
गव्यमाज्यं समादाय वीक्षणादिविशोधितं /
स्वकां ब्रह्ममयीं मूर्तिं सञ्चिन्त्यादाय तद्घृतं //
75.m: taking cow's clarified butter purified by glancing and the like, / and meditating upon one's own form as composed of Brahmā, taking that clarified butter,

75.s:
kuṇḍasyordhvaṃ hṛdāvartya bhrāmayitvāgnigocare /
punarviṣṇumayīṃ dhyātvā ghṛtamīśānagocare //
75.d:
कुण्डस्योर्ध्वं हृदावर्त्य भ्रामयित्वाग्निगोचरे /
पुनर्विष्णुमयीं ध्यात्वा घृतमीशानगोचरे //
75.m: circling it above the fire-pit with the heart mantra and rotating it in the sphere of fire, / and again meditating [upon oneself] as composed of Viṣṇu, holding the clarified butter in the sphere of Īśāna,

75.s:
dhṛtvādāya kuśāgreṇa svāhāntaṃ śirasāṇunā(2) /
:n
1 āstīryeti gha, ṅa, cihnitapustadvayapāṭhaḥ
2 hāṃ hrīṃ hraṃ samiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / hūṃ hāṃ
krūṃ samiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 śirasātmanā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 222
juhuyādviṣṇave vinduṃ rudrarūpamanantaraṃ //
75.d:
धृत्वादाय कुशाग्रेण स्वाहान्तं शिरसाणुना(2) /
:न्
1 आस्तीर्येति घ, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तद्वयपाठः
2 हां ह्रीं ह्रं समिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / हूं हां
क्रूं समिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 शिरसात्मना इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 222
जुहुयाद्विष्णवे विन्दुं रुद्ररूपमनन्तरं //
75.m:
and taking [it] with the tip of a kuśa grass, with the head mantra ending in svāhā,
[Gap in text]
1. 'āstīryeti' is the reading of the two manuscripts marked gha and ṅa.
2. 'hāṃ hrīṃ hraṃ samiti' is the reading of the manuscript marked kha; 'hūṃ hāṃ krūṃ samiti' is the reading of the manuscript marked ṅa.
3. 'śirasātmanā' is the reading of the manuscript marked kha.
[Page 222]
one should offer a drop to Viṣṇu; immediately afterwards, in the form of Rudra,

75.s:
bhāvayannijamātmānaṃ nābhau dhṛtvāplavettataḥ /
prādeśamātradarbhābhyāmaṅguṣṭānāmikāgrakaiḥ //
75.d:
भावयन्निजमात्मानं नाभौ धृत्वाप्लवेत्ततः /
प्रादेशमात्रदर्भाभ्यामङ्गुष्टानामिकाग्रकैः //
75.m: meditating upon one's own self, holding [it] at the navel, one should then sprinkle [it]. / With two darbha blades of a span's measure held by the tips of the thumb and ring finger,

75.s:
dhṛtābhyāṃ sammukhaṃ vahnerastreṇāplavamācaret /
hṛdātmasammukhaṃ tadvat kuryāt samplavanantataḥ //
75.d:
धृताभ्यां सम्मुखं वह्नेरस्त्रेणाप्लवमाचरेत् /
हृदात्मसम्मुखं तद्वत् कुर्यात् सम्प्लवनन्ततः //
75.m: facing the fire, one should perform the sprinkling with the weapon mantra. / In like manner, with the heart mantra facing oneself, one should then perform the sprinkling.

75.s:
hṛdālabdhadagdhadarbhaṃ śastrakṣepāt pavitayet /
dīptenāparadarbheṇa nivāhyānena dīpayet //
75.d:
हृदालब्धदग्धदर्भं शस्त्रक्षेपात् पवितयेत् /
दीप्तेनापरदर्भेण निवाह्यानेन दीपयेत् //
75.m: One should purify the darbha touched by the heart [mantra] and scorched, by throwing the weapon [mantra] at it. / Carried with another burning darbha, one should ignite it with this.

75.s:
astramantreṇa nirdagdhaṃ vahnau darbhaṃ punaḥ kṣipet /
kṣiptvā ghṛte kṛtagranthikuśaṃ prādeśasammitaṃ //
75.d:
अस्त्रमन्त्रेण निर्दग्धं वह्नौ दर्भं पुनः क्षिपेत् /
क्षिप्त्वा घृते कृतग्रन्थिकुशं प्रादेशसम्मितं //
75.m: Burnt by the weapon mantra, one should throw the darbha back into the fire. / Having thrown into the clarified butter a knotted kuśa measuring a span,

75.s:
pakṣadvayamiḍādīnāṃ trayaṃ cājye vibhāvayet /
krāmādbhāgatrayādājyaṃ sruveṇādāya homayet //
75.d:
पक्षद्वयमिडादीनां त्रयं चाज्ये विभावयेत् /
क्रामाद्भागत्रयादाज्यं स्रुवेणादाय होमयेत् //
75.m: one should visualize the two wings and the triad of Iḍā and the others in the clarified butter. / Taking clarified butter in sequence from the three portions with the ladle, one should offer it into the fire.

75.s:
svetyagnau hā ghṛte(1) bhāgaṃ śeṣamājyaṃ kṣipet kramāt /
oṃ hāṃ agnaye svāhā / oṃ hāṃ somāya svāhā / oṃ hāṃ
agnīṣomābhyāṃ svāhā
udghāṭanāya netrāṇāṃ agnernetratraye mukhe //
75.d:
स्वेत्यग्नौ हा घृते(1) भागं शेषमाज्यं क्षिपेत् क्रमात् /
ओं हां अग्नये स्वाहा / ओं हां सोमाय स्वाहा / ओं हां
अग्नीषोमाभ्यां स्वाहा
उद्घाटनाय नेत्राणां अग्नेर्नेत्रत्रये मुखे //
75.m:
Saying 'svāhā' into the fire, [saying] 'hāṃ' into the clarified butter, one should pour the remaining clarified butter portion in sequence:
'oṃ hāṃ agnaye svāhā' (Oṃ hāṃ, to Agni, svāhā); 'oṃ hāṃ somāya svāhā' (Oṃ hāṃ, to Soma, svāhā); 'oṃ hāṃ agnīṣomābhyāṃ svāhā' (Oṃ hāṃ, to Agni and Soma, svāhā).
For the opening of the eyes, [one offers] into the three eyes in the face of the fire.

75.s:
sruveṇa ghṛtapūrṇena caturthīmāhutiṃ yajet /
oṃ hāṃ agnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhā
abhimantrya ṣaḍaṅgena bodhayeddhenumudrayā //
75.d:
स्रुवेण घृतपूर्णेन चतुर्थीमाहुतिं यजेत् /
ओं हां अग्नये स्विष्टकृते स्वाहा
अभिमन्त्र्य षडङ्गेन बोधयेद्धेनुमुद्रया //
75.m: With the ladle filled with clarified butter, one should sacrifice the fourth oblation: / 'oṃ hāṃ agnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhā' (Oṃ hāṃ, to Agni maker of right sacrifice, svāhā). / Having consecrated it with the six limbs, one should awaken it with the cow mudrā,

75.s:
/
avaguṇṭhya tanutreṇa rakṣedājyaṃ śarāṇunā(2) /
/
hṛdājyavinduvikṣepāt kuryādabhyukṣya śodhanaṃ //
75.d:
/
अवगुण्ठ्य तनुत्रेण रक्षेदाज्यं शराणुना(2) /
/
हृदाज्यविन्दुविक्षेपात् कुर्यादभ्युक्ष्य शोधनं //
75.m: veiling it with the armour mantra, one should protect the clarified butter with the arrow-mantra. / By sprinkling drops of clarified butter with the heart mantra, having aspersioned, one should perform the purification.

75.s:
/
vaktrābhighārasandhānāṃ vaktraikīkaraṇaṃ tathā /
/
oṃ hāṃ sadyojātāya svāhā / oṃ hāṃ vāmadevāya svāhā / oṃ
hāṃ
:n
1 svāhetyagnau ghṛte iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 śarātmaneti ṇa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 223
aghorāya svāhā / oṃ tatpuruṣāya svāhā / oṃ hāṃ īśānāya
svāhā
ityekaikaghṛtāhutyā kuryādvaktrābhighārakaṃ //
auṃ hāṃ sadyojātavāmadevābhyāṃ svāhā / oṃ hāṃ
vāmadevāghorābhyāṃ svāhā / oṃ hāṃ aghoratatpuruṣābhyāṃ
svāhā / oṃ hāṃ tatpuruṣeśānābhyāṃ svāhā
75.d:
/
वक्त्राभिघारसन्धानां वक्त्रैकीकरणं तथा /
/
ओं हां सद्योजाताय स्वाहा / ओं हां वामदेवाय स्वाहा / ओं
हां
:न्
1 स्वाहेत्यग्नौ घृते इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 शरात्मनेति ण, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 223
अघोराय स्वाहा / ओं तत्पुरुषाय स्वाहा / ओं हां ईशानाय
स्वाहा
इत्येकैकघृताहुत्या कुर्याद्वक्त्राभिघारकं //
औं हां सद्योजातवामदेवाभ्यां स्वाहा / ओं हां
वामदेवाघोराभ्यां स्वाहा / ओं हां अघोरतत्पुरुषाभ्यां
स्वाहा / ओं हां तत्पुरुषेशानाभ्यां स्वाहा
75.m:
Then [follows] the lubrication of the mouths, their union, and the unification of the mouths.
'oṃ hāṃ sadyojātāya svāhā' (Oṃ hāṃ, to Sadyojāta, svāhā); 'oṃ hāṃ vāmadevāya svāhā' (Oṃ hāṃ, to Vāmadeva, svāhā); 'oṃ hāṃ'
[Gap in text]
1. 'svāhetyagnau ghṛte' is the reading of the manuscript marked ṅa.
2. 'śarātmanā' is the reading of the manuscript marked ṇa.
[Page 223]
'aghorāya svāhā' (to Aghora, svāhā); 'oṃ tatpuruṣāya svāhā' (Oṃ, to Tatpuruṣa, svāhā); 'oṃ hāṃ īśānāya svāhā' (Oṃ hāṃ, to Īśāna, svāhā)—
thus with an individual oblation of clarified butter, one should perform the lubrication of the mouths.
'auṃ hāṃ sadyojātavāmadevābhyāṃ svāhā; oṃ hāṃ vāmadevāghorābhyāṃ svāhā; oṃ hāṃ aghoratatpuruṣābhyāṃ svāhā; oṃ hāṃ tatpuruṣeśānābhyāṃ svāhā'—

75.s:
itivaktrānusandhānaṃ mantrair ebhiḥ kramāccaret /
agrito gatayā vāyuṃ nirṛtādiśivāntayā //
75.d:
इतिवक्त्रानुसन्धानं मन्त्रैर् एभिः क्रमाच्चरेत् /
अग्रितो गतया वायुं निरृतादिशिवान्तया //
75.m: thus one should perform the connection of the mouths in order with these mantras. / Flowing from the east to the northwest, and from the southwest to the northeast,

75.s:
vaktrāṇāmekatāṃ kuryāt sruveṇa ghṛtaghārayā /
oṃ hāṃ sadyojātavāmadevāghoratatpuruṣeśānebhyaḥ svāhā //
itīṣṭavaktre vaktrāṇāmantarbhāvastadākṛtiḥ //
75.d:
वक्त्राणामेकतां कुर्यात् स्रुवेण घृतघारया /
ओं हां सद्योजातवामदेवाघोरतत्पुरुषेशानेभ्यः स्वाहा //
इतीष्टवक्त्रे वक्त्राणामन्तर्भावस्तदाकृतिः //
75.m: one should unify the mouths with a stream of clarified butter from the ladle: / 'oṃ hāṃ sadyojātavāmadevāghoratatpuruṣeśānebhyaḥ svāhā' (Oṃ hāṃ, to Sadyojāta, Vāmadeva, Aghora, Tatpuruṣa, and Īśāna, svāhā). // / Thus the inclusion of the faces within the chosen face has that form.

75.s:
īśena vahnimabhyarcya datvāstreṇāhutitrayaṃ /
kuryāt sarvātmanā nāma śivāgnistvaṃ hutāśana //
75.d:
ईशेन वह्निमभ्यर्च्य दत्वास्त्रेणाहुतित्रयं /
कुर्यात् सर्वात्मना नाम शिवाग्निस्त्वं हुताशन //
75.m: Having worshipped the fire with Īśāna and offered three oblations with the weapon mantra, / one should bestow the name wholeheartedly: 'You are the fire of Śiva, O eater of oblations!'

75.s:
hṛdārcitau visṛṣṭāgnau pitarau vidhipūraṇīṃ /
mūlena vauṣaḍantena dadyāt pūrṇāṃ yathāvidhi //
75.d:
हृदार्चितौ विसृष्टाग्नौ पितरौ विधिपूरणीं /
मूलेन वौषडन्तेन दद्यात् पूर्णां यथाविधि //
75.m: The two parents, worshipped with the heart mantra, having been dismissed into the fire, completing the rite, / one should offer the full oblation according to rule with the basic mantra ending in vauṣaṭ.

75.s:
tato hṛdambuje sāṅgaṃ sasenaṃ bhāsuraṃ paraṃ(1) /
yajet pūrvavadāvāhya prārthyājñāntarpayecchivaṃ //
75.d:
ततो हृदम्बुजे साङ्गं ससेनं भासुरं परं(1) /
यजेत् पूर्ववदावाह्य प्रार्थ्याज्ञान्तर्पयेच्छिवं //
75.m: Then, having invoked in the heart lotus the supreme, radiant one, endowed with limbs and retinue, as before, / and having requested permission, one should propitiate Śiva.

75.s:
yāgāgniśivayoḥ kṛtvā nāḍīsandhānamātmanā /
śaktyā mūlāṇunā homaṃ kuryādaṅgair daśāṃśataḥ //
75.d:
यागाग्निशिवयोः कृत्वा नाडीसन्धानमात्मना /
शक्त्या मूलाणुना होमं कुर्यादङ्गैर् दशांशतः //
75.m: Having established the union of channels between the sacrificial fire and Śiva through oneself, / one should perform the fire oblation with the basic mantra according to capacity, and with the limbs by one-tenth part.

75.s:
ghṛtasya kārṣiko homaḥ kṣīrasya madhunas tathā /
śaktimātrāhutirdadhnaḥ prasṛtiḥ pāyasyatu //
75.d:
घृतस्य कार्षिको होमः क्षीरस्य मधुनस् तथा /
शक्तिमात्राहुतिर्दध्नः प्रसृतिः पायस्यतु //
75.m: The oblation of clarified butter is one karṣa, and likewise of milk and of honey; / the oblation of curd is according to capacity, while of milk-rice it is a handful.

75.s:
yathāvat sarvabhakṣāṇāṃ lājānāṃ muṣṭisammitaṃ /
khaṇḍatrayantu mūlānāṃ kalānāṃ svapramāṇataḥ //
:n
1 sasenaṃ bhāskaraṃ paramiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / śāsanaṃ
bhāskaraṃ paramiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / śāśanaṃ bhāsraṃ
paramiti ṅa cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / śāsanaṃ tryakṣaraṃ paramiti
gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 224
75.d:
यथावत् सर्वभक्षाणां लाजानां मुष्टिसम्मितं /
खण्डत्रयन्तु मूलानां कलानां स्वप्रमाणतः //
:न्
1 ससेनं भास्करं परमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / शासनं
भास्करं परमिति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / शाशनं भास्रं
परमिति ङ चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / शासनं त्र्यक्षरं परमिति
घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 224
75.m:
In the proper manner, of all eatables [and] of parched grains, the measure is a handful; / of roots, three pieces; and of peas, according to their own measure.
[Footnote]
1 Reading in the manuscript marked kha: 'sasenaṃ bhāskaraṃ param'; in ga: 'śāsanaṃ bhāskaraṃ param'; in ṅa: 'śāśanaṃ bhāsraṃ param'; in gha: 'śāsanaṃ tryakṣaraṃ param'. / [p. 224]

75.s:
grāsārdhamātramannānāṃ sūkṣmāṇi pañca homayet /
ikṣorāparvikaṃ mānaṃ latānāmaṅguladvayaṃ //
75.d:
ग्रासार्धमात्रमन्नानां सूक्ष्माणि पञ्च होमयेत् /
इक्षोरापर्विकं मानं लतानामङ्गुलद्वयं //
75.m: One should offer into the fire cooked grains in the measure of half a mouthful, [and] five subtle [substances]. / The measure of sugarcane is one joint; of creepers, two finger-breadths.

75.s:
puṣpaṃ patraṃ svamānena samidhāṃ tu daśāṅgulaṃ /
candracandanakāśmīrakastūrīyakṣakardamān //
75.d:
पुष्पं पत्रं स्वमानेन समिधां तु दशाङ्गुलं /
चन्द्रचन्दनकाश्मीरकस्तूरीयक्षकर्दमान् //
75.m: A flower or leaf according to its own size, but of kindling sticks, ten finger-breadths. / Camphor, sandalwood, saffron, musk, yakṣakardama paste—

75.s:
kalāyasammitānenān guggulaṃ vadarāsthivat /
kandānāmaṣṭamaṃ bhāgaṃ juhuyādvidhivat paraṃ //
75.d:
कलायसम्मितानेनान् गुग्गुलं वदरास्थिवत् /
कन्दानामष्टमं भागं जुहुयाद्विधिवत् परं //
75.m: these in the measure of a pea, and guggulu like a jujube stone; / of bulbous roots, one should offer an eighth part according to rule, as supreme.

75.s:
homaṃ nirvartayedevaṃ brahmavījapadaistataḥ /
ghṛtena sruci pūrṇāyāṃ nidhāyādhomukhaṃ sruvaṃ //
75.d:
होमं निर्वर्तयेदेवं ब्रह्मवीजपदैस्ततः /
घृतेन स्रुचि पूर्णायां निधायाधोमुखं स्रुवं //
75.m: One should thus perform the fire oblation with the seed-syllables of the brahmamantras. Then, / when the sruc-ladle is filled with clarified butter, placing the sruva-spoon face down,

75.s:
srugagre puṣpamāropya paścādvāmena pāṇinā /
punaḥ savyena tau dhṛtvā śaṅkhasannibhamudrayā //
75.d:
स्रुगग्रे पुष्पमारोप्य पश्चाद्वामेन पाणिना /
पुनः सव्येन तौ धृत्वा शङ्खसन्निभमुद्रया //
75.m: placing a flower on the tip of the sruc, thereafter holding them / with the left hand and then with the right in the conch ritual gesture,

75.s:
samudgato ardhakāyaś ca samapādaḥ samitthitaḥ /
nābhau tanmūlamādhāya srugagravyagralocanaḥ //
75.d:
समुद्गतो अर्धकायश् च समपादः समित्थितः /
नाभौ तन्मूलमाधाय स्रुगग्रव्यग्रलोचनः //
75.m: elevated, with upper body erect, with feet even, standing upright, / placing their base at the navel, fixing one's eyes on the tip of the sruc,

75.s:
brahmādikāraṇātyāgādviniḥsṛtya suṣumṇayā(1) /
vāmastanāntamānīya tayormūlamatandritaḥ //
75.d:
ब्रह्मादिकारणात्यागाद्विनिःसृत्य सुषुम्णया(1) /
वामस्तनान्तमानीय तयोर्मूलमतन्द्रितः //
75.m: having emerged along the suṣumṇā channel without leaving the cause which begins with Brahmā, / bringing their base to the vicinity of the left breast, unwearied,

75.s:
mūlamantramavispaṣṭaṃ vauṣaḍantaṃ samuccaret /
tadagnau juhuyādājyaṃ yavasammitadhārayā //
75.d:
मूलमन्त्रमविस्पष्टं वौषडन्तं समुच्चरेत् /
तदग्नौ जुहुयादाज्यं यवसम्मितधारया //
75.m: one should recite the root mantra inaudibly, ending with 'vauṣaṭ'. / One should offer that clarified butter into the fire in a stream the thickness of a barleycorn.

75.s:
ācāmaṃ candanaṃ datvā tāmbūlaprabhṛtīnapi /
bhaktyā tadbhūtimāvandya vidadhyātpraṇatiṃ parāṃ //
75.d:
आचामं चन्दनं दत्वा ताम्बूलप्रभृतीनपि /
भक्त्या तद्भूतिमावन्द्य विदध्यात्प्रणतिं परां //
75.m: Offering water for sipping, sandalwood paste, and betel leaves, / revering its ashes with devotion, one should make a supreme prostration.

75.s:
tato vahniṃ samabhyarcya paḍantāstreṇa saṃvarān /
saṃhāramudrayāhṛtya kṣamasvetyabhidhāya ca //
75.d:
ततो वह्निं समभ्यर्च्य पडन्तास्त्रेण संवरान् /
संहारमुद्रयाहृत्य क्षमस्वेत्यभिधाय च //
75.m: Then, having worshipped the fire, withdrawing the enclosures with the weapon mantra ending in 'phaṭ' / using the dissolution ritual gesture, and saying, 'Forgive me!',

75.s:
bhāsurān(2) paridhīstāṃś ca pūrakeṇa hṛdāṇunā(3) /
:n
1 viniḥsṛtya svapṛṣṭayā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ /
viniḥsṛtya svapuṣṭayā iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 bhāsvarāniti kha, ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 hṛdātmaneti kha, ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 225
śraddhayā parayātmīye sthāpayeta hṛdambuje //
75.d:
भासुरान्(2) परिधीस्तांश् च पूरकेण हृदाणुना(3) /
:न्
1 विनिःसृत्य स्वपृष्टया इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः /
विनिःसृत्य स्वपुष्टया इति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 भास्वरानिति ख, ग, घ, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 हृदात्मनेति ख, ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 225
श्रद्धया परयात्मीये स्थापयेत हृदम्बुजे //
75.m:
and [withdrawing] those radiant enclosing sticks with the heart mantra through inhalation,
[Footnote]
1 Reading in the manuscript marked kha: 'viniḥsṛtya svapṛṣṭayā'.
Reading in the manuscript marked ga: 'viniḥsṛtya svapuṣṭayā'.
2 Reading in the manuscripts marked kha, ga, gha, ṅa: 'bhāsvarān'.
3 Reading in the manuscripts marked kha, ga: 'hṛdātmanā'. / [p. 225]
one should establish them with supreme faith in the lotus of one's heart.

75.s:
sarvapākāgramādāya kṛtvā maṇḍalakadvayaṃ(1) /
antarvahirbaliṃ dadyādāgneyyāṃ kuṇḍasannidhau //
75.d:
सर्वपाकाग्रमादाय कृत्वा मण्डलकद्वयं(1) /
अन्तर्वहिर्बलिं दद्यादाग्नेय्यां कुण्डसन्निधौ //
75.m: Taking the first portion of all cooked offerings and making two small circles, / one should offer the inner and outer food offerings in the south-east, near the fire-pit:

75.s:
oṃ hāṃ rudrebhyaḥ svāhā pūrve mātṛbhyo dakṣiṇe tathā /
vāruṇe hāṃ gaṇebhyaś ca svāhā tebhyastvayaṃ baliḥ //
75.d:
ओं हां रुद्रेभ्यः स्वाहा पूर्वे मातृभ्यो दक्षिणे तथा /
वारुणे हां गणेभ्यश् च स्वाहा तेभ्यस्त्वयं बलिः //
75.m: 'Oṃ hāṃ to the Rudras svāhā' in the east; likewise to the Mothers in the south; / in the west, 'hāṃ to the Gaṇas svāhā, this food offering is for them';

75.s:
uttare hāñca yakṣebhya īśāne hāṃ grahebhya u(2) /
agnau hāmasurebhyaś ca rakṣobhyo nairṛte baliḥ //
75.d:
उत्तरे हाञ्च यक्षेभ्य ईशाने हां ग्रहेभ्य उ(2) /
अग्नौ हामसुरेभ्यश् च रक्षोभ्यो नैरृते बलिः //
75.m: in the north, 'hāṃ to the Yakṣas'; in the north-east, 'hāṃ to the Planets'; / in the south-east, 'hāṃ to the Asuras'; and the food offering is to the Rakṣases in the south-west;

75.s:
vāyavye hāñca nāgebhyo nakṣatrebhyaś ca madhyataḥ /
hāṃ rāśibhyaḥ(3) svāhā vahnau viśvebhyo nairṛte yathā //
75.d:
वायव्ये हाञ्च नागेभ्यो नक्षत्रेभ्यश् च मध्यतः /
हां राशिभ्यः(3) स्वाहा वह्नौ विश्वेभ्यो नैरृते यथा //
75.m: in the north-west, 'hāṃ to the Nāgas'; and to the Lunar Mansions in the center; / 'hāṃ to the Zodiacal Signs svāhā' in the south-east; to the Viśvedevas in the south-west;

75.s:
vāruṇyāṃ(4) kṣetrapālāya antarbalirudāhṛtaḥ /
dvitīye maṇḍale vāhye indyāyāgniyamāya ca //
75.d:
वारुण्यां(4) क्षेत्रपालाय अन्तर्बलिरुदाहृतः /
द्वितीये मण्डले वाह्ये इन्द्यायाग्नियमाय च //
75.m: in the west, to the Guardian of the Field: this is proclaimed as the inner food offering. / In the second, outer circle: to Indra, Agni, and Yama,

75.s:
nairṛtāya jaleśāya vāyave dhanarakṣiṇe /
īśānāya ca pūrvādau hīśāne brahmaṇe namaḥ //
75.d:
नैरृताय जलेशाय वायवे धनरक्षिणे /
ईशानाय च पूर्वादौ हीशाने ब्रह्मणे नमः //
75.m: to Nirṛti, to the Lord of Waters, to Vāyu, to the Guardian of Wealth, / and to Īśāna, beginning from the east; in the north-east, 'Salutation to Brahmā';

75.s:
nairṛte viṣṇave svāhā vāyasādervahirbaliḥ /
balidvayagatānmantrān saṃhāramudrayā.atmani //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye agnikāryaṃ nāma pañcasaptatitamo
'dhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 kṛtvā ca maṇḍaladvayamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 gaṇebhya u iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 hāṃ ṛpibhya iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 vāyavyāmiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / nairṛta iti ṅa,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 226
:ś atha ṣaṭsaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
caṇdapūjākathanaṃ
75.d:
नैरृते विष्णवे स्वाहा वायसादेर्वहिर्बलिः /
बलिद्वयगतान्मन्त्रान् संहारमुद्रया.अत्मनि //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये अग्निकार्यं नाम पञ्चसप्ततितमो
ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 कृत्वा च मण्डलद्वयमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 गणेभ्य उ इति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 हां ऋपिभ्य इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 वायव्यामिति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / नैरृत इति ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 226
:श् अथ षट्सप्ततितमो ऽध्यायः
चण्दपूजाकथनं
75.m:
in the south-west, 'To Viṣṇu svāhā'. The outer food offering is for crows and other creatures. / With the dissolution ritual gesture, [one draws] into oneself the mantras belonging to the two food offerings.
Thus in the ancient Great Purāṇa composed by Agni, the seventy-fifth chapter, named 'The Rite of Fire'.
[Footnote]
1 Reading in the manuscript marked kha: 'kṛtvā ca maṇḍaladvayam'.
2 Reading in the manuscript marked ga: 'gaṇebhya u'.
3 Reading in the manuscript marked ṅa: 'hāṃ ṛpibhya'.
4 Reading in the manuscript marked ga: 'vāyavyām'; reading in ṅa: 'nairṛte'. / [p. 226]
Now the seventy-sixth chapter.
The description of the worship of Caṇḍa.

76.s:
īśvara uvāca
tataḥ śivāntikaṅgatvā pūjāhomādikaṃ mama /
gṛhāṇa bhagavan puṇyaphalamityabhidhāya ca //
76.d:
ईश्वर उवाच
ततः शिवान्तिकङ्गत्वा पूजाहोमादिकं मम /
गृहाण भगवन् पुण्यफलमित्यभिधाय च //
76.m: Īśvara said: / Then, going into the presence of Śiva and saying, 'O Lord, accept / my worship, fire oblation, and other rites, and their holy fruit,'

76.s:
arghyodakena devāya mudrayodbhavasañjñayā /
hṛdvījapūrvamūlena sthiracitto nivedayet //
76.d:
अर्घ्योदकेन देवाय मुद्रयोद्भवसञ्ज्ञया /
हृद्वीजपूर्वमूलेन स्थिरचित्तो निवेदयेत् //
76.m: with water offering for the deity, with the ritual gesture called 'arising', / with a steady mind, preceded by the heart seed-syllable, one should offer [it] with the root mantra.

76.s:
tataḥ pūrvavadabhyarcya stutvā stotraiḥ praṇamya ca /
arghyaṃ parāṅmukhaṃ datvā kṣamasvetyabhidhāya ca //
76.d:
ततः पूर्ववदभ्यर्च्य स्तुत्वा स्तोत्रैः प्रणम्य च /
अर्घ्यं पराङ्मुखं दत्वा क्षमस्वेत्यभिधाय च //
76.m: Then, having worshipped as before, praised with hymns, and prostrated, / offering an averted water offering, and saying, 'Forgive me!',

76.s:
nārācamudrayāstreṇa phaḍantenātmasañcayaṃ /
saṃhṛtya divyayā liṅgaṃ mūrtimantreṇa yojayet //
76.d:
नाराचमुद्रयास्त्रेण फडन्तेनात्मसञ्चयं /
संहृत्य दिव्यया लिङ्गं मूर्तिमन्त्रेण योजयेत् //
76.m: with the iron-arrow ritual gesture, with the weapon mantra ending in 'phaṭ', withdrawing the collection of elements / into oneself, one should unite the liṅga with the icon mantra by means of divine [power].

76.s:
sthaṇḍile tvarcite deve mantrasaṅghātamātmani /
niyojya vidhinoktena vidadhyāccaṇḍapūjanaṃ //
76.d:
स्थण्डिले त्वर्चिते देवे मन्त्रसङ्घातमात्मनि /
नियोज्य विधिनोक्तेन विदध्याच्चण्डपूजनं //
76.m: When the deity has been worshipped on an altar, having drawn the assembly of mantras into oneself / according to the prescribed rule, one should perform the worship of Caṇḍa:

76.s:
oṃ caṇḍeśānāya namo madhyataś caṇḍamūrtaye /
oṃ dhūlicaṇḍeśvarāya(1) hūṃ phaṭ(2) svāhā tamāhṇayet //
76.d:
ओं चण्डेशानाय नमो मध्यतश् चण्डमूर्तये /
ओं धूलिचण्डेश्वराय(1) हूं फट्(2) स्वाहा तमाह्णयेत् //
76.m: 'Oṃ salutation to Caṇḍeśāna' in the center, to Caṇḍa's icon. / 'Oṃ to Dhūlicaṇḍeśvara hūṃ phaṭ svāhā'—one should invoke him with this.

76.s:
caṇḍahṛdayāya hūṃ phaṭ oṃ caṇḍaśirase tathā(3) /
oṃ caṇḍaśikhāyai hūṃ phaṭ caṇḍāyuḥ(4) kavacāya ca //
76.d:
चण्डहृदयाय हूं फट् ओं चण्डशिरसे तथा(3) /
ओं चण्डशिखायै हूं फट् चण्डायुः(4) कवचाय च //
76.m: 'To the heart of Caṇḍa hūṃ phaṭ', 'Oṃ to the head of Caṇḍa' likewise, / 'Oṃ to the crest of Caṇḍa hūṃ phaṭ', and 'To the armor of Caṇḍa',

76.s:
caṇḍastrāya tathā hūṃ phaṭ caṇḍaṃ rudrāgnijaṃ smaret /
śūlaṭaṅkadharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sākṣasūtrakaṇḍaluṃ //
76.d:
चण्डस्त्राय तथा हूं फट् चण्डं रुद्राग्निजं स्मरेत् /
शूलटङ्कधरं कृष्णं साक्षसूत्रकण्डलुं //
76.m: likewise 'To the weapon of Caṇḍa hūṃ phaṭ'. One should meditate on Caṇḍa born of Rudra's fire, / holding a trident and a chisel, black, with a rosary and water-pot,

76.s:
ṭaṅkākare 'rdhacandre(5) vā caturvaktraṃ prapūjayet /
:n
1 oṃ balicaṇḍeśvarāya iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 krūṃ phaḍiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 hūṃ caṇḍaśirase svāheti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 hūṃ phaṭ caṇdata iti ga, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
5 ṭaṅkāreṇārdhacandre iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 227
yathāśakti japaṃ kuryādaṅgānāntu daśāṃśataḥ //
76.d:
टङ्काकरे ऽर्धचन्द्रे(5) वा चतुर्वक्त्रं प्रपूजयेत् /
:न्
1 ओं बलिचण्डेश्वराय इति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 क्रूं फडिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 हूं चण्डशिरसे स्वाहेति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 हूं फट् चण्दत इति ग, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
5 टङ्कारेणार्धचन्द्रे इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 227
यथाशक्ति जपं कुर्यादङ्गानान्तु दशांशतः //
76.m:
or in a chisel-shaped [pit] or a crescent, four-faced, one should worship him.
[Footnote]
1 Reading in the manuscript marked ga: 'oṃ balicaṇḍeśvarāya'.
2 Reading in the manuscript marked ṅa: 'krūṃ phaṭ'.
3 Reading in the manuscript marked ga: 'hūṃ caṇḍaśirase svāhā'.
4 Reading in the two manuscripts marked ga and gha: 'hūṃ phaṭ caṇdata'.
5 Reading in the manuscript marked kha: 'ṭaṅkāreṇārdhacandre'. / [p. 227]
One should perform recitation according to one's ability, and a tenth part for the auxiliary limbs.
Leaving aside cows, land, gold, garments, gems, gold ornaments, and the like, / one should offer the remaining used offerings to Caṇḍeśa:

76.s:
lehyacoṣyādyanuvaraṃ tāmbūlaṃ sragvilepanaṃ /
nirmālyaṃ bhojanaṃ tubhyaṃ pradattantu śivājñayā //
76.d:
लेह्यचोष्याद्यनुवरं ताम्बूलं स्रग्विलेपनं /
निर्माल्यं भोजनं तुभ्यं प्रदत्तन्तु शिवाज्ञया //
76.m: 'Food to be licked, sucked, and the like, the excellent betel, garlands, ointments, / the used offerings, and food are presented to you by the command of Śiva.

76.s:
sarvametat kriyākāṇḍaṃ mayā caṇḍa tavājñayā /
nyūnādhikaṃ kṛtaṃ mohāt paripūrṇaṃ sadāstu me //
76.d:
सर्वमेतत् क्रियाकाण्डं मया चण्ड तवाज्ञया /
न्यूनाधिकं कृतं मोहात् परिपूर्णं सदास्तु मे //
76.m: Whatever of this whole division of rituals has been performed by me by your command, O Caṇḍa, / deficient or excessive through delusion, may it always be complete for me.'

76.s:
iti vijñāpya deveśaṃ datvārghyaṃ tasya saṃsmaran /
saṃhāramūrtimantreṇa śanaiḥ saṃhāramudrayā //
76.d:
इति विज्ञाप्य देवेशं दत्वार्घ्यं तस्य संस्मरन् /
संहारमूर्तिमन्त्रेण शनैः संहारमुद्रया //
76.m: Having thus addressed the Lord of gods, offering him a water offering, remembering him, / with the icon mantra of dissolution, slowly with the dissolution ritual gesture,

76.s:
pūrakānvitamūlena mantrānātmani yojayet /
nirmālyāpanayasthānaṃ limpedgomayavāriṇā /
prokṣyārghyādi visṛjyātha ācānto 'nyatsamācaret //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye caṇḍapūjākathanaṃ nāma
ṣaṭsaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha saptasaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
kapilādipūjāvidhanaṃ
76.d:
पूरकान्वितमूलेन मन्त्रानात्मनि योजयेत् /
निर्माल्यापनयस्थानं लिम्पेद्गोमयवारिणा /
प्रोक्ष्यार्घ्यादि विसृज्याथ आचान्तो ऽन्यत्समाचरेत् //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये चण्डपूजाकथनं नाम
षट्सप्ततितमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ सप्तसप्ततितमो ऽध्यायः
कपिलादिपूजाविधनं
76.m:
with the root mantra accompanied by inhalation, one should unite the mantras into oneself. / One should smear the place of removing the used offerings with cow-dung water; / having sprinkled it, dismissed the water offerings and other things, and sipped water, one should perform other rites.
:e Thus ends the seventy-sixth chapter, named "The Description of the Worship of Caṇḍa," in the primary Mahāpurāṇa, the Āgneya.
Now the seventy-seventh chapter.
The rule for the worship of Kapilā and others.

77.s:
īśvara uvāca
kapilāpūjanaṃ vakṣye ebhirmantrair yajecca gāṃ /
oṃ kapile nande namaḥ oṃ kapile bhadrike namaḥ //
77.d:
ईश्वर उवाच
कपिलापूजनं वक्ष्ये एभिर्मन्त्रैर् यजेच्च गां /
ओं कपिले नन्दे नमः ओं कपिले भद्रिके नमः //
77.m:
Īśvara said:
I shall explain the worship of the brown cow (kapilā); one should worship the cow with these mantras:
"Om, obeisance to the brown cow, Nandā! Om, obeisance to the brown cow, Bhadrikā!

77.s:
oṃ kapile suśīle namaḥ kapile surabhiprabhe /
oṃ kapile sumanase namaḥ oṃ bhuktimuktiprade namaḥ //
77.d:
ओं कपिले सुशीले नमः कपिले सुरभिप्रभे /
ओं कपिले सुमनसे नमः ओं भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदे नमः //
77.m:
Om, obeisance to the brown cow, Suśīlā! [Obeisance] to the brown cow radiant as Surabhi!
Om, obeisance to the brown cow, Sumanas! Om, obeisance to the granter of worldly enjoyment and liberation!

77.s:
saurabheyi jaganmātardevānāmamṛtaprade /
gṛhāṇa varade grāsamīpsitārthañca dehi me //
:p 228
77.d:
सौरभेयि जगन्मातर्देवानाममृतप्रदे /
गृहाण वरदे ग्रासमीप्सितार्थञ्च देहि मे //
:प् 228
77.m:
O daughter of Surabhi, mother of the universe, granter of nectar to the gods,
accept this mouthful of food, O grantor of boons, and give me the desired object!
[Page 228]

77.s:
vanditāsi vasiṣṭhena viśvāmitreṇa dhīmatā /
kapile hara me pāpaṃ yanmayā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ //
77.d:
वन्दितासि वसिष्ठेन विश्वामित्रेण धीमता /
कपिले हर मे पापं यन्मया दुष्कृतं कृतं //
77.m:
You have been praised by Vasiṣṭha and by wise Viśvāmitra.
O brown cow, take away my sin, whatever misdeed has been done by me!

77.s:
gāvo mamāgrato nityaṃ gāvaḥ pṛṣṭhata eva ca /
gāvo me hṛdaye cāpi gavāṃ madhye vasāmyahaṃ //
77.d:
गावो ममाग्रतो नित्यं गावः पृष्ठत एव च /
गावो मे हृदये चापि गवां मध्ये वसाम्यहं //
77.m:
May cows be always in front of me, and cows behind me;
may cows be in my heart, and may I dwell among cows!"

77.s:
dattaṃ gṛhṇantu(1) me grāsaṃ japtvā syāṃ nirmalaḥ śivaḥ /
prārcya vidyāpustakāni gurupādau namennaraḥ //
77.d:
दत्तं गृह्णन्तु(1) मे ग्रासं जप्त्वा स्यां निर्मलः शिवः /
प्रार्च्य विद्यापुस्तकानि गुरुपादौ नमेन्नरः //
77.m:
Having recited: "May they accept the mouthful given by me; may I be stainless Śiva,"
a man, having worshipped the books of sacred knowledge, should bow to the feet of his guru.

77.s:
yajet snātvā tu madhyāhne aṣṭapuṣpikayā śivaṃ /
pīṭhamūrtiśivāṅgānāṃ pūjā syādaṣṭapuṣpikā //
77.d:
यजेत् स्नात्वा तु मध्याह्ने अष्टपुष्पिकया शिवं /
पीठमूर्तिशिवाङ्गानां पूजा स्यादष्टपुष्पिका //
77.m:
Having bathed at midday, he should worship Śiva with the eight-flower offering (aṣṭapuṣpikā);
the worship of the pedestal, the icon, and Śiva's limbs constitutes the eight-flower offering.

77.s:
madhyāhne bhojanāgāre sulipte pākamānayet /
tato mṛtyuñjayenaiva vauṣaḍantena saptadhā //
77.d:
मध्याह्ने भोजनागारे सुलिप्ते पाकमानयेत् /
ततो मृत्युञ्जयेनैव वौषडन्तेन सप्तधा //
77.m:
At midday, in the dining room that has been well smeared, he should bring the cooked food.
Then, with the Mṛtyuñjaya mantra ending with 'vauṣaṭ' seven times,

77.s:
japtaiḥ sadarbhaśaṅkhasthaiḥ siñcettaṃ vārivindubhiḥ /
sarvapākāgramuddhṛtya śivāya vinivedayet //
77.d:
जप्तैः सदर्भशङ्खस्थैः सिञ्चेत्तं वारिविन्दुभिः /
सर्वपाकाग्रमुद्धृत्य शिवाय विनिवेदयेत् //
77.m:
he should sprinkle it with drops of water recited over [the food] contained in a conch shell with darbha grass.
Taking the choice portion of all the cooked food, he should offer it to Śiva.

77.s:
athārdhaṃ(2) cullikāhome vidhānāyopakalpayet(3) /
viśodhya vidhinā cullīṃ tadvahniṃ pūrakāhutiṃ //
77.d:
अथार्धं(2) चुल्लिकाहोमे विधानायोपकल्पयेत्(3) /
विशोध्य विधिना चुल्लीं तद्वह्निं पूरकाहुतिं //
77.m:
Then he should set aside half for the rule of the hearth-fire oblation (cullikāhoma).
Having purified the hearth according to rule, [he offers into] that fire the inhalation oblation (pūrakāhuti),

77.s:
hutvā nābhyagninā caikaṃ tato recakavāyunā /
vahnivījaṃ samādāya kādisthānagatikramāt(4) //
77.d:
हुत्वा नाभ्यग्निना चैकं ततो रेचकवायुना /
वह्निवीजं समादाय कादिस्थानगतिक्रमात्(4) //
77.m:
having offered it as one with the fire of the navel; then, with the exhalation breath,
taking up the seed-syllable of fire according to the sequence of passage through the places from 'ka' onwards,

77.s:
śivāgnistvamiti dhyātvā cullikāgnau niveśayet /
oṃ hāṃ agnaye namo vai hāṃ somāya vai namaḥ //
77.d:
शिवाग्निस्त्वमिति ध्यात्वा चुल्लिकाग्नौ निवेशयेत् /
ओं हां अग्नये नमो वै हां सोमाय वै नमः //
77.m:
meditating, "You are the fire of Śiva," he should deposit it in the hearth-fire:
"Oṃ hāṃ, obeisance indeed to Agni; hāṃ, obeisance indeed to Soma;

77.s:
sūryāya vṛhaspataye prajānāṃ pataye namaḥ /
sarvebhyaś caiva devebhyaḥ sarvaviśvebhya eva ca //
:n
1 dattaṃ gṛhāṇeti ga, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
2 anyārdhamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / antyārdhamiti ṅa,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 nidhānāyopakalpayediti ca, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
4 hṛdi sthānamatikramediti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ /
kādisthānamatikramāditi kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 229
77.d:
सूर्याय वृहस्पतये प्रजानां पतये नमः /
सर्वेभ्यश् चैव देवेभ्यः सर्वविश्वेभ्य एव च //
:न्
1 दत्तं गृहाणेति ग, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
2 अन्यार्धमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / अन्त्यार्धमिति ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 निधानायोपकल्पयेदिति च, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
4 हृदि स्थानमतिक्रमेदिति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः /
कादिस्थानमतिक्रमादिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 229

77.s:
hāmagnaye khiṣṭikṛte pūrvādāvarcayedimān /
svāhāntāmāhutiṃ datvā kṣamayitvā visarjayet //
77.d:
हामग्नये खिष्टिकृते पूर्वादावर्चयेदिमान् /
स्वाहान्तामाहुतिं दत्वा क्षमयित्वा विसर्जयेत् //
77.m:
hāṃ, to Agni Sviṣṭakṛt." He should worship these beginning in the east;
having offered the oblation ending in svāhā and asked forgiveness, he should dismiss [them].

77.s:
cullyā dakṣiṇabāhau ca yajeddharmāya vai namaḥ /
vāmabāhāvadharmāya kāñjikādikabhāṇḍake //
77.d:
चुल्ल्या दक्षिणबाहौ च यजेद्धर्माय वै नमः /
वामबाहावधर्माय काञ्जिकादिकभाण्डके //
77.m:
And on the right arm of the hearth he should worship: "Obeisance indeed to Dharma";
on the left arm, "To Adharma"; on the pot of sour gruel and the like,

77.s:
rasaparivartamānāya varuṇāya jalāgnaye(1) /
vighnarājo gṛhadvāre peṣaṇyāṃ subhage namaḥ //
77.d:
रसपरिवर्तमानाय वरुणाय जलाग्नये(1) /
विघ्नराजो गृहद्वारे पेषण्यां सुभगे नमः //
77.m:
to Varuṇa, who transforms the fluids, and to the fire in the water;
"O Lord of Obstacles (Vighnarāja), at the house door; on the grinding stone: Obeisance to Subhagā;

77.s:
oṃ raudrike namo girike(2) namaś caolūkhale yajet /
balapriyāyāyudhāya namaste muṣale yajet //
77.d:
ओं रौद्रिके नमो गिरिके(2) नमश् चओलूखले यजेत् /
बलप्रियायायुधाय नमस्ते मुषले यजेत् //
77.m:
Oṃ, obeisance to Raudrikā; obeisance to Girikā," he should worship on the mortar;
"O weapon fond of strength, obeisance to you," he should worship on the pestle;

77.s:
sammārjanyāṃ devatokte kāmāya śayanīyake /
madhyastambhe ca skandāya datvā vāstubaliṃ tataḥ //
77.d:
सम्मार्जन्यां देवतोक्ते कामाय शयनीयके /
मध्यस्तम्भे च स्कन्दाय दत्वा वास्तुबलिं ततः //
77.m:
on the broom, as stated for the deity; on the bed, to Kāma;
and on the central pillar, to Skanda. Then, having offered the site-offering (vāstubali),

77.s:
bhuñjīta pātre sauvarṇe padminyādidalādike /
ācāryaḥ sādhakaḥputra samayī maunamāsthitaḥ //
77.d:
भुञ्जीत पात्रे सौवर्णे पद्मिन्यादिदलादिके /
आचार्यः साधकःपुत्र समयी मौनमास्थितः //
77.m:
the master (ācārya), the adept (sādhaka), the spiritual son (putraka), or the novice (samayin),
maintaining silence, should eat from a golden dish, or on leaves of the lotus and the like.

77.s:
vaṭāśvatthārkavātāvisarjabhallātakāṃstyajet /
apośānaṃ purādāya prāṇādyaiḥ praṇavānvitaiḥ //
77.d:
वटाश्वत्थार्कवाताविसर्जभल्लातकांस्त्यजेत् /
अपोशानं पुरादाय प्राणाद्यैः प्रणवान्वितैः //
77.m:
He should avoid [leaves of] the banyan, holy fig, madar, vātāvi, sarja, and marking-nut trees.
Having first taken the sipping water (apośāna), with the [mantras] of the vital breaths accompanied by the Praṇava

77.s:
svāhāntenāhutīḥ pañca datvādīpyodarānalaṃ /
nāgaḥ kūrmo 'tha kṛkaro devadatto dhanañjayaḥ //
77.d:
स्वाहान्तेनाहुतीः पञ्च दत्वादीप्योदरानलं /
नागः कूर्मो ऽथ कृकरो देवदत्तो धनञ्जयः //
77.m:
and ending with svāhā, offering five oblations, having kindled the belly fire;
[and reciting the names of the secondary breaths:] Nāga, Kūrma, Kṛkara, Devadatta, and Dhanañjaya;

77.s:
etebhya upavāyubhyaḥ svāhāpoṣānavāriṇā /
bhaktādikaṃ nivedyāya piveccheṣodakaṃ naraḥ //
77.d:
एतेभ्य उपवायुभ्यः स्वाहापोषानवारिणा /
भक्तादिकं निवेद्याय पिवेच्छेषोदकं नरः //
77.m:
[reciting:] "Svāhā to these secondary breaths!" with the sipping water,
having offered the cooked food and the rest, a man should drink the remaining water,

77.s:
amṛtopastaraṇamasi prāṇāhutīstato dadet /
prāṇāya svāhāpānāya samānāya tatas tathā //
77.d:
अमृतोपस्तरणमसि प्राणाहुतीस्ततो ददेत् /
प्राणाय स्वाहापानाय समानाय ततस् तथा //
77.m:
[saying:] "You are the spread of nectar." Then he should offer the oblations to the vital breaths:
"Svāhā to the prāṇa, to the apāna, and likewise then to the samāna,

77.s:
udānāya ca vyānāya bhuktvā cullakamācaret /
:n
1 jalāśaye iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 oṃ raudrakoṭigirike iti kha, ga, gha, ṅa,
cihnitapustakacatuṣṭayapāṭhaḥ
:p 230
amṛtāpiścānamasīti śarīre 'nnādivāyavaḥ(1) //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye vāstupūjākathanaṃ nāma
saptasaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś athoṣṭasaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
pavitrārohaṇakathanaṃ
77.d:
उदानाय च व्यानाय भुक्त्वा चुल्लकमाचरेत् /
:न्
1 जलाशये इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 ओं रौद्रकोटिगिरिके इति ख, ग, घ, ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकचतुष्टयपाठः
:प् 230
अमृतापिश्चानमसीति शरीरे ऽन्नादिवायवः(1) //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये वास्तुपूजाकथनं नाम
सप्तसप्ततितमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथोष्टसप्ततितमो ऽध्यायः
पवित्रारोहणकथनं
77.m:
and to the udāna and to the vyāna." Having eaten, he should perform the rinsing of the mouth with a mouthful of water (cullaka),
[Footnote]
1 "jalāśaye" is the reading of the manuscript marked ṅa.
2 "oṃ raudrakoṭigirike" is the reading of the four manuscripts marked kha, ga, gha, and ṅa.
[Page 230]
[reciting:] "You are the covering of nectar." These are the winds of food and the rest in the body.
Thus ends the seventy-seventh chapter in the primary Mahāpurāṇa composed by Agni, entitled "Description of the Worship of the Site".
Now, the seventy-eighth chapter:
Description of the Investiture with Sacred Thread (pavitrārohaṇa)

78.s:
īśvara uvāca
pavitrārohaṇaṃ vakṣye kriyārcādiṣu pūraṇaṃ /
nityaṃ tannityamuddiṣṭaṃ naimittikamathāparaṃ //
78.d:
ईश्वर उवाच
पवित्रारोहणं वक्ष्ये क्रियार्चादिषु पूरणं /
नित्यं तन्नित्यमुद्दिष्टं नैमित्तिकमथापरं //

78.s:
āṣāḍhādicaturdaśyāmatha śrāvaṇabhādrayoḥ /
sitāsitāsu kartavyaṃ caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu tat //
78.d:
आषाढादिचतुर्दश्यामथ श्रावणभाद्रयोः /
सितासितासु कर्तव्यं चतुर्दश्यष्टमीषु तत् //
78.m:
On the fourteenth day of the lunar months beginning with Āṣāḍha, and then in Śrāvaṇa and Bhādrapada,
on the fourteenth and eighth lunar days during the bright and dark fortnights, it should be performed;

78.s:
kuryādvā kārttikīṃ yāvattithau pratipādike /
vahnibrahmāmbikebhāsyanāgaskandārkaśūlināṃ //
78.d:
कुर्याद्वा कार्त्तिकीं यावत्तिथौ प्रतिपादिके /
वह्निब्रह्माम्बिकेभास्यनागस्कन्दार्कशूलिनां //
78.m:
or one may perform it up to Kārttika on lunar days beginning with the first (pratipad),
for Agni, Brahmā, Ambikā, Ganeśa, the Nāgas, Skanda, Sūrya, Śiva,

78.s:
durgāyamendragovindasmaraśambhusudhābhujāṃ(2) /
sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ kṛtādiṣu yathākramaṃ //
78.d:
दुर्गायमेन्द्रगोविन्दस्मरशम्भुसुधाभुजां(2) /
सौवर्णं राजतं ताम्रं कृतादिषु यथाक्रमं //
78.m:
Durgā, Yama, Indra, Govinda, Kāma, Śambhu, and the gods.
[The thread should be] gold, silver, or copper in the Kṛta and subsequent ages, respectively;

78.s:
kalau kārpāsajaṃ cāpi paṭṭapadmādisūtrakaṃ /
praṇavaś candramā vahnirbrahmā nāgo guho hariḥ(3) //
78.d:
कलौ कार्पासजं चापि पट्टपद्मादिसूत्रकं /
प्रणवश् चन्द्रमा वह्निर्ब्रह्मा नागो गुहो हरिः(3) //
78.m:
and in the Kali age, made of cotton, or a thread of silk, lotus fibre, and the like.
The Praṇava, the Moon, Fire, Brahmā, the Serpent, Guha, Hari,

78.s:
sarveśaḥ(4) sarvadevāḥ syuḥ krameṇa navatantuṣu /
aṣṭottaraśatānyardhaṃ tadardhaṃ cottamādikaṃ //
78.d:
सर्वेशः(4) सर्वदेवाः स्युः क्रमेण नवतन्तुषु /
अष्टोत्तरशतान्यर्धं तदर्धं चोत्तमादिकं //
78.m:
the Lord of All (Sarveśa), and all the gods reside in order in the nine strands.
One hundred and eight, half of that, and half of that [are the strands], from best to lowest;

78.s:
ekāśītyāthavā sūtraistriṃśatāppaṣṭayuktayā /
:n
1 śarīronmādavāyava iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 svadhābhujāmiti kha, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
3 guho raviriti kha, ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakacatuṣṭayapāṭhaḥ
4 sadeśa iti kha, ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 231
pañcāśatā vā kartavyaṃ tulyagranthyantarālakaṃ //
78.d:
एकाशीत्याथवा सूत्रैस्त्रिंशताप्पष्टयुक्तया /
:न्
1 शरीरोन्मादवायव इति घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 स्वधाभुजामिति ख, घ, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकत्रयपाठः
3 गुहो रविरिति ख, ग, घ, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकचतुष्टयपाठः
4 सदेश इति ख, ग, घ, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 231
पञ्चाशता वा कर्तव्यं तुल्यग्रन्थ्यन्तरालकं //
78.m:
or with eighty-one threads, or with thirty-six,
[Footnote]
1 "śarīronmādavāyavaḥ" is the reading of the manuscript marked gha.
2 "svadhābhujām" is the reading of the three manuscripts marked kha, gha, and ṅa.
3 "guho raviḥ" is the reading of the four manuscripts marked kha, ga, gha, and ṅa.
4 "sadeśaḥ" is the reading of the manuscript marked kha, ga, gha, and ṅa.
[Page 231]
or it should be made with fifty, with equal spaces between the knots.

78.s:
dvādaśāṅgulamānāni vyāsādaṣṭāṅgulāni ca /
liṅgavistāramānāni caturaṅgulakāni vā //
78.d:
द्वादशाङ्गुलमानानि व्यासादष्टाङ्गुलानि च /
लिङ्गविस्तारमानानि चतुरङ्गुलकानि वा //
78.m:
The measurements are twelve aṅgulas, or eight aṅgulas across,
or the size of the width of the liṅga, or four aṅgulas.

78.s:
tathaiva piṇḍikāsparśaṃ caturthaṃ sarvadaivataṃ /
gaṅgāvatārakaṃ kāryaṃ sujātena sudhautakaṃ //
78.d:
तथैव पिण्डिकास्पर्शं चतुर्थं सर्वदैवतं /
गङ्गावतारकं कार्यं सुजातेन सुधौतकं //
78.m:
Likewise, touching the pedestal; the fourth is for all deities.
It should be made reaching down to the descent of the Gaṅgā, well formed and well washed.

78.s:
granthiṃ kuryācca vāmena aghoraṇātha śodhayet /
rañjayet puruṣeṇaiva raktacandanakuṅkumaiḥ //
78.d:
ग्रन्थिं कुर्याच्च वामेन अघोरणाथ शोधयेत् /
रञ्जयेत् पुरुषेणैव रक्तचन्दनकुङ्कुमैः //
78.m:
One should tie the knot with the Vāmadeva mantra, and purify it with the Aghora mantra;
he should color it with the Tatpuruṣa mantra using red sandalwood and saffron,

78.s:
kastūrīrocanācandrair haridrāgair ikādibhiḥ /
granthayo daśa kartavyā athavā tantusaṅkhyayā //
78.d:
कस्तूरीरोचनाचन्द्रैर् हरिद्रागैर् इकादिभिः /
ग्रन्थयो दश कर्तव्या अथवा तन्तुसङ्ख्यया //
78.m:
musk, yellow rocanā, camphor, turmeric, and red ochre.
Ten knots are to be made, or according to the number of threads;

78.s:
antaraṃ vā yathāśobhamekadvicaturaṅgulaṃ /
prakṛtiḥ pauruṣī vīrā caturthī tvaparājitā //
78.d:
अन्तरं वा यथाशोभमेकद्विचतुरङ्गुलं /
प्रकृतिः पौरुषी वीरा चतुर्थी त्वपराजिता //
78.m:
or the interval may be one, two, or four aṅgulas, according to aesthetic balance.
Prakṛti, Pauruṣī, Vīrā, and the fourth is Aparājitā,

78.s:
jayānyā vijayā ṣaṣṭhī ajitā ca sadāśivā /
manonmanī sarvamukhī granthayo 'bhyadhikāḥ śubhāḥ //
78.d:
जयान्या विजया षष्ठी अजिता च सदाशिवा /
मनोन्मनी सर्वमुखी ग्रन्थयो ऽभ्यधिकाः शुभाः //
78.m:
Jayā, another Vijayā, the sixth Ajitā, and Sadāśivā,
Manonmanī, and Sarvamukhī—the extra knots are auspicious.

78.s:
kāryā vā candravahnyarkapavitraṃ(1) śivavaddhṛdi /
ekaikaṃ nijamūrtau vā puptake guruke gaṇe(2) //
78.d:
कार्या वा चन्द्रवह्न्यर्कपवित्रं(1) शिववद्धृदि /
एकैकं निजमूर्तौ वा पुप्तके गुरुके गणे(2) //
78.m:
Or the sacred threads of the Moon, Fire, and Sun should be made on the chest, like Śiva's,
or one on each own icon, on the sacred book, on the guru, and on the assembly;

78.s:
syādekaikaṃ tathā dvāradikpālakalaśādiṣu /
hastādinavahastāntaṃ liṅgānāṃ syātpavitrakaṃ //
78.d:
स्यादेकैकं तथा द्वारदिक्पालकलशादिषु /
हस्तादिनवहस्तान्तं लिङ्गानां स्यात्पवित्रकं //
78.m:
likewise, there should be one each on the door, the guardians of the directions, the water pots, and the like.
The sacred thread for liṅgas should range from one cubit (hasta) up to nine cubits.

78.s:
aṣṭāviṃśatito yuddhaṃ daśabhirdaśabhiḥ kramāt /
dvyaṅgulābhyantarāstatra kramādekāṅgulāntarāḥ //
78.d:
अष्टाविंशतितो युद्धं दशभिर्दशभिः क्रमात् /
द्व्यङ्गुलाभ्यन्तरास्तत्र क्रमादेकाङ्गुलान्तराः //
78.m: From twenty-eight [threads], joined ten by ten in succession, / there they are separated by two aṅgulas, [or] in order by one aṅgula.

78.s:
granthayo mānamapyeṣāṃ liṅgavistārasasmitaṃ /
saptamyāṃ vā trayodaśyāṃ kṛtanityakriyaḥ śuciḥ //
78.d:
ग्रन्थयो मानमप्येषां लिङ्गविस्तारसस्मितं /
सप्तम्यां वा त्रयोदश्यां कृतनित्यक्रियः शुचिः //
78.m: The measurement of their knots also corresponds to the breadth of the liṅga. / On the seventh or the thirteenth [tithi], having performed the daily rites, purified,

78.s:
bhūṣayet puṣpavastrādyaiḥ sāyāhne yāgamandiraṃ /
:n
1 caṇḍavahnyarkapavitramiti kha, ga, ṅa. cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
2 pustake gurave gaṇo iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 232
kṛtvā naimittikīṃ sandhyāṃ viśeṣeṇa ca tarpaṇaṃ //
78.d:
भूषयेत् पुष्पवस्त्राद्यैः सायाह्ने यागमन्दिरं /
:न्
1 चण्डवह्न्यर्कपवित्रमिति ख, ग, ङ. चिह्नितपुस्तकत्रयपाठः
2 पुस्तके गुरवे गणो इति ख, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 232
कृत्वा नैमित्तिकीं सन्ध्यां विशेषेण च तर्पणं //
78.m:
one should decorate the sacrificial pavilion in the evening with flowers, garments, and other articles.
:n
1. 'caṇḍavahnyarkapavitram' is the reading in the three manuscripts marked kha, ga, and ṅa.
2. 'pustake gurave gaṇo' is the reading in the manuscripts marked kha and ṅa. / :p 232
Having performed the occasional twilight prayers and especially the water libations,

78.s:
parigṛhīte bhūbhāge pavitre sūryamarcayet(1) /
ācamya sakalīkṛtya praṇavārghyakaro guruḥ //
78.d:
परिगृहीते भूभागे पवित्रे सूर्यमर्चयेत्(1) /
आचम्य सकलीकृत्य प्रणवार्घ्यकरो गुरुः //
78.m: in the marked-out, consecrated precinct of the site, one should worship the Sun. / Having sipped water and performed the complete ritual imposition, the guru, holding the water offering with the praṇava,

78.s:
dvārāṇyastreṇa samprokṣya pūrvādikramato 'rcayet /
hāṃ śāntikalādvārāya tathā vidyākalātmane //
78.d:
द्वाराण्यस्त्रेण सम्प्रोक्ष्य पूर्वादिक्रमतो ऽर्चयेत् /
हां शान्तिकलाद्वाराय तथा विद्याकलात्मने //
78.m: having sprinkled the doors with the Astra mantra, should worship [them] in order beginning from the east: / 'Hāṃ, to the door of the Śānti kalā,' and likewise to the one whose essence is the Vidyā kalā,

78.s:
nivṛttikalādvārāya pratiṣṭhākhyakalātmane /
tacchākhayoḥ pratidvāraṃ dvau dvau dvārādhipau yajet //
78.d:
निवृत्तिकलाद्वाराय प्रतिष्ठाख्यकलात्मने /
तच्छाखयोः प्रतिद्वारं द्वौ द्वौ द्वाराधिपौ यजेत् //
78.m: to the door of the Nivṛtti kalā, and to the one whose essence is the Pratiṣṭhā kalā. / On their two door-jambs, at every door, he should worship two door-guardians:

78.s:
nandine mahākālāya bhṛṅgiṇe 'tha gaṇāya ca /
vṛṣabhāya ca skandāya devyai caṇḍāya ca kramāt //
78.d:
नन्दिने महाकालाय भृङ्गिणे ऽथ गणाय च /
वृषभाय च स्कन्दाय देव्यै चण्डाय च क्रमात् //
78.m: To Nandin, to Mahākāla, to Bhṛṅgin, and then to Gaṇa, / to Vṛṣabha, to Skanda, to Devī, and to Caṇḍa in order.

78.s:
nityaṃ ca dvārapālādīn praviśya dvārapaścime /
iṣṭvā vāstuṃ bhūtaśuddhiṃ viśeṣārghyakaraḥ śivaḥ //
78.d:
नित्यं च द्वारपालादीन् प्रविश्य द्वारपश्चिमे /
इष्ट्वा वास्तुं भूतशुद्धिं विशेषार्घ्यकरः शिवः //
78.m: And having entered [past] the daily door-guardians and others at the west of the door, / having worshipped the site deity and performed the purification of the elements, the guru, holding the special water offering and identified with Śiva,

78.s:
prokṣaṇādyaṃ(2) vidhāyātha yajñasambhārakṛnnaraḥ /
mantrayeddarbhadūrvādyaiḥ puṣpādyaiś ca hṛdādibhiḥ //
78.d:
प्रोक्षणाद्यं(2) विधायाथ यज्ञसम्भारकृन्नरः /
मन्त्रयेद्दर्भदूर्वाद्यैः पुष्पाद्यैश् च हृदादिभिः //
78.m: having performed sprinkling and other rites, the person preparing the sacrificial materials / should consecrate them with kuśa grass, dūrvā grass, and the like, with flowers and other offerings, and with the Hṛdaya and other [aṅga-mantras].

78.s:
śivahastaṃ vidhāyetthaṃ(3) svaśirasyadhiropayet /
śivo 'hamādiḥ sarvajño mama yajñapradhānatā //
78.d:
शिवहस्तं विधायेत्थं(3) स्वशिरस्यधिरोपयेत् /
शिवो ऽहमादिः सर्वज्ञो मम यज्ञप्रधानता //
78.m: Having thus formed the Śiva-hand, he should place it upon his own head: / 'I am Śiva, the primordial, the omniscient; mine is the preeminence in the sacrifice.'

78.s:
atyarthaṃ bhāvayeddevaṃ jñānakhadgakaro guruḥ /
nairṛtīṃ diśamāsādya prakṣipedudagānanaḥ //
78.d:
अत्यर्थं भावयेद्देवं ज्ञानखद्गकरो गुरुः /
नैरृतीं दिशमासाद्य प्रक्षिपेदुदगाननः //
78.m: The guru, holding the sword of wisdom, should intensely contemplate the Lord. / Having approached the southwest direction, facing north,

78.s:
arghyāmbu pañcagavyañca samastān makhamaṇḍape /
catuṣpathāntasaṃskārair vīkṣaṇādyaiḥ(4) susaṃskṛtaiḥ //
78.d:
अर्घ्याम्बु पञ्चगव्यञ्च समस्तान् मखमण्डपे /
चतुष्पथान्तसंस्कारैर् वीक्षणाद्यैः(4) सुसंस्कृतैः //
78.m: he should cast the water offering and the five cow-products over the entire sacrificial pavilion, / with the purifications culminating in the fourfold path, well purified by gazing and the like.

78.s:
vikṣipya vikirāṃstatra kuśakūrcopasaṃharet(5) /
:n
1 sūtrite sūryamarcayediti kha, ga, gha, ṅa,
cihnitapustakacatuṣṭayapāṭhaḥ
2 prokṣaṇacceti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 vidhāyaikamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 brāhmaṇādyair iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
5 daśakūrñcopasaṃharediti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 233
tānīśadiśi(1) vardhanyāmāsanāyopakalpayet //
78.d:
विक्षिप्य विकिरांस्तत्र कुशकूर्चोपसंहरेत्(5) /
:न्
1 सूत्रिते सूर्यमर्चयेदिति ख, ग, घ, ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकचतुष्टयपाठः
2 प्रोक्षणच्चेति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 विधायैकमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 ब्राह्मणाद्यैर् इति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
5 दशकूर्ञ्चोपसंहरेदिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 233
तानीशदिशि(1) वर्धन्यामासनायोपकल्पयेत् //
78.m:
Having scattered the loose offerings there, he should collect them with a bundle of kuśa grass;
:n
1. 'sūtrite sūryamarcayet' is the reading in the four manuscripts marked kha, ga, gha, and ṅa.
2. 'prokṣaṇācca' is the reading in the manuscript marked ga.
3. 'vidhāyaikam' is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
4. 'brāhmaṇādyair' is the reading in the manuscript marked ga.
5. 'daśakūrcopasaṃharet' is the reading in the manuscript marked kha. / :p 233
he should arrange them in the northeast direction as a seat for the vardhanī vessel.

78.s:
nairṛte vāstugīrvāṇā dvāre lakṣmīṃ prapūjayet /
paścimābhimukhaṃ kumbhaṃ sarvadhānyopari sthitaṃ //
78.d:
नैरृते वास्तुगीर्वाणा द्वारे लक्ष्मीं प्रपूजयेत् /
पश्चिमाभिमुखं कुम्भं सर्वधान्योपरि स्थितं //
78.m: In the southwest one should worship the site deities, and at the door Lakṣmī. / [One should place] the pitcher facing west, set upon all varieties of grain,

78.s:
praṇavena vṛṣārūḍhaṃ siṃhasthāṃ vardhanīntataḥ /
kumbhe sāṅgaṃ śivandevaṃ vardhanyāmarcayet(2) //
78.d:
प्रणवेन वृषारूढं सिंहस्थां वर्धनीन्ततः /
कुम्भे साङ्गं शिवन्देवं वर्धन्यामर्चयेत्(2) //
78.m: seated upon the bull by means of the praṇava, and then the vardhanī vessel seated upon the lion. / In the pitcher one should worship the divine Śiva with his limbs, and [his weapon] in the vardhanī vessel,

78.s:
dikṣu śakrādidikpālān viṣṇubrahmaśivādikān(3) /
vardhanīṃ samyagādāya ghaṭapṛṣṭānugāminīṃ //
78.d:
दिक्षु शक्रादिदिक्पालान् विष्णुब्रह्मशिवादिकान्(3) /
वर्धनीं सम्यगादाय घटपृष्टानुगामिनीं //
78.m: and in the directions the guardians of the directions headed by Indra, and Viṣṇu, Brahmā, Śiva, and the others. / Fully taking up the vardhanī vessel that follows behind the pitcher,

78.s:
śivājñāṃ śrāvayenmantrī pūrvādīśānagocaraṃ /
avicchinnapayodhārāṃ mūlamantramudīrayet //
78.d:
शिवाज्ञां श्रावयेन्मन्त्री पूर्वादीशानगोचरं /
अविच्छिन्नपयोधारां मूलमन्त्रमुदीरयेत् //
78.m: the ritual master should proclaim the command of Śiva from the east ending in the northeast. / With an unbroken stream of water, he should recite the root mantra.

78.s:
samantād bhrāmayedenāṃ rakṣārthaṃ śastrarūpiṇīṃ /
pūrvaṃ kalaśamāropya śastrārthantasya(4) vāmataḥ //
78.d:
समन्ताद् भ्रामयेदेनां रक्षार्थं शस्त्ररूपिणीं /
पूर्वं कलशमारोप्य शस्त्रार्थन्तस्य(4) वामतः //
78.m: He should carry it around everywhere for protection, [since it is] the embodiment of the weapon. / Having first installed the pitcher, to its left for the sake of the weapon,

78.s:
samagrāsanake kumbhe yajeddevaṃ sthirāsane /
vardhanyāṃ praṇavasthāyāmāyudhantadanu dvayoḥ //
78.d:
समग्रासनके कुम्भे यजेद्देवं स्थिरासने /
वर्धन्यां प्रणवस्थायामायुधन्तदनु द्वयोः //
78.m: in the pitcher on a complete seat he should worship the God on a firm seat; / in the vardhanī vessel resting on the praṇava, the weapon; thereafter, of the two,

78.s:
bhagaliṅgasamāyogaṃ vidadhyālliṅgamudrayā /
kumbhe nivedya bodhāsiṃ mūlamantrajapantathā //
78.d:
भगलिङ्गसमायोगं विदध्याल्लिङ्गमुद्रया /
कुम्भे निवेद्य बोधासिं मूलमन्त्रजपन्तथा //
78.m: he should effect the union of the yoni and liṅga with the liṅga mudrā. / Having offered the sword of consciousness in the pitcher, and likewise recitation of the root mantra,

78.s:
taddaśāṃśena vardhanyāṃ rakṣāṃ vijñāpayedapi(5) /
gaṇeśaṃ vāyave 'bhyarcya haraṃ pañcāmṛtādibhiḥ //
78.d:
तद्दशांशेन वर्धन्यां रक्षां विज्ञापयेदपि(5) /
गणेशं वायवे ऽभ्यर्च्य हरं पञ्चामृतादिभिः //
78.m: he should also request protection in the vardhanī vessel with one-tenth of that [recitation]. / Having worshipped Gaṇeśa in the northwest, [and] Hara with the five nectars and other substances,

78.s:
snāpayet pūrvavat prārcya(6) kuṇḍe ca śivapāvakaṃ(7) /
:n
1 anīśadiśi iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
2 vardhanyāṃ śastramarcayediti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 viṣṇubrahmāvasānakāniti kha, ṅa,
cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
4 śastrālambhasyeti ka, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
5 rakṣāṃ ca kārayet sadeti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
6 pūrvavat snāpayet prārcediti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / sthāpayet
pūrvavaccāgnimiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
7 kumbhe vā śivamarcayediti ga, cihnitaspustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 234
vidhivacca caruṃ kṛtvā sampātāhutiśodhitaṃ //
78.d:
स्नापयेत् पूर्ववत् प्रार्च्य(6) कुण्डे च शिवपावकं(7) /
:न्
1 अनीशदिशि इति ख, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
2 वर्धन्यां शस्त्रमर्चयेदिति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 विष्णुब्रह्मावसानकानिति ख, ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
4 शस्त्रालम्भस्येति क, ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
5 रक्षां च कारयेत् सदेति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
6 पूर्ववत् स्नापयेत् प्रार्चेदिति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / स्थापयेत्
पूर्ववच्चाग्निमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
7 कुम्भे वा शिवमर्चयेदिति ग, चिह्नितस्पुस्तकपाठः
:प् 234
विधिवच्च चरुं कृत्वा सम्पाताहुतिशोधितं //
78.m:
he should bathe him as before, and having first worshipped the fire of Śiva in the fire-pit,
:n
1. 'anīśadiśi' is the reading in the two manuscripts marked kha and ṅa.
2. 'vardhanyāṃ śastramarcayet' is the reading in the manuscript marked ga.
3. 'viṣṇubrahmāvasānakān' is the reading in the two manuscripts marked kha and ṅa.
4. 'śastrālambhasya' is the reading in the two manuscripts marked ka and ga.
5. 'rakṣāṃ ca kārayet sadā' is the reading in the manuscript marked ga.
6. 'pūrvavat snāpayet prārced' is the reading in the manuscript marked ga; 'sthāpayet pūrvavaccāgnim' is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
7. 'kumbhe vā śivamarcayed' is the reading in the manuscript marked ga. / :p 234
and having prepared the sacrificial boiled offering according to rule, purified by the remnant oblations,

78.s:
devāgryātmavibhedena darṣyā taṃ vibhajet tridhā /
datvā bhāgau śivāgnibhyāṃ saṃrakṣedbhāgamātmani //
78.d:
देवाग्र्यात्मविभेदेन दर्ष्या तं विभजेत् त्रिधा /
दत्वा भागौ शिवाग्निभ्यां संरक्षेद्भागमात्मनि //
78.m: he should divide it threefold with a ladle into portions for the deity, the fire, and oneself. / Having given two shares to Śiva and the fire, he should reserve a share for himself.

78.s:
śareṇa carmaṇā deyaṃ pūrvato dantadhāvanaṃ /
tasmādghoraśikhābhyāṃ vā dakṣiṇe paścime mṛdaṃ //
78.d:
शरेण चर्मणा देयं पूर्वतो दन्तधावनं /
तस्माद्घोरशिखाभ्यां वा दक्षिणे पश्चिमे मृदं //
78.m: A tooth-cleansing stick should be given in the east with the Astra and Kavaca mantras; / clay in the south or west with the Aghora and Śikhā mantras;

78.s:
sādyojātena ca hṛdā cottare vāmanīkṛtaṃ(1) /
jalaṃ(2) vāmena śirasā īśe gandhānvitaṃ jalaṃ //
78.d:
साद्योजातेन च हृदा चोत्तरे वामनीकृतं(1) /
जलं(2) वामेन शिरसा ईशे गन्धान्वितं जलं //
78.m: and in the north, water made fit for sipping with the Sadyojāta and the Hṛdaya mantras; / with the Vāmadeva and Śiras mantras, water endowed with perfume in the northeast;

78.s:
pañcagavyaṃ palāśādipuṭakaṃ vai samantataḥ /
aiśānyāṃ kusumaṃ dadyādāgneyyāṃ diśi rocanāṃ //
78.d:
पञ्चगव्यं पलाशादिपुटकं वै समन्ततः /
ऐशान्यां कुसुमं दद्यादाग्नेय्यां दिशि रोचनां //
78.m: the five cow-products in cups of palāśa and other leaves on all sides. / He should offer a flower in the northeast, and yellow orpiment in the southeast;

78.s:
aguruṃ nirṛtāśāyāṃ vāyavyāṃ ca catuḥsamaṃ /
homadravyāṇi sarvāṇi sadyojātaiḥ kuśaiḥ saha //
78.d:
अगुरुं निरृताशायां वायव्यां च चतुःसमं /
होमद्रव्याणि सर्वाणि सद्योजातैः कुशैः सह //
78.m: aloe-wood in the southwest direction, and fourfold perfume in the northwest; / all oblation materials together with freshly gathered kuśa grass;

78.s:
daṇḍākṣasūtrakaupīnabhikṣāpātrāṇi(3) rūpiṇe /
kajjalaṃ kuṅkumantailaṃ śalākāṃ keśaśodhanīṃ //
78.d:
दण्डाक्षसूत्रकौपीनभिक्षापात्राणि(3) रूपिणे /
कज्जलं कुङ्कुमन्तैलं शलाकां केशशोधनीं //
78.m: a staff, a rosary, a loincloth, and an alms-bowl for the ascetic icon; / collyrium, saffron, oil, an application rod, a comb for cleaning hair,

78.s:
tāmbūlaṃ darpaṇaṃ dadyāduttare rocanāmapi /
āsanaṃ pāduke pātraṃ yogapaṭṭātapatrakaṃ //
78.d:
ताम्बूलं दर्पणं दद्यादुत्तरे रोचनामपि /
आसनं पादुके पात्रं योगपट्टातपत्रकं //
78.m: betel, and a mirror, and he should also give yellow orpiment in the north; / a seat, sandals, a vessel, an ascetic's strap, and an umbrella

78.s:
aiśānyāmīśamantreṇa dadyādīśānatuṣṭaye /
pūrvasyāñcarukaṃ sājyaṃ dadyādgandhādikaṃ nave //
78.d:
ऐशान्यामीशमन्त्रेण दद्यादीशानतुष्टये /
पूर्वस्याञ्चरुकं साज्यं दद्याद्गन्धादिकं नवे //
78.m: he should offer in the northeast with the Īśa mantra for the gratification of Īśāna; / in the east he should offer the caru porridge with clarified butter, [and] perfume and other articles in a new [vessel].

78.s:
pūrvitrāṇi samādāya prokṣitānyarghyavāriṇā /
saṃhitāmantrapūtāni nītvā pāvakasannidhiṃ //
78.d:
पूर्वित्राणि समादाय प्रोक्षितान्यर्घ्यवारिणा /
संहितामन्त्रपूतानि नीत्वा पावकसन्निधिं //
78.m: Having taken up the sacred threads, sprinkled them with arghya water, / and purified them with the Saṃhitā mantras, having brought them near the fire,

78.s:
kṛṣṇājinādinā.acchādya smaran saṃvatsarātmakaṃ /
sākṣiṇaṃ sarvakṛtyānāṃ goptāraṃ śivamavyayaṃ //
:n
1 sadyojātena ca hṛdā cottare vāmanīyakamiti kha,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / sadyojātena ca hṛdā cottare dhāma
niṣphalamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 phalamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 daṇḍākṣasūtrakaupānatīrthapātrāṇi iti ṅa,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 235
78.d:
कृष्णाजिनादिना.अच्छाद्य स्मरन् संवत्सरात्मकं /
साक्षिणं सर्वकृत्यानां गोप्तारं शिवमव्ययं //
:न्
1 सद्योजातेन च हृदा चोत्तरे वामनीयकमिति ख,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / सद्योजातेन च हृदा चोत्तरे धाम
निष्फलमिति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 फलमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 दण्डाक्षसूत्रकौपानतीर्थपात्राणि इति ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 235
78.m:
and covered them with a black antelope skin and the like, remembering the immutable Śiva / whose nature is the year, the witness of all actions, the protector,
:n
1. 'sadyojātena ca hṛdā cottare vāmanīyakam' is the reading in the manuscript marked kha; 'sadyojātena ca hṛdā cottare dhāma niṣphalam' is the reading in the manuscript marked ga.
2. 'phalam' is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
3. 'daṇḍākṣasūtrakaupānatīrthapātrāṇi' is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa. / :p 235

78.s:
sveti heti prayogeṇa mantrasaṃhitayā punaḥ /
śodhayecca pavitrāṇi vārāṇāmekaviṃśatiṃ //
78.d:
स्वेति हेति प्रयोगेण मन्त्रसंहितया पुनः /
शोधयेच्च पवित्राणि वाराणामेकविंशतिं //
78.m: with the application of 'svāhā' and 'phaṭ' using the Saṃhitā mantras, / he should purify the sacred threads twenty-one times.

78.s:
gṛhādi veṣṭayetsūtrair gandhādyaṃ (1) ravaye dadet /
pūjitāya samācamya(2) kṛtanyāsaḥ kṛtārghyakaḥ //
78.d:
गृहादि वेष्टयेत्सूत्रैर् गन्धाद्यं (1) रवये ददेत् /
पूजिताय समाचम्य(2) कृतन्यासः कृतार्घ्यकः //
78.m: One should wrap the temple and other structures with threads, and offer perfume and the like to the Sun. / Having sipped water before the worshipped deity, having performed ritual deposition and offered arghya water,

78.s:
nandyādibhyo 'tha(3) gandhākhyaṃ(4) vāstoścātha praviśya ca /
śastrebhyo lokapālebhyaḥ svanāmnā śivakumbhake //
78.d:
नन्द्यादिभ्यो ऽथ(3) गन्धाख्यं(4) वास्तोश्चाथ प्रविश्य च /
शस्त्रेभ्यो लोकपालेभ्यः स्वनाम्ना शिवकुम्भके //
78.m: [one should offer] the perfume to Nandin and the others, and of the site, and having entered, / to the weapons and the world-protectors, each by name, in the Śiva pitcher.

78.s:
vardhanyai vighnarājāya gurave hy ātmane yajet /
atha sarvauṣadhīliptaṃ dhūpitaṃ puṣpadūrvayā //
78.d:
वर्धन्यै विघ्नराजाय गुरवे ह्य् आत्मने यजेत् /
अथ सर्वौषधीलिप्तं धूपितं पुष्पदूर्वया //
78.m: He should sacrifice unto the vardhanī pitcher, the lord of obstacles, the guru, and the Self. / Then, [taking] that which is smeared with all medicinal herbs, perfumed with incense, along with flowers and dūrvā grass,

78.s:
āmantrya ca pavitraṃ(5) tat vidhāyāñjalimadhyagaṃ /
oṃ samastavidhicchidrapūraṇe ca vidhiṃ prati //
78.d:
आमन्त्र्य च पवित्रं(5) तत् विधायाञ्जलिमध्यगं /
ओं समस्तविधिच्छिद्रपूरणे च विधिं प्रति //
78.m: and invoking that sacred thread, placing it in the middle of his cupped hands: / 'Oṃ, for the fulfillment of the rite and the repair of every ritual defect,

78.s:
prabhavamantrayāmi tvāṃ tvadicchāvāptikārikāṃ /
tatsiddhimanujānīhi yajataścidacitpate //
78.d:
प्रभवमन्त्रयामि त्वां त्वदिच्छावाप्तिकारिकां /
तत्सिद्धिमनुजानीहि यजतश्चिदचित्पते //
78.m: I invite you, who bring about the attainment of your desire; / permit its accomplishment for the sacrificer, O Lord of the conscious and unconscious!

78.s:
sarvathā sarvadā śambho namaste 'stu prasīda me /
āmantrito 'si deveśa saha devyā gaṇeśvaraiḥ //
78.d:
सर्वथा सर्वदा शम्भो नमस्ते ऽस्तु प्रसीद मे /
आमन्त्रितो ऽसि देवेश सह देव्या गणेश्वरैः //
78.m: In every way and at all times, O Śambhu, obeisance be to you; be pleased with me! / You are invited, O Lord of the gods, along with the Goddess, the lords of Gaṇas,

78.s:
mantreśair lokapālaiś ca sahitaḥ paricārakaiḥ(6) /
nimantrayāmyahantubhyaṃ prabhāte tu pavitrakaṃ //
78.d:
मन्त्रेशैर् लोकपालैश् च सहितः परिचारकैः(6) /
निमन्त्रयाम्यहन्तुभ्यं प्रभाते तु पवित्रकं //
78.m: accompanied by the lords of mantras, the world-protectors, and your attendants! / I invite you to the sacred thread at dawn,

78.s:
niyamañca kariṣyāmi parameśa tavājñayā /
ityevandevamāmantrya recakenāmṛtīkṛtaṃ //
78.d:
नियमञ्च करिष्यामि परमेश तवाज्ञया /
इत्येवन्देवमामन्त्र्य रेचकेनामृतीकृतं //
78.m: and I shall perform my observance by your command, O Supreme Lord!' / Having thus invited the god, [the sacred thread] made immortal through the out-breath,

78.s:
śivāntaṃ mūlamuccārya tacchivāya nivedayet /
:n
1 gandhākhyamiti kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapaṭhaḥ
2 pūjanārthaṃ samācamya iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 ravyādibhyo 'theti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 gandhādyamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
5 āmantraṇapavitramiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
6 parivārakaiviti ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 236
japaṃ stotraṃ pramāṇañca kṛtvā śambhuṃ kṣamāpayet //
78.d:
शिवान्तं मूलमुच्चार्य तच्छिवाय निवेदयेत् /
:न्
1 गन्धाख्यमिति ख, ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपठः
2 पूजनार्थं समाचम्य इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 रव्यादिभ्यो ऽथेति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 गन्धाद्यमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
5 आमन्त्रणपवित्रमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
6 परिवारकैविति ग, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 236
जपं स्तोत्रं प्रमाणञ्च कृत्वा शम्भुं क्षमापयेत् //
78.m:
uttering the basic mantra ending with Śiva, he should offer it to Śiva.
[Gap in text]
1. 'gandhākhyam' is the reading of the two manuscripts marked kha and ga.
2. 'pūjanārthaṃ samācamya' is the reading of the manuscript marked ṅa.
3. 'ravyādibhyo 'tha' is the reading of the manuscript marked ga.
4. 'gandhādyam' is the reading of the manuscript marked ṅa.
5. 'āmantraṇapavitram' is the reading of the manuscript marked kha.
6. 'parivārakaiviti' [sic] is the reading of the manuscripts marked ga and ṅa. / page 236
Having performed recitation, praise, and prostration, he should ask Śambhu for pardon.

78.s:
hutvā carostṛtīyāṃśaṃ taddaddīta śivāgnaye(1) /
digvāsibhyo digīśebhyo bhūtamātṛgaṇebhya u(2) //
78.d:
हुत्वा चरोस्तृतीयांशं तद्दद्दीत शिवाग्नये(1) /
दिग्वासिभ्यो दिगीशेभ्यो भूतमातृगणेभ्य उ(2) //
78.m: Having offered a third portion of the caru in oblation, he should give that to the fire of Śiva, / and to the quarter-dwellers, the quarter-lords, and the hosts of spirits and mothers,

78.s:
rudrebhyo kṣetrapādibhyo(3) namaḥ svāhā balistvayaṃ /
diṅnāgādyaiś ca pūrvādau kṣetrāya cāgnaye baliḥ //
78.d:
रुद्रेभ्यो क्षेत्रपादिभ्यो(3) नमः स्वाहा बलिस्त्वयं /
दिङ्नागाद्यैश् च पूर्वादौ क्षेत्राय चाग्नये बलिः //
78.m: to the Rudras and the protectors of the field: 'Namaḥ svāhā, this is the offering.' / With the elephants of the quarters and the others, in the east and the rest, an offering is made to the field and to Agni.

78.s:
samācamya vidhicchidrapūrakaṃ homamācaret /
pūrṇāṃ vyāhṛtihomañca kṛtvā rundhīta pāvakaṃ //
78.d:
समाचम्य विधिच्छिद्रपूरकं होममाचरेत् /
पूर्णां व्याहृतिहोमञ्च कृत्वा रुन्धीत पावकं //
78.m: Having sipped water, he should perform a fire oblation that fills ritual defects. / Having made the full oblation and the vyāhṛti oblation, he should constrain the fire.

78.s:
tata omagnaye svāhā svāhā somāya caiva hi /
omagnīṣomābhyāṃ svāhāgnaye sviṣṭakṛte tathā //
78.d:
तत ओमग्नये स्वाहा स्वाहा सोमाय चैव हि /
ओमग्नीषोमाभ्यां स्वाहाग्नये स्विष्टकृते तथा //
78.m: Then: 'Oṃ, to Agni svāhā! Svāhā to Soma indeed! / Oṃ, to Agni and Soma svāhā! Likewise, to Agni Sviṣṭakṛt!'

78.s:
ityāhuticatuṣkantu datvā kuryāttu yojanāṃ /
vahnikuṇḍārcitaṃ devaṃ maṇḍalābhyarcite śive //
78.d:
इत्याहुतिचतुष्कन्तु दत्वा कुर्यात्तु योजनां /
वह्निकुण्डार्चितं देवं मण्डलाभ्यर्चिते शिवे //
78.m: Having thus offered the set of four oblations, he should make the union: / the god worshipped in the fire-pit unto Śiva worshipped in the maṇḍala,

78.s:
nāḍīsandhānarūpeṇa vidhinā yojayettataḥ /
vaṃśādipātre vinyasya astrañca hṛdayantataḥ //
78.d:
नाडीसन्धानरूपेण विधिना योजयेत्ततः /
वंशादिपात्रे विन्यस्य अस्त्रञ्च हृदयन्ततः //
78.m: he should then unite by the rite having the form of channel-connection. / Placing it in a vessel of bamboo or the like, then [reciting] the weapon-mantra and the heart-mantra,

78.s:
adhiropya pavitrāṇi kalābhirvātha mantrayet /
ṣaḍaṅgaṃ brahmamūlair vā hṛddharmāstrañca yojayet //
78.d:
अधिरोप्य पवित्राणि कलाभिर्वाथ मन्त्रयेत् /
षडङ्गं ब्रह्ममूलैर् वा हृद्धर्मास्त्रञ्च योजयेत् //
78.m: and having mounted the sacred threads, he should consecrate them with mantras by means of the parts; / or with the six limbs, the basic Brahman mantras, he should join the heart, dharma, and weapon.

78.s:
vidhāya sūtraiḥ saṃveṣṭya pūjayitvāṅgasambhavaiḥ(4) /
rakṣārthaṃ jagadīśāya bhaktinamraḥ samarpayet //
78.d:
विधाय सूत्रैः संवेष्ट्य पूजयित्वाङ्गसम्भवैः(4) /
रक्षार्थं जगदीशाय भक्तिनम्रः समर्पयेत् //
78.m: Having performed [this], wrapped them with threads, and worshipped with the offerings produced for the limbs, / bowed with devotion, he should present them to the Lord of the universe for protection.

78.s:
pūjite puṣpadhūpādyair datvā siddhāntapustake /
guroḥ pādāntikaṃ gatvā bhaktyā dadyāt pavitrakaṃ //
78.d:
पूजिते पुष्पधूपाद्यैर् दत्वा सिद्धान्तपुस्तके /
गुरोः पादान्तिकं गत्वा भक्त्या दद्यात् पवित्रकं //
78.m: When it is worshipped with flowers, incense, and the like, offering [it] to the Siddhānta book, / and going near the feet of the guru, he should present the sacred thread with devotion.

78.s:
nirgatya vahirācamya gomaye maṇḍalatraye /
:n
1 śivājñayā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 bhūtamātṛgaṇeṣu phaḍiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 rudrebhyaḥ kṣetrapālebhya iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 pūjayitvā tataḥ śivamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / pūjayitvātha
sañcarair iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 237
pañcagavyañcarundantadhāvanañca kramād yajet //
78.d:
निर्गत्य वहिराचम्य गोमये मण्डलत्रये /
:न्
1 शिवाज्ञया इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 भूतमातृगणेषु फडिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 रुद्रेभ्यः क्षेत्रपालेभ्य इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 पूजयित्वा ततः शिवमिति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / पूजयित्वाथ
सञ्चरैर् इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 237
पञ्चगव्यञ्चरुन्दन्तधावनञ्च क्रमाद् यजेत् //
78.m:
Going out and sipping water outside, on three maṇḍalas made of cow dung,
[Gap in text]
1. 'śivājñayā' is the reading of the manuscript marked kha.
2. 'bhūtamātṛgaṇeṣu phaṭ' is the reading of the manuscript marked ṅa.
3. 'rudrebhyaḥ kṣetrapālebhyaḥ' is the reading of the manuscript marked kha.
4. 'pūjayitvā tataḥ śivam' is the reading of the manuscript marked ga; 'pūjayitvātha sañcaraiḥ' is the reading of the manuscript marked ṅa. / page 237
he should sacrifice in order the five products of the cow, the caru, and the tooth-cleansing stick.

78.s:
ācānto mantrasambaddhaḥ kṛtasaṅgītajāgaraḥ /
svapedantaḥ smarannīśaṃ bubhukṣurdarbhasaṃstare //
78.d:
आचान्तो मन्त्रसम्बद्धः कृतसङ्गीतजागरः /
स्वपेदन्तः स्मरन्नीशं बुभुक्षुर्दर्भसंस्तरे //
78.m: Having sipped water, bound by mantras, having performed vigil with music, / one desiring worldly enjoyment should sleep inside on a bed of darbha grass, remembering the Lord.

78.s:
anenaiva prakāreṇa mumukṣurapi saṃviśet /
kevalambhasmaśayyāyāṃ sopavāsaḥ samāhitaḥ //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye pavitrādhivāsanavidhirnāma
aṣṭasaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś athaikonāśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
pavitrārohaṇavidhiḥ
78.d:
अनेनैव प्रकारेण मुमुक्षुरपि संविशेत् /
केवलम्भस्मशय्यायां सोपवासः समाहितः //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये पवित्राधिवासनविधिर्नाम
अष्टसप्ततितमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथैकोनाशीतितमो ऽध्यायः
पवित्रारोहणविधिः
78.m:
In this very manner, one desiring liberation also should lie down, / only on a bed of ashes, fasting and concentrated.
Thus ends the seventy-eighth chapter, named 'The Rule of Preliminary Consecration of the Sacred Thread', in the primeval Mahāpurāṇa composed by Agni.
Now, the seventy-ninth chapter.
The Rule for Investiture with the Sacred Thread

79.s:
īśvara uvāca
atha prātaḥ samutthāya kṛtasnānaḥ samāhitaḥ /
