kṛtasandhyārcano mantrī praviśya makhamaṇḍapaṃ //
79.d:
ईश्वर उवाच
अथ प्रातः समुत्थाय कृतस्नानः समाहितः /
कृतसन्ध्यार्चनो मन्त्री प्रविश्य मखमण्डपं //
79.m: The Lord said: / Now, having risen in the morning, bathed, composed in mind, / having performed the twilight worship, the practitioner of mantras, entering the sacrificial pavilion,

79.s:
samādāya pavitrāṇi avisarjitadaivataḥ /
aiśānyāṃ bhājane śuddhe sthāpayet kṛtamaṇḍale //
79.d:
समादाय पवित्राणि अविसर्जितदैवतः /
ऐशान्यां भाजने शुद्धे स्थापयेत् कृतमण्डले //
79.m: taking the sacred threads, not having dismissed the deity, / should place them in the north-east in a clean vessel on an executed maṇḍala.

79.s:
tato visarjya deveśaṃ nirmālyamapanīya ca /
pūrvavad bhūtale śuddhekṛtvāhnikamatha dvayaṃ //
79.d:
ततो विसर्ज्य देवेशं निर्माल्यमपनीय च /
पूर्ववद् भूतले शुद्धेकृत्वाह्निकमथ द्वयं //
79.m: Then, having dismissed the Lord of the gods and removed the flowers from the previous day, / having performed as before the two daily rites on clean ground,

79.s:
ādityadvāradikpālakumbheśānau śive 'nale(1) /
naimittikīṃ savistarāṃ kuryāt pūjāṃ viśeṣataḥ //
79.d:
आदित्यद्वारदिक्पालकुम्भेशानौ शिवे ऽनले(1) /
नैमित्तिकीं सविस्तरां कुर्यात् पूजां विशेषतः //
79.m: he should perform the occasional worship in full detail, particularly / for the sun, the door, the quarter-guardians, the pitcher, Īśāna, Śiva, and the fire.

79.s:
mantrāṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ prāyaścittahomaṃ śarātmanā(2) /
aṣṭottaraśataṃ kṛtvā dadyāt pūrṇāhutiṃ śanaiḥ //
:n
1 ādityadvāradikpālān skandeśānau śive 'nale iti ṅa,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 śarāṇuneti gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
:p 238
79.d:
मन्त्राणां तर्पणं प्रायश्चित्तहोमं शरात्मना(2) /
अष्टोत्तरशतं कृत्वा दद्यात् पूर्णाहुतिं शनैः //
:न्
1 आदित्यद्वारदिक्पालान् स्कन्देशानौ शिवे ऽनले इति ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 शराणुनेति घ, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
:प् 238
79.m:
Having made satisfaction of the mantras and a hundred and eight expiatory fire oblations with the arrow mantra, / he should slowly offer the full oblation.
[Gap in text]
1. 'ādityadvāradikpālān skandeśānau śive 'nale' is the reading of the manuscript marked ṅa.
2. 'śarāṇunā' is the reading of the two manuscripts marked gha and ṅa. / page 238

79.s:
pavitraṃ bhānave datvā samācamya dadīta ca /
dvāramālādidikpālakumbhavardhanikādiṣu //
79.d:
पवित्रं भानवे दत्वा समाचम्य ददीत च /
द्वारमालादिदिक्पालकुम्भवर्धनिकादिषु //
79.m: Having given a sacred thread to the sun and sipped water, he should give [sacred threads] / to the door, the garland, the quarter-guardians, the pitcher, the vardhanī, and the others.

79.s:
sannidhāne tataḥ śambhorupaviśya nijāsane /
pavitramātmane dadyādgaṇāya guruvahnaye //
79.d:
सन्निधाने ततः शम्भोरुपविश्य निजासने /
पवित्रमात्मने दद्याद्गणाय गुरुवह्नये //
79.m: Then, having sat on his own seat near Śambhu, / he should give a sacred thread to the Self, to the host [of attendants], to the guru, and to the fire:

79.s:
oṃ kālātmanā tvayā deva yaddiṣṭaṃ māmake vidhau(1) /
kṛtaṃ kliṣṭaṃ samutsṛṣṭaṃ kṛtaṃ guptañca yatkṛtaṃ //
79.d:
ओं कालात्मना त्वया देव यद्दिष्टं मामके विधौ(1) /
कृतं क्लिष्टं समुत्सृष्टं कृतं गुप्तञ्च यत्कृतं //
79.m: 'Oṃ, O God in the form of Time, whatever in my ritual was pointed out [by you], / whatever was done afflicted, omitted, done secretly, or done [imperfectly],

79.s:
tadastu kliṣṭamakliṣṭaṃ kṛtaṃ kliṣṭamasaṃskṛtaṃ(2) /
sarvātmanāmunā śambho pavitreṇa tvadicchayā //
79.d:
तदस्तु क्लिष्टमक्लिष्टं कृतं क्लिष्टमसंस्कृतं(2) /
सर्वात्मनामुना शम्भो पवित्रेण त्वदिच्छया //
79.m: let that which is afflicted become unafflicted, and what was performed defective and unconsecrated [become complete], / in every way by means of this sacred thread through your will, O Śambhu!'

79.s:
oṃ pūrayamakhavrataṃ niyameśvarāya svāhā /
ātmatattve prakṛtyante pālite padmayoninā //
79.d:
ओं पूरयमखव्रतं नियमेश्वराय स्वाहा /
आत्मतत्त्वे प्रकृत्यन्ते पालिते पद्मयोनिना //
79.m: 'Oṃ, fulfill the vow of the sacrifice! Svāhā to the Lord of Observance!' / In the self-principle ending in nature, protected by the Lotus-born [Brahmā],

79.s:
mūlaṃ layāntamuccārya pavitreṇārcayecchivaṃ /
vidyātattve ca vidyānte viṣṇukāraṇapālite //
79.d:
मूलं लयान्तमुच्चार्य पवित्रेणार्चयेच्छिवं /
विद्यातत्त्वे च विद्यान्ते विष्णुकारणपालिते //
79.m: uttering the basic mantra ending in dissolution, he should worship Śiva with the sacred thread. / And in the knowledge-principle ending in knowledge, protected by Viṣṇu as the cause,

79.s:
īśvarāntaṃ samuccārya pavitramadhiropayet /
śivānte śivatattve ca rudrakāraṇapālite //
79.d:
ईश्वरान्तं समुच्चार्य पवित्रमधिरोपयेत् /
शिवान्ते शिवतत्त्वे च रुद्रकारणपालिते //
79.m: uttering [the mantra] ending in Īśvara, he should mount the sacred thread. / In the Śiva-principle ending in Śiva, protected by Rudra as the cause,

79.s:
śivāntaṃ mantramuccārya tasmai deyaṃ pavitrakaṃ /
sarvakāraṇapāleṣu śivamuccārya suvrataḥ(3) //
79.d:
शिवान्तं मन्त्रमुच्चार्य तस्मै देयं पवित्रकं /
सर्वकारणपालेषु शिवमुच्चार्य सुव्रतः(3) //
79.m: uttering the mantra ending in Śiva, the sacred thread is to be given unto him. / For all the protectors of the causes, uttering 'Śiva', one of good vows,

79.s:
mūlaṃ layāntamuccārya dadyādgaṅgāvatārakaṃ(4) /
ātmavidyāśivaiḥ proktaṃ mumukṣūṇāṃ pavitrakaṃ //
79.d:
मूलं लयान्तमुच्चार्य दद्याद्गङ्गावतारकं(4) /
आत्मविद्याशिवैः प्रोक्तं मुमुक्षूणां पवित्रकं //
79.m: uttering the basic mantra ending in dissolution, should offer the descent of the Gaṅgā. / The sacred thread is declared for those desiring liberation through the Self, knowledge, and Śiva;

79.s:
vinirdiṣṭaṃ bubhukṣūṇāṃ śivatattvātmabhiḥ kramāt /
svāhāntaṃ vā namo 'ntaṃ vā mantrameṣāmudīrayet //
oṃ hāṃ ātmatattvādhipataye śivāya svāhā
:n
1 prabhustvaṃ māmakevidhau iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 hutaṃ yatra vaṣaṭkṛtamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 sarvatattveṣu suvrata iti kha, ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
4 dadyādaṅgāvatārakamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 239
oṃ hāṃ vidyātattvādhipataye śivāya svāhā
oṃ hauṃ śivatattvādhipataye śivāya svāhā
oṃ hauṃ sarvatattvādhipataye śivāya svāhā
79.d:
विनिर्दिष्टं बुभुक्षूणां शिवतत्त्वात्मभिः क्रमात् /
स्वाहान्तं वा नमो ऽन्तं वा मन्त्रमेषामुदीरयेत् //
ओं हां आत्मतत्त्वाधिपतये शिवाय स्वाहा
:न्
1 प्रभुस्त्वं मामकेविधौ इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 हुतं यत्र वषट्कृतमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 सर्वतत्त्वेषु सुव्रत इति ख, ग, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकत्रयपाठः
4 दद्यादङ्गावतारकमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 239
ओं हां विद्यातत्त्वाधिपतये शिवाय स्वाहा
ओं हौं शिवतत्त्वाधिपतये शिवाय स्वाहा
ओं हौं सर्वतत्त्वाधिपतये शिवाय स्वाहा
79.m:
for those desiring worldly enjoyment, it is prescribed in order through Śiva, knowledge, and the Self. / He should pronounce their mantra ending in either svāhā or namaḥ:
'Oṃ hāṃ svāhā to Śiva, the regent of the self-principle!'
[Gap in text]
"You are the Lord in my ritual" is the reading of the manuscript marked ṅa.
"where the offering has been consecrated with vaṣaṭ" is the reading of the manuscript marked ṅa.
"O observant one, regarding all the principles" is the reading of the three manuscripts marked kha, ga, and ṅa.
"He should present the descent of the limbs" is the reading of the manuscript marked kha.
Oṃ hāṃ svāhā to Śiva, the regent of the principle of wisdom.
Oṃ hauṃ svāhā to Śiva, the regent of the principle of Śiva.
Oṃ hauṃ svāhā to Śiva, the regent of all principles.

79.s:
natvā gaṅgāvatārantu prārthayettaṃ kṛtāñjaliḥ /
tvaṅgatiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ saṃsthitistvañcarācare //
79.d:
नत्वा गङ्गावतारन्तु प्रार्थयेत्तं कृताञ्जलिः /
त्वङ्गतिः सर्वभूतानां संस्थितिस्त्वञ्चराचरे //
79.m: Having bowed, one should indeed pray with folded hands to Him who brought down the Gaṅgā: / "You are the refuge of all beings; You are their abode in the moving and unmoving.

79.s:
antaścāreṇa bhūtānāṃ(1) draṣṭā tvaṃ parameśvara /
karmaṇā manasā vācā tvatto nānyā gatirmama //
79.d:
अन्तश्चारेण भूतानां(1) द्रष्टा त्वं परमेश्वर /
कर्मणा मनसा वाचा त्वत्तो नान्या गतिर्मम //
79.m: Moving within all beings, You are their observer, O Supreme Lord! / In deed, mind, and speech, I have no refuge other than You.

79.s:
mantrahīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ dravyahīnañca yat kṛtaṃ /
japahomārcanair hīnaṃ kṛtaṃ nityaṃ mayā tava //
79.d:
मन्त्रहीनं क्रियाहीनं द्रव्यहीनञ्च यत् कृतं /
जपहोमार्चनैर् हीनं कृतं नित्यं मया तव //
79.m: Whatever has been performed devoid of mantras, devoid of ritual actions, and devoid of ritual substances, / and [whatever] has continually been done by me for You devoid of recitation, fire oblations, and worship,

79.s:
akṛtaṃ vākyahīnaṃ ca tat pūraya maheśvaraṃ(2) /
supūtastvaṃ pareśāna(3) pavitraṃ pāpanāśanaṃ //
79.d:
अकृतं वाक्यहीनं च तत् पूरय महेश्वरं(2) /
सुपूतस्त्वं परेशान(3) पवित्रं पापनाशनं //
79.m: or left undone, or defective in spoken word, make that complete, O Maheśvara! / You are exceedingly pure, O Supreme Lord, a sacred purifier destroying sin.

79.s:
tvayā pavitritaṃ sarvaṃ jagat sthāvarajaṅgamaṃ /
khaṇḍitaṃ yanmayā deva vrataṃ vaikalpayogataḥ //
79.d:
त्वया पवित्रितं सर्वं जगत् स्थावरजङ्गमं /
खण्डितं यन्मया देव व्रतं वैकल्पयोगतः //
79.m: By You the entire world, moving and unmoving, has been purified. / Whatever votive observance has been broken by me, O God, due to distraction,

79.s:
ekībhavatu tat sarvaṃ tavājñāsūtragumphitaṃ /
japaṃ nivedya devasya bhaktyā stotraṃ vidhāya ca //
79.d:
एकीभवतु तत् सर्वं तवाज्ञासूत्रगुम्फितं /
जपं निवेद्य देवस्य भक्त्या स्तोत्रं विधाय च //
79.m: may all that become unified, strung together by the thread of Your command!" / Having presented the recitation to the God, and having offered praise with devotion,

79.s:
natvā tu guruṇādiṣṭaṃ gṛhṇīyānniyamannaraḥ /
caturmāsaṃ trimāsaṃ vā tryahamekāhameva ca //
79.d:
नत्वा तु गुरुणादिष्टं गृह्णीयान्नियमन्नरः /
चतुर्मासं त्रिमासं वा त्र्यहमेकाहमेव च //
79.m: and having bowed, a man should undertake the observance instructed by the guru, / for four months, or three months, or three days, or even just one day.

79.s:
praṇamya kṣamayitveśaṃ gatvā kuṇḍāntikaṃ vratī /
pāvakasthe śive 'pyevaṃ pavitrāṇāṃ catuṣṭayaṃ //
79.d:
प्रणम्य क्षमयित्वेशं गत्वा कुण्डान्तिकं व्रती /
पावकस्थे शिवे ऽप्येवं पवित्राणां चतुष्टयं //
79.m: Having bowed and begged forgiveness of the Lord, the votary, going to the vicinity of the fire-pit, / should likewise offer four sacred threads to Śiva residing in the fire,

79.s:
samāropya samabhyarcya puṣpadhūpākṣatādibhiḥ /
antarbaliṃ pavitrañca rudrādibhyo nivedayet //
79.d:
समारोप्य समभ्यर्च्य पुष्पधूपाक्षतादिभिः /
अन्तर्बलिं पवित्रञ्च रुद्रादिभ्यो निवेदयेत् //
79.m: investing [him] and worshipping [him] with flowers, incense, unbroken grains, and the like; / he should offer the internal oblation and the sacred thread to Rudra and the others.

79.s:
praviśyāntaḥ śivaṃ stutvā sapraṇāmaṃ kṣamāpayet /
:n
1 antaś cara tvaṃ bhūtānāmiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 paripūrṇaṃ karo tu me iti ga, cihitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 amṛtastvaṃ pareśāna iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 240
prāyaścittakṛtaṃ homaṃ kṛtvā hutvā ca pāyasaṃ //
79.d:
प्रविश्यान्तः शिवं स्तुत्वा सप्रणामं क्षमापयेत् /
:न्
1 अन्तश् चर त्वं भूतानामिति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 परिपूर्णं करो तु मे इति ग, चिहितपुस्तकपाठः
3 अमृतस्त्वं परेशान इति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 240
प्रायश्चित्तकृतं होमं कृत्वा हुत्वा च पायसं //
79.m:
Having entered inside, having praised Śiva, he should beg his forgiveness with a prostration.
[Gap in text]
"O wanderer within all beings" is the reading of the manuscript marked ga.
"Make it complete for me" is the reading of the manuscript marked ga.
"You are immortal, O Supreme Lord" is the reading of the manuscript marked ga.
Having performed the fire oblation for expiation, and having offered rice boiled in milk,

79.s:
śanaiḥ pūrṇāhutiṃ datvā vahnisthaṃ visṛjecchivaṃ /
homaṃ vyāhṛtibhiḥ kṛtvā rundhyānniṣṭhurayānalaṃ //
79.d:
शनैः पूर्णाहुतिं दत्वा वह्निस्थं विसृजेच्छिवं /
होमं व्याहृतिभिः कृत्वा रुन्ध्यान्निष्ठुरयानलं //
79.m: having slowly given the final oblation, he should discharge Śiva residing in the fire. / Having performed the fire oblation with the mystic utterances, he should restrain the fire with the Niṣṭhurā [mantra].

79.s:
agnyādibhyastato dadyādāhutīnāṃ catuṣṭayaṃ /
dikpatibhyastato dadyāt(1) sapavitraṃ vahirbaliṃ //
79.d:
अग्न्यादिभ्यस्ततो दद्यादाहुतीनां चतुष्टयं /
दिक्पतिभ्यस्ततो दद्यात्(1) सपवित्रं वहिर्बलिं //
79.m: He should then offer four oblations to Agni and the others; / then he should present the external oblation along with the sacred thread to the guardians of the directions.

79.s:
siddhāntapustake dadyāt sapramāṇaṃ pavitrakaṃ /
oṃ hāṃ bhūḥ svāhā / oṃ hāṃ bhuvaḥ svāhā / oṃ hāṃ
svaḥ svāhā / oṃ hāṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ svāhā
homaṃ vyāhṛtibhiḥ kṛtvā datvā.ahuticatuṣṭayaṃ //
oṃ hāṃ agnaye svāhā / oṃ hāṃ somāya svāhā / oṃ hāṃ
agnīṣomābhyāṃ svāhā / oṃ hāṃ agnaye sviṣṭakṛte
svāhā
79.d:
सिद्धान्तपुस्तके दद्यात् सप्रमाणं पवित्रकं /
ओं हां भूः स्वाहा / ओं हां भुवः स्वाहा / ओं हां
स्वः स्वाहा / ओं हां भूर्भुवः स्वः स्वाहा
होमं व्याहृतिभिः कृत्वा दत्वा.अहुतिचतुष्टयं //
ओं हां अग्नये स्वाहा / ओं हां सोमाय स्वाहा / ओं हां
अग्नीषोमाभ्यां स्वाहा / ओं हां अग्नये स्विष्टकृते
स्वाहा
79.m:
He should present the sacred thread of proper size to the Siddhānta book: / "Oṃ hāṃ svāhā to the earth! Oṃ hāṃ svāhā to the atmosphere! Oṃ hāṃ / svāhā to heaven! Oṃ hāṃ svāhā to earth, atmosphere, and heaven!" / Having performed the fire oblation with the mystic utterances and offered the four oblations:
"Oṃ hāṃ svāhā to Agni! Oṃ hāṃ svāhā to Soma! Oṃ hāṃ / svāhā to Agni and Soma! Oṃ hāṃ svāhā to Agni Sviṣṭakṛt!"

79.s:
guruṃ śivamivābhyarcya vastrabhūṣādivistaraiḥ /
samagraṃ saphalaṃ tasya kriyākāṇḍādi vārṣikaṃ //
79.d:
गुरुं शिवमिवाभ्यर्च्य वस्त्रभूषादिविस्तरैः /
समग्रं सफलं तस्य क्रियाकाण्डादि वार्षिकं //
79.m: Having worshipped the guru like Śiva with an abundance of clothes, ornaments, and the like, / the entire annual cycle of ritual action and the rest becomes fruitful for him

79.s:
yasya tuṣṭo guruḥ samyagityāha parameśvaraḥ /
itthaṃ guroḥ samāropya hṛdālambipavitrakaṃ //
79.d:
यस्य तुष्टो गुरुः सम्यगित्याह परमेश्वरः /
इत्थं गुरोः समारोप्य हृदालम्बिपवित्रकं //
79.m: with whom the guru is fully satisfied; thus spoke the Supreme Lord. / Thus having invested the guru with the sacred thread that hangs to the heart,

79.s:
dvijātīn bhojayitvā tu bhaktyā vastrādikaṃ dadet /
dānenānena deveśa prīyatāṃ me sadā śivaḥ //
79.d:
द्विजातीन् भोजयित्वा तु भक्त्या वस्त्रादिकं ददेत् /
दानेनानेन देवेश प्रीयतां मे सदा शिवः //
79.m: having fed the twice-born, he should offer clothes and the like with devotion: / "By this gift, O Lord of gods, may Śiva ever be pleased with me."

79.s:
bhaktyā snānādikaṃ prātaḥ kṛtvā śambhoḥ samāharet /
pavitrāṇyaṣṭapuṣpaistaṃ pūjayitvā visarjayet //
79.d:
भक्त्या स्नानादिकं प्रातः कृत्वा शम्भोः समाहरेत् /
पवित्राण्यष्टपुष्पैस्तं पूजयित्वा विसर्जयेत् //
79.m: Having performed bathing and other rites in the morning with devotion, he should remove [the offerings] from Śambhu; / having worshipped him with the eight flowers, he should dismiss the sacred threads.

79.s:
nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kṛtvā vistareṇa yathā purā /
pavitrāṇi samāropya praṇamyāgnau śivaṃ yajet //
79.d:
नित्यं नैमित्तिकं कृत्वा विस्तरेण यथा पुरा /
पवित्राणि समारोप्य प्रणम्याग्नौ शिवं यजेत् //
79.m: Having performed the regular and occasional rites in detail as before, / having invested the sacred threads and bowed, he should worship Śiva in the fire.

79.s:
prāyaścittaṃ tato 'streṇa hutvā(2) pūrṇāhutiṃ yajet /
:n
1 dikpālebhyastato datveti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 tato 'streṇa kṛtveti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 241
bhuktikāmaḥ śivāyātha kuryāt karmasamarpaṇaṃ //
79.d:
प्रायश्चित्तं ततो ऽस्त्रेण हुत्वा(2) पूर्णाहुतिं यजेत् /
:न्
1 दिक्पालेभ्यस्ततो दत्वेति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 ततो ऽस्त्रेण कृत्वेति घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 241
भुक्तिकामः शिवायाथ कुर्यात् कर्मसमर्पणं //
79.m:
Then, having offered expiation with the Astra [mantra], he should offer the final oblation.
[Gap in text]
"having then given to the guardians of the directions" is the reading of the manuscript marked kha.
"having then performed with the Astra [mantra]" is the reading of the manuscript marked gha.
One who desires worldly enjoyment should then make an offering of the ritual action to Śiva:

79.s:
tvatprasādena karmedaṃ māstu phalasādhakaṃ /
muktikāmastu karmedaṃ māstu me nātha bandhakaṃ //
79.d:
त्वत्प्रसादेन कर्मेदं मास्तु फलसाधकं /
मुक्तिकामस्तु कर्मेदं मास्तु मे नाथ बन्धकं //
79.m: "By Your grace, may not this ritual action become a producer of results [for me]!" / But one who desires liberation [should say]: "O Lord, may not this ritual action bind me!"

79.s:
vahnisthaṃ nāḍīyogena śivaṃ saṃyojayechive /
hṛdi nyasyāgnisaṅghātaṃ pāvakaṃ ca visarjayet //
79.d:
वह्निस्थं नाडीयोगेन शिवं संयोजयेछिवे /
हृदि न्यस्याग्निसङ्घातं पावकं च विसर्जयेत् //
79.m: Through the channel of the subtle veins, he should unite Śiva residing in the fire with Śiva [within]. / Having placed the collection of fires in the heart, he should dismiss the fire.

79.s:
samācamya praviśyāntaḥ kumbhānugatasaṃvarān /
śive saṃyojya sākṣepaṃ kṣamasveti visarjayet //
79.d:
समाचम्य प्रविश्यान्तः कुम्भानुगतसंवरान् /
शिवे संयोज्य साक्षेपं क्षमस्वेति विसर्जयेत् //
79.m: Having sipped water and entered inside, having united the protective deities accompanying the water-pot / into Śiva, he should dismiss [him] respectfully, saying, "Forgive me."

79.s:
visṛjya lokapālādīnādāyeśāt pavitrakaṃ /
sati caṇḍeśvare pūjāṃ kṛtvā datvā pavitrakaṃ //
79.d:
विसृज्य लोकपालादीनादायेशात् पवित्रकं /
सति चण्डेश्वरे पूजां कृत्वा दत्वा पवित्रकं //
79.m: Having dismissed the world-protectors and the others, and having taken the sacred thread from the Lord, / if Caṇḍeśvara is present, having performed worship and given the sacred thread,

79.s:
tannirmālyādikaṃ tasmai sapavitraṃ samarpayet /
athavā sthaṇḍile caṇḍaṃ vidhinā pūrvavadyajet //
79.d:
तन्निर्माल्यादिकं तस्मै सपवित्रं समर्पयेत् /
अथवा स्थण्डिले चण्डं विधिना पूर्ववद्यजेत् //
79.m: he should offer him the remains of the offering together with the sacred thread; / or else he should worship Caṇḍa on a bare mound of earth according to the rule as before:

79.s:
yat kiñcidvārṣikaṃ karma kṛtaṃ nyūnādhikaṃ mayā /
tadastu paripūrṇaṃ me caṇḍa nātha tavājñayā //
79.d:
यत् किञ्चिद्वार्षिकं कर्म कृतं न्यूनाधिकं मया /
तदस्तु परिपूर्णं मे चण्ड नाथ तवाज्ञया //
79.m: "Whatever annual ritual action has been performed by me, deficient or excessive, / may that be made complete for me, O Lord Caṇḍa, by your command!"

79.s:
iti vijñāpya deveśaṃ natvā stutvā visarjayet /
tyaktanirmālyakaḥ śuddhaḥ snāpayitvā śivaṃ yajet /
pañcayojanasaṃstho 'pi pavitraṃ gurusannidhau //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye pavitrārohaṇaṃ nāma ekonāśītitamo
'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha aśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
damanakārohaṇavidhiḥ
79.d:
इति विज्ञाप्य देवेशं नत्वा स्तुत्वा विसर्जयेत् /
त्यक्तनिर्माल्यकः शुद्धः स्नापयित्वा शिवं यजेत् /
पञ्चयोजनसंस्थो ऽपि पवित्रं गुरुसन्निधौ //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये पवित्रारोहणं नाम एकोनाशीतितमो
ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ अशीतितमो ऽध्यायः
दमनकारोहणविधिः
79.m:
Having thus petitioned the Lord of gods, having bowed and praised him, he should dismiss him. / Having discarded the remains of the offering, purified, having bathed, he should worship Śiva. / Even if he resides five yojanas away, [he should present] the sacred thread in the presence of the guru.
Thus ends the seventy-ninth chapter, named "Investiture with the Sacred Thread," in the venerable and primal Mahāpurāṇa composed by Agni.
Now, the eightieth chapter.
The procedure for the investiture with the damanaka plant.

80.s:
īśvara uvāca
vakṣye damanakārohavidhiṃ pūrvavadācaret /
harakopāt purā jāto bhairavo damitāḥ surāḥ //
:p 242
80.d:
ईश्वर उवाच
वक्ष्ये दमनकारोहविधिं पूर्ववदाचरेत् /
हरकोपात् पुरा जातो भैरवो दमिताः सुराः //
:प् 242
80.m:
The Lord said: / I shall declare the rite of investiture with the damanaka plant; one should perform it as before. / In ancient times, Bhairava was born from Hara's wrath, and the gods were subdued.
page 242

80.s:
tenātha śapto viṭapo bhaveti tripurāriṇā /
prasanneneritaṃ cedaṃ pūjayiṣyanti ye narāḥ //
80.d:
तेनाथ शप्तो विटपो भवेति त्रिपुरारिणा /
प्रसन्नेनेरितं चेदं पूजयिष्यन्ति ये नराः //
80.m: Then he was cursed by the foe of Tripura, "Become a shrub!" / And this was spoken [by the Lord] when he was pacified: "Those men who will worship [it],

80.s:
paripūrṇaphalaṃ teṣāṃ nānyathā te bhaviṣyati /
saptamyāṃ vā trayodaśyāṃ damanaṃ saṃhitātmabhiḥ //
80.d:
परिपूर्णफलं तेषां नान्यथा ते भविष्यति /
सप्तम्यां वा त्रयोदश्यां दमनं संहितात्मभिः //
80.m: their reward shall be complete; it shall not be otherwise for you." / On the seventh or on the thirteenth [lunar day], by those established in the Saṃhitā,

80.s:
sampūjya bodhayedvṛkṣaṃ bhavavākyena mantravit /
haraprasādasaṃbhūta tvamatra sannidhībhava //
80.d:
सम्पूज्य बोधयेद्वृक्षं भववाक्येन मन्त्रवित् /
हरप्रसादसंभूत त्वमत्र सन्निधीभव //
80.m: the tree, having been worshipped, should be awakened with the word of Bhava by one who knows the mantras: / "Born of the grace of Hara, be present here!

80.s:
śivakāryaṃ samuddiśya netavyo 'si śivājñayā /
gṛhe 'pyāmantraṇaṃ kuryāt sāyāhne cādhivāsanaṃ //
80.d:
शिवकार्यं समुद्दिश्य नेतव्यो ऽसि शिवाज्ञया /
गृहे ऽप्यामन्त्रणं कुर्यात् सायाह्ने चाधिवासनं //
80.m: Having in mind the service of Śiva, you are to be taken by the command of Śiva." / One should also perform the invitation at home, and the preliminary consecration in the evening.

80.s:
yathāvidhi samabhyarcya sūryaśaṅkarapāvakān /
devasya paścime mūlaṃ dadyāttasya mṛdā yutaṃ //
80.d:
यथाविधि समभ्यर्च्य सूर्यशङ्करपावकान् /
देवस्य पश्चिमे मूलं दद्यात्तस्य मृदा युतं //
80.m: Having duly worshipped the Sun, Śaṅkara, and the fire, / one should place its root along with soil to the west of the God,

80.s:
vāmena śirasā vātha nālaṃ dhātrīṃ tathottare /
dakṣiṇe bhagnapatrañca prācyāṃ puṣpañca dhāraṇaṃ //
80.d:
वामेन शिरसा वाथ नालं धात्रीं तथोत्तरे /
दक्षिणे भग्नपत्रञ्च प्राच्यां पुष्पञ्च धारणं //
80.m: or the stalk to the left or on the head, the Earth to the north, / the broken leaf to the south, and the holding of the flower to the east,

80.s:
puṭikāsthaṃ phalaṃ mūlamathaiśānyāṃ yajecchivaṃ /
pañcāṅgamañjalau kṛtvā āmantrya śirasi nyaset //
80.d:
पुटिकास्थं फलं मूलमथैशान्यां यजेच्छिवं /
पञ्चाङ्गमञ्जलौ कृत्वा आमन्त्र्य शिरसि न्यसेत् //
80.m: and the fruit and root placed in a receptacle to the northeast; then he should worship Śiva. / Having placed the five limbs into the folded hands and recited the invitation, he should place it on the head:

80.s:
āmantrito 'si deveśa prātaḥkāle(1) mayā prabho /
kartavyastapaso lābhaḥ pūrṇaṃ sarvaṃ tavājñayā //
80.d:
आमन्त्रितो ऽसि देवेश प्रातःकाले(1) मया प्रभो /
कर्तव्यस्तपसो लाभः पूर्णं सर्वं तवाज्ञया //
80.m: "You have been invited, O Lord of gods, in the morning by me, O Lord! / The attainment of ascetic austerity must be performed; everything is complete by Your command."

80.s:
mūlena śeṣaṃ pātrasthaṃ pidhāyātha pavitrakaṃ /
prātaḥ snātvā jagannāthaṃ gandhapuṣpādibhiryajet(2) //
80.d:
मूलेन शेषं पात्रस्थं पिधायाथ पवित्रकं /
प्रातः स्नात्वा जगन्नाथं गन्धपुष्पादिभिर्यजेत्(2) //
80.m: Having covered the remainder of the sacred thread resting in the vessel with the root mantra, / having bathed in the morning, he should worship the Lord of the world with fragrant paste, flowers, and the like.

80.s:
nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kṛtvā damanaiḥ pūjayettataḥ /
śeṣamañjalimādāya ātmavidyāśivātmabhiḥ //
80.d:
नित्यं नैमित्तिकं कृत्वा दमनैः पूजयेत्ततः /
शेषमञ्जलिमादाय आत्मविद्याशिवात्मभिः //
80.m: Having performed the daily and occasional rites, he should then worship with damanaka [leaves]. / Taking up the remaining handful [of flowers], with the [mantras] of the nature of ātman, vidyā, and Śiva,

80.s:
mūlādyair īśvarāntaiś ca caturthāñjalinā tataḥ /
oṃ hauṃ makheśvarāya makhaṃ pūraya śūlapāṇaye namaḥ //
:n
1 deveśa pūjākāle iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 gandhapuṣpādinārcayediti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 243
śivaṃ vahniṃ ca sampūjya guruṃ prārcyātha bodhayet //
80.d:
मूलाद्यैर् ईश्वरान्तैश् च चतुर्थाञ्जलिना ततः /
ओं हौं मखेश्वराय मखं पूरय शूलपाणये नमः //
:न्
1 देवेश पूजाकाले इति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 गन्धपुष्पादिनार्चयेदिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 243
शिवं वह्निं च सम्पूज्य गुरुं प्रार्च्याथ बोधयेत् //
80.m:
beginning with the root mantra and ending with Īśvara, with a fourth handful [he should recite]: / 'Oṃ hauṃ, to the Lord of sacrifice! Fulfill the sacrifice, homage to the trident-bearer!'
:n
1 'deveśa pūjākāle' is the reading in manuscript ga
2 'gandhapuṣpādinārcayet' is the reading in manuscript kha / :p 243
Having worshipped Śiva and Agni, and having worshipped the guru, he should then awaken [the deity]:

80.s:
bhagavannatiriktaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā yanmayā kṛtaṃ /
sarvaṃ tadastu sampūrṇaṃ yacca dāmanakaṃ mama /
sakalaṃ caitramāsotthaṃ phalaṃ prāpya divaṃ vrajet //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye damanakārohaṇavidhirnāma aśītitamo
'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś athaikāśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
samayadīkṣāvidhānaṃ
80.d:
भगवन्नतिरिक्तं वा हीनं वा यन्मया कृतं /
सर्वं तदस्तु सम्पूर्णं यच्च दामनकं मम /
सकलं चैत्रमासोत्थं फलं प्राप्य दिवं व्रजेत् //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये दमनकारोहणविधिर्नाम अशीतितमो
ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथैकाशीतितमो ऽध्यायः
समयदीक्षाविधानं
80.m:
"O Lord, whatever was done by me in excess or deficient, / may all that be complete, as well as my damanaka offering. / Having obtained the entire fruit arising from the month of Caitra, may one go to heaven."
:e Thus ends the eightieth chapter, entitled 'The Procedure for Offering Damanaka', in the ancient Great Purāṇa of Agni.
:ś Now the eighty-first chapter.
The Procedure for Probationary Initiation

81.s:
īśvara uvāca
vākṣyāmi bhogamokṣārthaṃ dīkṣāṃ pāpakṣayaṅkarīṃ /
malamāyādipāśānāṃ viśleṣaḥ kriyate yayā //
81.d:
ईश्वर उवाच
वाक्ष्यामि भोगमोक्षार्थं दीक्षां पापक्षयङ्करीं /
मलमायादिपाशानां विश्लेषः क्रियते यया //
81.m: Īśvara said: / I shall declare initiation, which brings about the destruction of sin, for the purpose of worldly enjoyment and liberation, / by which the separation of the fetters of impurity, māyā, and the rest is effected,

81.s:
jñānañca janyate śiṣye sā dīkṣā bhuktimuktidā /
vijñātakalanāmaiko dvitīyaḥ pralayākalaḥ(1) //
81.d:
ज्ञानञ्च जन्यते शिष्ये सा दीक्षा भुक्तिमुक्तिदा /
विज्ञातकलनामैको द्वितीयः प्रलयाकलः(1) //
81.m: and knowledge is produced in the disciple. That initiation bestows worldly enjoyment and liberation. / One [class of souls] is called vijñānākala, the second is the pralayākala,

81.s:
tṛtīyaḥ sakalaḥ śāstre 'nugrāhyastrividho mataḥ /
tatrādyo malamātreṇa mukto 'nyo malakarmabhiḥ //
81.d:
तृतीयः सकलः शास्त्रे ऽनुग्राह्यस्त्रिविधो मतः /
तत्राद्यो मलमात्रेण मुक्तो ऽन्यो मलकर्मभिः //
81.m: and the third is the sakala; in the scripture, the recipient of grace is considered threefold. / Among these, the first is freed merely by [the removal of] impurity; the other by [the removal of] impurity and karma.

81.s:
kalādibhūmiparyantaṃ stavaistu sakalo yataḥ /
nirādhārātha sādhārā dīkṣāpi dvividhā matā //
81.d:
कलादिभूमिपर्यन्तं स्तवैस्तु सकलो यतः /
निराधाराथ साधारा दीक्षापि द्विविधा मता //
81.m: Since the sakala is [bound] up to the realm of kalā and the rest, [initiation is taught] by praises. / Initiation is also considered twofold: unsupported (nirādhārā) and supported (sādhārā).

81.s:
nirādhārā dvayosteṣāṃ sādhārā sakalasya tu /
ādhāranirapekṣeṇa kriyate śambhucaryayā //
81.d:
निराधारा द्वयोस्तेषां साधारा सकलस्य तु /
आधारनिरपेक्षेण क्रियते शम्भुचर्यया //
81.m: The unsupported is for two of them, but the supported is for the sakala. / Performed without dependence upon a support, through the conduct of Śambhu,

81.s:
tīvraśaktinipātena nirādhāreti sā smṛtā /
ācāryamūrtimāsthāya māyātīvrādibhedayā //
81.d:
तीव्रशक्तिनिपातेन निराधारेति सा स्मृता /
आचार्यमूर्तिमास्थाय मायातीव्रादिभेदया //
81.m: by the descent of intense power (śaktinipāta), it is known as unsupported. / But that which Śambhu performs by taking the form of the teacher, through the distinctions of māyā, intense power, and so forth,

81.s:
śaktyā yāṃ kurute śambhuḥ sā sādhikaraṇocyate /
:n
1 pralayānala iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / pralayātmaka iti ṅa,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 244
iyaṃ caturvidhā proktā savījā vījavarjitā //
81.d:
शक्त्या यां कुरुते शम्भुः सा साधिकरणोच्यते /
:न्
1 प्रलयानल इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / प्रलयात्मक इति ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 244
इयं चतुर्विधा प्रोक्ता सवीजा वीजवर्जिता //
81.m:
by means of His power, is called supported (sādhikaraṇā).
:n
1 'pralayānala' is the reading in manuscript kha; 'pralayātmaka' is the reading in manuscript ṅa / :p 244
This is declared to be fourfold: with seed (savījā) and seedless (vījavarjitā),

81.s:
sādhikārānadhikārā yathā tadabhidhīyate /
samayācārasaṃyuktā savījā jāyate nṛṇāṃ //
81.d:
साधिकारानधिकारा यथा तदभिधीयते /
समयाचारसंयुक्ता सवीजा जायते नृणां //
81.m: with qualification (sādhikārā) and without qualification (anadhikārā). That is now explained: / [Initiation] endowed with conventional observances (samayācāra) is 'with seed' for men;

81.s:
nirvījā tvasamarthānāṃ samayācāravarjitā /
nitye naimittike kāmye yataḥ syādadhikāritā //
81.d:
निर्वीजा त्वसमर्थानां समयाचारवर्जिता /
नित्ये नैमित्तिके काम्ये यतः स्यादधिकारिता //
81.m: the 'seedless' is for the incapable, being devoid of conventional observances. / Since eligibility exists with respect to daily, occasional, and optional rites,

81.s:
sādhikārā bhaveddīkṣā sādhakācāryayorataḥ /
nirvījā dīkṣitānāntu yadāsa mama putrayoḥ //
81.d:
साधिकारा भवेद्दीक्षा साधकाचार्ययोरतः /
निर्वीजा दीक्षितानान्तु यदास मम पुत्रयोः //
81.m: initiation is 'with qualification' for the practitioner (sādhaka) and the teacher (ācārya). Therefore, / when it occurred for those initiated without seed, as for my two sons,

81.s:
nityamātrādhikāratvaddīkṣā niradhikārikā /
dvividheyaṃ dvirūpā hi pratyekamupajāyate //
81.d:
नित्यमात्राधिकारत्वद्दीक्षा निरधिकारिका /
द्विविधेयं द्विरूपा हि प्रत्येकमुपजायते //
81.m: due to eligibility only for daily rites, initiation is 'without qualification'. / This [initiation] is twofold, and indeed each manifests in two forms.

81.s:
ekā kriyāvatī tatra kuṇḍamaṇḍalapūrvikā /
manovyāpāramātreṇa yā sā jñānavatī matā //
81.d:
एका क्रियावती तत्र कुण्डमण्डलपूर्विका /
मनोव्यापारमात्रेण या सा ज्ञानवती मता //
81.m: One of them is ritual-based (kriyāvatī), preceded by [rites at] the fire-pit and maṇḍala; / that which is performed merely by mental operation is considered knowledge-based (jñānavatī).

81.s:
itthaṃ labdhādhikāreṇa dīkṣā.acāryeṇa sādhyate /
skandadīkṣāṃ guruḥ kuryāt kṛtvā nityakriyāṃ tataḥ(1) //
81.d:
इत्थं लब्धाधिकारेण दीक्षा.अचार्येण साध्यते /
स्कन्ददीक्षां गुरुः कुर्यात् कृत्वा नित्यक्रियां ततः(1) //
81.m: Thus, initiation is performed by the teacher who has obtained authority. / The guru should perform Skanda's initiation, having then completed the daily rites.

81.s:
praṇavārgyakarāmbhojakṛtadvārādhipārcaṇaḥ /
vighnānutsārya dehalyāṃ nyasyāstraṃ svāsane sthitaḥ //
81.d:
प्रणवार्ग्यकराम्भोजकृतद्वाराधिपार्चणः /
विघ्नानुत्सार्य देहल्यां न्यस्यास्त्रं स्वासने स्थितः //
81.m: Having worshipped the guardians of the door with water offering from the hollow of his hands joined with the praṇava, / and having dispelled obstacles and deposited the astra mantra on the threshold, seated on his seat,

81.s:
kurvīta bhūtasaṃśuddhiṃ mantrayogaṃ yathoditaṃ /
tilataṇḍulasiddhārthakuśadūrvākṣatodakaṃ //
81.d:
कुर्वीत भूतसंशुद्धिं मन्त्रयोगं यथोदितं /
तिलतण्डुलसिद्धार्थकुशदूर्वाक्षतोदकं //
81.m: he should perform the purification of the elements and the application of mantras as prescribed: / water with sesamum, husked rice, white mustard, kuśa grass, dūrvā grass, and unhusked rice,

81.s:
sayavakṣīranīrañca viśeṣārghyamidantataḥ /
tadambunā dravyaśuddhiṃ tilakaṃ svāsanātmanoḥ //
81.d:
सयवक्षीरनीरञ्च विशेषार्घ्यमिदन्ततः /
तदम्बुना द्रव्यशुद्धिं तिलकं स्वासनात्मनोः //
81.m: together with barley, milk, and water—this is then the special water offering. / With that water, he performs the purification of articles, marks the forehead of his seat and himself,

81.s:
pūjanaṃ mantraśiddhiñca pañcagavyañca pūrvavat /
lājacandanasiddhārthabhasmadūrvākṣataṃ(2) kuśān //
81.d:
पूजनं मन्त्रशिद्धिञ्च पञ्चगव्यञ्च पूर्ववत् /
लाजचन्दनसिद्धार्थभस्मदूर्वाक्षतं(2) कुशान् //
81.m: the worship, the perfection of mantras, and [the preparation of] the five products of the cow as before: / parched grains, sandalwood, white mustard, ashes, dūrvā, unhusked rice, and kuśa grasses.

81.s:
vikirān śuddhalājāṃstān sadhūpānastramantritān /
:n
1 kṛtanityakriyādvaya iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 bhasmadūrvākṣatāniti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 245
śastrāmbu(1)prokṣitānetān kavacenāvaguṇṭhitān //
81.d:
विकिरान् शुद्धलाजांस्तान् सधूपानस्त्रमन्त्रितान् /
:न्
1 कृतनित्यक्रियाद्वय इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 भस्मदूर्वाक्षतानिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 245
शस्त्राम्बु(1)प्रोक्षितानेतान् कवचेनावगुण्ठितान् //
81.m:
The scattering materials (vikira)—pure parched grains, fumigated with incense and consecrated with the astra mantra,
:n
1 'kṛtanityakriyādvaya' is the reading in manuscript kha
2 'bhasmadūrvākṣatān' is the reading in manuscript ṅa / :p 245
sprinkled with weapon-water, and veiled with the kavaca mantra—

81.s:
nānāgrahaṇākārān vighnaughavinivārakān /
darbhāṇāntālamānena kṛtvā ṣaṭtriṃśatā dalaiḥ //
81.d:
नानाग्रहणाकारान् विघ्नौघविनिवारकान् /
दर्भाणान्तालमानेन कृत्वा षट्त्रिंशता दलैः //
81.m: are of diverse graspable forms and dispel the multitude of obstacles. / Having made, to the measure of a span with thirty-six stalks of darbha grass,

81.s:
saptajaptaṃ śivāstreṇa veṇīṃ bodhāsimuttamaṃ /
śivamātmani vinyasya sṛṣṭyādhāramabhīpsitaṃ //
81.d:
सप्तजप्तं शिवास्त्रेण वेणीं बोधासिमुत्तमं /
शिवमात्मनि विन्यस्य सृष्ट्याधारमभीप्सितं //
81.m: a braid consecrated seven times with the weapon of Śiva, the excellent sword of consciousness, / and having deposited Śiva within himself, the desired support of creation,

81.s:
niṣkalaṃ ca śivaṃ nyasya śivo 'hamiti bhāvayet /
uṣṇīṣaṃ śirasi nyasya alaṃ kuryātsvadehakaṃ //
81.d:
निष्कलं च शिवं न्यस्य शिवो ऽहमिति भावयेत् /
उष्णीषं शिरसि न्यस्य अलं कुर्यात्स्वदेहकं //
81.m: and having deposited partless Śiva, he should meditate: 'I am Śiva.' / Having deposited the turban on his head, he should adorn his body.

81.s:
gandhamaṇḍanakaṃ svīye vidadhyāddakṣiṇe kare /
vidhinātrārcayedīśamitthaṃ syācchivamastakaṃ //
81.d:
गन्धमण्डनकं स्वीये विदध्याद्दक्षिणे करे /
विधिनात्रार्चयेदीशमित्थं स्याच्छिवमस्तकं //
81.m: He should place a fragrant adornment in his right hand. / He should worship the Lord here according to rule; thus it should be Śiva's head.

81.s:
vinyasya śivamantreṇa bhāsvaraṃ nijamastake /
śivādabhinnamātmānaṃ kartāraṃ bhāvayedyathā //
81.d:
विन्यस्य शिवमन्त्रेण भास्वरं निजमस्तके /
शिवादभिन्नमात्मानं कर्तारं भावयेद्यथा //
81.m: Having deposited the radiant [deity] on his own head with the mantra of Śiva, / he should meditate on himself as the agent non-different from Śiva, so that

81.s:
maṇḍale karmaṇāṃ sākṣī kalaśe yajñarakṣakaḥ /
homādhikaraṇaṃ vahnau śiṣye pāśavimocakaḥ(2) //
81.d:
मण्डले कर्मणां साक्षी कलशे यज्ञरक्षकः /
होमाधिकरणं वह्नौ शिष्ये पाशविमोचकः(2) //
81.m: he is the witness of actions in the maṇḍala, the protector of the rite in the water-pot, / the substratum of oblations in the fire, the releaser from fetters in the disciple,

81.s:
svātmanyanugṛhīteti ṣaḍādhāro ya īśvaraḥ /
so 'hameveti kurvīta bhāvaṃ sthirataraṃ punaḥ //
81.d:
स्वात्मन्यनुगृहीतेति षडाधारो य ईश्वरः /
सो ऽहमेवेति कुर्वीत भावं स्थिरतरं पुनः //
81.m: and the recipient of grace within himself. The Lord who has six supports— / he should again make very firm the conviction: 'I indeed am He.'

81.s:
jñānakhaḍgakaraḥ sthitvā nairṛtyābhimukho naraḥ /
sārghyāmbupañcagavyābhyāṃ prokṣayedyāgamaṇḍapaṃ //
81.d:
ज्ञानखड्गकरः स्थित्वा नैरृत्याभिमुखो नरः /
सार्घ्याम्बुपञ्चगव्याभ्यां प्रोक्षयेद्यागमण्डपं //
81.m: Holding the sword of knowledge in his hand, facing the south-west, / a man should sprinkle the sacrificial pavilion with the water offering and the five products of the cow.

81.s:
catuṣpathāntasaṃskāraiḥ saṃskuryādīkṣaṇādibhiḥ /
vikṣipya vikarāṃstatra kuśakūrcopasaṃharet //
81.d:
चतुष्पथान्तसंस्कारैः संस्कुर्यादीक्षणादिभिः /
विक्षिप्य विकरांस्तत्र कुशकूर्चोपसंहरेत् //
81.m: He should consecrate it with consecrations up to the crossroad, such as gazing and the rest. / Having scattered the scattering materials there, he should gather them with a kuśa bundle.

81.s:
tānīśadiśi vardhanyāmāsanāyopakalpayet /
nairṛte vāstugīrvāṇān dvāre lakṣmīṃ prapūjayet //
81.d:
तानीशदिशि वर्धन्यामासनायोपकल्पयेत् /
नैरृते वास्तुगीर्वाणान् द्वारे लक्ष्मीं प्रपूजयेत् //
81.m: He should place them in the north-eastern direction in the vardhanī vessel for a seat. / In the south-west he should worship the deities of the site architecture, and Lakṣmī at the door.

81.s:
āpye ratnaiḥ pūrayantīṃ hṛdā maṇḍaparūpiṇīṃ /
:n
1 astrāmbu iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 śiṣye pāpavimocaka iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 246
sāmbuvastre saratne ca dhānyasthe paścimānane //
81.d:
आप्ये रत्नैः पूरयन्तीं हृदा मण्डपरूपिणीं /
:न्
1 अस्त्राम्बु इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 शिष्ये पापविमोचक इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 246
साम्बुवस्त्रे सरत्ने च धान्यस्थे पश्चिमानने //
81.m:
In the western [direction], with the heart mantra, [he worships her who is] filling with jewels and has the form of the pavilion,
:n
1 'astrāmbu' is the reading in manuscript ṅa / 2 'śiṣye pāpavimocakaḥ' is the reading in manuscript ṅa / :p 246
with water and cloth, with jewels, placed on grain, facing the west.

81.s:
aiśe kumbhe yajecchambhuṃ śaktiṃ kumbhasya dakṣiṇe /
paścimasyāntu siṃhasthāṃ vardhanīṃ khaḍgarūpiṇīṃ //
81.d:
ऐशे कुम्भे यजेच्छम्भुं शक्तिं कुम्भस्य दक्षिणे /
पश्चिमस्यान्तु सिंहस्थां वर्धनीं खड्गरूपिणीं //
81.m: In the north-eastern jar he should worship Śambhu, and the Śakti to the right of the jar, / and in the western direction the vardhanī vessel seated on a lion, having the form of a sword.

81.s:
dikṣu śakrādidikpālānviṣṇvantān praṇavāsanān /
vāhanāyudhasaṃyuktān hṛdābhyarcya svanāmabhiḥ //
81.d:
दिक्षु शक्रादिदिक्पालान्विष्ण्वन्तान् प्रणवासनान् /
वाहनायुधसंयुक्तान् हृदाभ्यर्च्य स्वनामभिः //
81.m: In the directions, [he should worship] the guardians of the directions beginning with Śakra and ending with Viṣṇu, seated on the praṇava, / equipped with vehicles and weapons, with the heart mantra and with their own names.

81.s:
prathamantāṃ samādāya kumbhasyāgrābhigāminīṃ /
avicchinnapayodharāṃ bhrāmayitvā pradakṣiṇaṃ //
81.d:
प्रथमन्तां समादाय कुम्भस्याग्राभिगामिनीं /
अविच्छिन्नपयोधरां भ्रामयित्वा प्रदक्षिणं //
81.m: First taking that [vardhanī vessel] which moves in front of the jar, / having circumambulated sunwise while pouring an unbroken stream of water,

81.s:
śivājñāṃ lokapālānāṃ śrāvayenmūlamuccaran /
saṃrakṣata yathāyogaṃ kumbhaṃ dhṛtvātha tāṃ dhāret //
81.d:
शिवाज्ञां लोकपालानां श्रावयेन्मूलमुच्चरन् /
संरक्षत यथायोगं कुम्भं धृत्वाथ तां धारेत् //
81.m: he should proclaim the command of Śiva to the world-guardians while uttering the root mantra: / 'Protect [the rite] appropriately!' Then, holding the jar, he should hold that [vessel].

81.s:
tataḥ sthirāsane kumbhe sāṅgaṃ sampūjya śaṅkaraṃ /
vinyasya śodhyamadhvānaṃ vardhanyāmastramarcayet //
oṃ haḥ astrāsanāya hūṃ phaṭ / oṃ oṃ astramūrtaye namaḥ /
oṃ hūṃ phaṭ pāśupatāstrāya namaḥ / oṃ oṃ hṛdayāya
hūṃ phaṭ namaḥ / oṃ śrīṃ śirase hūṃ phaṭ namaḥ / oṃ
yaṃ śikhāyai hūṃ phaṭ namaḥ / oṃ gūṃ kavacāya hūṃ
phaṭ namaḥ / oṃ phaṭ astrāya hūṃ phaṭ namaḥ(1)
81.d:
ततः स्थिरासने कुम्भे साङ्गं सम्पूज्य शङ्करं /
विन्यस्य शोध्यमध्वानं वर्धन्यामस्त्रमर्चयेत् //
ओं हः अस्त्रासनाय हूं फट् / ओं ओं अस्त्रमूर्तये नमः /
ओं हूं फट् पाशुपतास्त्राय नमः / ओं ओं हृदयाय
हूं फट् नमः / ओं श्रीं शिरसे हूं फट् नमः / ओं
यं शिखायै हूं फट् नमः / ओं गूं कवचाय हूं
फट् नमः / ओं फट् अस्त्राय हूं फट् नमः(1)
81.m:
Then, having worshipped Śaṅkara with His limbs on the firmly established jar, / and having deposited the path to be purified, he should worship the weapon in the vardhanī vessel:
'Oṃ haḥ, to the seat of the weapon, hūṃ phaṭ! Oṃ oṃ, homage to the icon of the weapon!'
'Oṃ hūṃ phaṭ, homage to the Pāśupata weapon! Oṃ oṃ, to the heart, hūṃ phaṭ namaḥ! Oṃ śrīṃ, to the head, hūṃ phaṭ namaḥ! Oṃ yaṃ, to the topknot, hūṃ phaṭ namaḥ! Oṃ gūṃ, to the armour, hūṃ'
'phaṭ namaḥ! Oṃ phaṭ, to the weapon, hūṃ phaṭ namaḥ!'

81.s:
caturvaktraṃ sadaṃṣṭrañca smaredastraṃ saśaktikaṃ /
samudgaratriśūlāsiṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabhaṃ //
81.d:
चतुर्वक्त्रं सदंष्ट्रञ्च स्मरेदस्त्रं सशक्तिकं /
समुद्गरत्रिशूलासिं सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभं //
81.m: He should meditate on the weapon with four faces and fangs, accompanied by Śakti, / equipped with a club, a trident, and a sword, with splendour equal to ten million suns.

81.s:
bhagaliṅgasamāyogaṃ vidadhyālliṅgamudrayā /
:n
1 oṃ aṃ haḥ astrāsanāya hraṃ phaṭ / oṃ aṃ astramūrtaye
namaḥ / oṃ paśūṃ huṃ phaṭ pāśupatāstrāya namaḥ / oṃ
hṛdayāya hraṃ phaṭ namaḥ / oṃ śrīṃ śirase hrūṃ phaṭ
namaḥ / oṃ maṃ śikhāyai phaṭ namaḥ / oṃ astrāya phaṭ
hūṃ phaṭ namaḥ / iti ga, cihnkitapustakapāṭhaḥ / oṃ haḥ
astrāsanāya krūṃ phaṭ / oṃ oṃ astramūrtaye namaḥ / oṃ svāṃ
svaṃ krūṃ phaṭ pāśupatāstrāya svāhā / oṃ oṃ hṛdayāya
krūṃ phaṭ namaḥ / oṃ paṃ śikhāyai krūṃ phaṭ namaḥ /
oṃ khaṃ kavacāya krūṃ phaṭ namaḥ / oṃ haṃ phaṭ astrāya
phaṭ namaḥ / iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 247
agguṣṭhena spṛśet kumbhaṃ hṛdā muṣṭyāstravardhanīṃ //
81.d:
भगलिङ्गसमायोगं विदध्याल्लिङ्गमुद्रया /
:न्
1 ओं अं हः अस्त्रासनाय ह्रं फट् / ओं अं अस्त्रमूर्तये
नमः / ओं पशूं हुं फट् पाशुपतास्त्राय नमः / ओं
हृदयाय ह्रं फट् नमः / ओं श्रीं शिरसे ह्रूं फट्
नमः / ओं मं शिखायै फट् नमः / ओं अस्त्राय फट्
हूं फट् नमः / इति ग, चिह्न्कितपुस्तकपाठः / ओं हः
अस्त्रासनाय क्रूं फट् / ओं ओं अस्त्रमूर्तये नमः / ओं स्वां
स्वं क्रूं फट् पाशुपतास्त्राय स्वाहा / ओं ओं हृदयाय
क्रूं फट् नमः / ओं पं शिखायै क्रूं फट् नमः /
ओं खं कवचाय क्रूं फट् नमः / ओं हं फट् अस्त्राय
फट् नमः / इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 247
अग्गुष्ठेन स्पृशेत् कुम्भं हृदा मुष्ट्यास्त्रवर्धनीं //
81.m:
One should perform the union of the female and male organs using the liṅga mudrā.
[Gap in text]
1. "Oṃ aṃ haḥ astrāsanāya hraṃ phaṭ / oṃ aṃ astramūrtaye namaḥ / oṃ paśūṃ huṃ phaṭ pāśupatāstrāya namaḥ / oṃ hṛdayāya hraṃ phaṭ namaḥ / oṃ śrīṃ śirase hrūṃ phaṭ namaḥ / oṃ maṃ śikhāyai phaṭ namaḥ / oṃ astrāya phaṭ hūṃ phaṭ namaḥ /" Thus reads the text marked ga. "Oṃ haḥ astrāsanāya krūṃ phaṭ / oṃ oṃ astramūrtaye namaḥ / oṃ svāṃ svaṃ krūṃ phaṭ pāśupatāstrāya svāhā / oṃ oṃ hṛdayāya krūṃ phaṭ namaḥ / oṃ paṃ śikhāyai krūṃ phaṭ namaḥ / oṃ khaṃ kavacāya krūṃ phaṭ namaḥ / oṃ haṃ phaṭ astrāya phaṭ namaḥ /" Thus reads the text marked ṅa. / p. 247
With the thumb one should touch the pitcher, [reciting] the heart [mantra], and with a fist [touch] the weapon-spouted jar.

81.s:
bhuktaye muktaye tvādau muṣṭinā vardhanīṃ spṛśet /
kumbhasya mukharakṣārthaṃ jñānakhaḍgaṃ samarpayet //
81.d:
भुक्तये मुक्तये त्वादौ मुष्टिना वर्धनीं स्पृशेत् /
कुम्भस्य मुखरक्षार्थं ज्ञानखड्गं समर्पयेत् //
81.m: First, for worldly enjoyment and liberation, one should touch the spouted jar with a fist. / To protect the mouth of the pitcher, one should offer the sword of wisdom.

81.s:
śastrañca mūlamantrasya śataṃ kumbhe niveśayet /
taddaśāṃśena vardhanyāṃ rakṣāṃ vijñāpayettataḥ //
81.d:
शस्त्रञ्च मूलमन्त्रस्य शतं कुम्भे निवेशयेत् /
तद्दशांशेन वर्धन्यां रक्षां विज्ञापयेत्ततः //
81.m: One should deposit a hundred weapons and [repetitions] of the root mantra into the pitcher, / and a tenth part of that into the spouted jar, and then pray for protection:

81.s:
yathedaṃ kṛtayatnena bhagavanmakhamandiraṃ /
rakṣaṇīyaṃ jagannātha sarvādhvaradhara tvayā //
81.d:
यथेदं कृतयत्नेन भगवन्मखमन्दिरं /
रक्षणीयं जगन्नाथ सर्वाध्वरधर त्वया //
81.m: “Just as this house of sacrifice has been prepared with effort, O Lord, / so it must be protected by You, O Lord of the Universe, who sustain all sacrifices!”

81.s:
praṇavasthaṃ caturbāhuṃ vāyavye gaṇamarcayet(1) /
sthaṇḍile śivamabhyarcya sārghyakuṇḍaṃ vrajennaraḥ //
81.d:
प्रणवस्थं चतुर्बाहुं वायव्ये गणमर्चयेत्(1) /
स्थण्डिले शिवमभ्यर्च्य सार्घ्यकुण्डं व्रजेन्नरः //
81.m: One should worship the four-armed Gaṇa situated on the praṇava in the northwest. / Having worshipped Śiva on the bare ground, the man should proceed to the fire-pit accompanied by the water offering.

81.s:
niviṣṭo mantratṛptyarthamarghyagandhaghṛtādikaṃ /
vāme 'savye tu vinyasya samiddarbhatilādikaṃ //
81.d:
निविष्टो मन्त्रतृप्त्यर्थमर्घ्यगन्धघृतादिकं /
वामे ऽसव्ये तु विन्यस्य समिद्दर्भतिलादिकं //
81.m: Seated, for the satisfaction of the mantra, placing the water offering, fragrant paste, clarified butter, and so forth on the left, / but on the right the firewood, darbha grass, sesame seeds, and the like,

81.s:
kuṇḍavahnisrugājyādi prāgvat saṃskṛtya bhāvayet /
mukhyatāmūrdhvavaktrasya hṛdi vahnau śivaṃ yajet //
81.d:
कुण्डवह्निस्रुगाज्यादि प्राग्वत् संस्कृत्य भावयेत् /
मुख्यतामूर्ध्ववक्त्रस्य हृदि वह्नौ शिवं यजेत् //
81.m: having consecrated the fire-pit, fire, ladles, clarified butter, and so forth as before, one should contemplate them. / Concentrating on the pre-eminence of the upward-facing face, one should worship Śiva in the heart and in the fire.

81.s:
svamūrtau śivakumbhe ca sthaṇḍile tvagniśiṣyayoḥ /
sṛṣṭinyāsena vinyasya śodhyādhvānaṃ yathāvidhi //
81.d:
स्वमूर्तौ शिवकुम्भे च स्थण्डिले त्वग्निशिष्ययोः /
सृष्टिन्यासेन विन्यस्य शोध्याध्वानं यथाविधि //
81.m: In one's own body, in the pitcher of Śiva, on the bare ground, and in the fire and the disciple, / having performed the ritual deposition according to the order of cosmic creation, purifying the path according to rule,

81.s:
kuṇḍamānaṃ mukhaṃ dhyātvā hṛdāhutibhirīpsitaṃ /
vījāni saptajihvānāmagnerhomāya bhaṇyate //
81.d:
कुण्डमानं मुखं ध्यात्वा हृदाहुतिभिरीप्सितं /
वीजानि सप्तजिह्वानामग्नेर्होमाय भण्यते //
81.m: contemplating the mouth to be the size of the fire-pit, desiring [results] by means of heart oblations, / the seed-syllables of the seven tongues of fire are declared for the fire oblation:

81.s:
virephāvantimauvarṇau rephaṣaṣṭhasvarānvitau /
induvinduśikhāyuktau jihvāvījānupakramāt //
81.d:
विरेफावन्तिमौवर्णौ रेफषष्ठस्वरान्वितौ /
इन्दुविन्दुशिखायुक्तौ जिह्वावीजानुपक्रमात् //
81.m: The last two letters devoid of the letter 'r', combined with 'r' and the sixth vowel, / and joined with the crescent moon, bindu, and crest, are in succession the seed-syllables of the tongues:

81.s:
hiraṇyā vanakā raktā kṛṣṇā tadanu suprabhā /
atiriktā bahurūpā rudrendrāgnyāpyadiṅmukhā //
81.d:
हिरण्या वनका रक्ता कृष्णा तदनु सुप्रभा /
अतिरिक्ता बहुरूपा रुद्रेन्द्राग्न्याप्यदिङ्मुखा //
81.m: Hiraṇyā, Kanakā, Raktā, then Kṛṣṇā, Suprabhā, / Atiriktā, and Bahurūpā, facing the quarters of Rudra, Indra, Agni, and the deity of the waters.

81.s:
kṣīrādimadhurair homaṃ kuryācchāntikapauṣṭike /
abhicāre tu piṇyākasaktukañcukakāñcikaiḥ //
81.d:
क्षीरादिमधुरैर् होमं कुर्याच्छान्तिकपौष्टिके /
अभिचारे तु पिण्याकसक्तुकञ्चुककाञ्चिकैः //
81.m: One should perform the fire oblation with sweet substances such as milk in rites for pacification and nourishment; / but in malevolent sorcery, with oil-cake, roasted barley flour, husks, and fermented gruel,

81.s:
lavaṇair ājikātakrakaṭutailaiś ca kaṇṭakaiḥ /
:n
1 vāyavye kālamarcayediti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 248
samidbhirapi vakrābhiḥ kruddho bhāṣyāṇunā yajet //
81.d:
लवणैर् आजिकातक्रकटुतैलैश् च कण्टकैः /
:न्
1 वायव्ये कालमर्चयेदिति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 248
समिद्भिरपि वक्राभिः क्रुद्धो भाष्याणुना यजेत् //
81.m:
and with salt, mustard seeds, buttermilk, pungent oils, and thorns,
[Gap in text]
1. "One should worship Kāla in the northwest," thus reads the text marked ga. / p. 248
and also with crooked fire-sticks, angry, one should sacrifice with the prescribed mantra.

81.s:
kadambakalikāhomādyakṣiṇī siddhyati dhruvaṃ /
bandhūkakiṃśukādīni vaśyākarṣāya homayet //
81.d:
कदम्बकलिकाहोमाद्यक्षिणी सिद्ध्यति ध्रुवं /
बन्धूककिंशुकादीनि वश्याकर्षाय होमयेत् //
81.m: By offering kadamba buds into the fire, a yakṣiṇī is certainly mastered. / One should offer bandhūka, kiṃśuka, and other flowers for subjugation and attraction.

81.s:
bilvaṃ rājyāya lakṣmārthaṃ pāṭalāṃś campakānapi /
padmāni cakravartitve bhakṣyabhojyāni sampade //
81.d:
बिल्वं राज्याय लक्ष्मार्थं पाटलांश् चम्पकानपि /
पद्मानि चक्रवर्तित्वे भक्ष्यभोज्यानि सम्पदे //
81.m: Bilva fruit for kingship; pāṭalā and campaka flowers for wealth; / lotuses for universal sovereignty; edible foods for prosperity.

81.s:
dūrvā vyādhivināśāya sarvasattvavaśīkṛte /
priyaṅgupāṭalīpuṣpaṃ cūtapatraṃ jvarāntakaṃ //
81.d:
दूर्वा व्याधिविनाशाय सर्वसत्त्ववशीकृते /
प्रियङ्गुपाटलीपुष्पं चूतपत्रं ज्वरान्तकं //
81.m: Dūrvā grass for the destruction of disease; priyaṅgu and pāṭalī flowers for subjugating all living beings; / mango leaves put an end to fever.

81.s:
mṛtyuñjayo mṛtyujit syād vṛddhiḥ syāttilahomataḥ /
rudraśāntiḥ sarvaśāntyai atha prastutamucyate //
81.d:
मृत्युञ्जयो मृत्युजित् स्याद् वृद्धिः स्यात्तिलहोमतः /
रुद्रशान्तिः सर्वशान्त्यै अथ प्रस्तुतमुच्यते //
81.m: By means of the Mṛtyuñjaya [mantra] one conquers death; prosperity arises from the fire oblation of sesame seeds; / the Rudra-śānti rite is for all pacification. Now what has been commenced is described:

81.s:
āhutyaṣṭaśatair mūlamaṅgāni tu daśāṃśataḥ /
santarpayeta mūlena dadyāt pūrṇāṃ yathā purā //
81.d:
आहुत्यष्टशतैर् मूलमङ्गानि तु दशांशतः /
सन्तर्पयेत मूलेन दद्यात् पूर्णां यथा पुरा //
81.m: With one hundred and eight oblations [one should gratify] the root [mantra], and the ancillary deities with a tenth part of that. / One should gratify with the root mantra and make the full oblation as before.

81.s:
tathā śiṣyapraveśāya pratiśiṣyaṃ śataṃ japet /
dur nimittāpasārāya sunimittakṛte tathā //
81.d:
तथा शिष्यप्रवेशाय प्रतिशिष्यं शतं जपेत् /
दुर् निमित्तापसाराय सुनिमित्तकृते तथा //
81.m: Likewise, for the entrance of the disciples, one should recite [the mantra] a hundred times for each disciple. / For removing ill omens and for securing good omens,

81.s:
śatadvayañca hotavyaṃ mūlamantreṇa pūrvavat /
mūlādyaṣṭāstramantrāṇāṃ svāhāntaistarpaṇaṃ sakṛt //
81.d:
शतद्वयञ्च होतव्यं मूलमन्त्रेण पूर्ववत् /
मूलाद्यष्टास्त्रमन्त्राणां स्वाहान्तैस्तर्पणं सकृत् //
81.m: two hundred oblations should be offered into the fire with the root mantra as before. / There is a single gratification of the mantras of the eight weapons starting with the root mantra, ending with "svāhā",

81.s:
śikhāsampuṭitair vījair hrūṃ phaḍantaiś ca(1) dīpanaṃ /
oṃ hauṃ śivāya svāhetyādimantraiś ca tarpaṇaṃ //
81.d:
शिखासम्पुटितैर् वीजैर् ह्रूं फडन्तैश् च(1) दीपनं /
ओं हौं शिवाय स्वाहेत्यादिमन्त्रैश् च तर्पणं //
81.m: and an illumination with seed-syllables enclosed by the śikhā mantra and ending with "hrūṃ phaṭ"; / and a gratification with mantras such as "oṃ hauṃ śivāya svāhā",

81.s:
oṃ hrūṃ hrauṃ hrīṃ śivāya hrūṃ(2) phaḍityādidīpanaṃ /
tataḥ śivāmbhasā sthālīṃ kṣālitāṃ varmaguṇṭhitāṃ(3) //
81.d:
ओं ह्रूं ह्रौं ह्रीं शिवाय ह्रूं(2) फडित्यादिदीपनं /
ततः शिवाम्भसा स्थालीं क्षालितां वर्मगुण्ठितां(3) //
81.m: and an illumination such as "oṃ hrūṃ hrauṃ hrīṃ śivāya hrūṃ phaṭ". / Then, over the cooking pot washed with Śiva-water and veiled with the armour mantra,

81.s:
candanādisamālabdhāṃ badhnīyāt kaṭakaṃ gale /
varmāstrajaptasaddarbhapatrābhyāṃ carusiddhaye //
:n
1 huṃ phaḍantaiś ca kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 oṃ hūṃ hauṃ hūṃ śivāya hūmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ /
oṃ kraṃ hauṃ kraṃ śivāya krūṃ iti ṅa,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 dharmaguṇṭhitāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 249
81.d:
चन्दनादिसमालब्धां बध्नीयात् कटकं गले /
वर्मास्त्रजप्तसद्दर्भपत्राभ्यां चरुसिद्धये //
:न्
1 हुं फडन्तैश् च ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 ओं हूं हौं हूं शिवाय हूमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः /
ओं क्रं हौं क्रं शिवाय क्रूं इति ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 धर्मगुण्ठितामिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 249
81.m:
anointed with sandalwood paste and the like, one should tie a ring around the neck / with two blades of auspicious darbha grass consecrated with the armour and weapon mantras, for the accomplishment of the sacrificial pap.
[Gap in text]
1. "And ending with huṃ phaṭ," thus reads the text marked kha.
2. "Oṃ hūṃ hauṃ hūṃ śivāya hūm," thus reads the text marked kha.
"Oṃ kraṃ hauṃ kraṃ śivāya krūṃ," thus reads the text marked ṅa.
3. "Veiled with dharma," thus reads the text marked kha. / p. 249

81.s:
varmādyair āsane(1) datte sārdhendukṛtamaṇḍale(2) /
nyastāyāṃ mūrtibhūtāyāṃ bhāvapuṣpaiḥ śivaṃ yajet //
81.d:
वर्माद्यैर् आसने(1) दत्ते सार्धेन्दुकृतमण्डले(2) /
न्यस्तायां मूर्तिभूतायां भावपुष्पैः शिवं यजेत् //
81.m: When the seat has been provided with the armour and other [mantras] in a maṇḍala made with a crescent moon, / and when the pot, having become the form [of the deity], has been placed, one should worship Śiva with flowers of devotional feeling,

81.s:
vastrabaddhamukhāyāṃ vā sthālyāṃ puṣpair vahirbhavaiḥ /
cullyāṃ paścimavaktrāyāṃ nyastāyāṃ mānuṣātmanā //
81.d:
वस्त्रबद्धमुखायां वा स्थाल्यां पुष्पैर् वहिर्भवैः /
चुल्ल्यां पश्चिमवक्त्रायां न्यस्तायां मानुषात्मना //
81.m: or in the cooking pot whose mouth is tied with cloth, with external flowers, / placed on an oven facing west by the human self,

81.s:
nyastāhaṅkāravījāyāṃ śuddhāyāṃ vīkṣaṇādibhiḥ /
dharmādharmaśarīrāyāṃ japtāyāṃ mānuṣātmanā //
81.d:
न्यस्ताहङ्कारवीजायां शुद्धायां वीक्षणादिभिः /
धर्माधर्मशरीरायां जप्तायां मानुषात्मना //
81.m: upon which the ego seed-syllable has been deposited, purified by glances and other rites, / whose body consists of merit and demerit, consecrated by the human self.

81.s:
sthālīmāropayedastrajaptāṃ gavyāmbumārjitāṃ /
gavyaṃ payo 'strasaṃśuddhaṃ prāsādaśatamantritaṃ //
81.d:
स्थालीमारोपयेदस्त्रजप्तां गव्याम्बुमार्जितां /
गव्यं पयो ऽस्त्रसंशुद्धं प्रासादशतमन्त्रितं //
81.m: One should place the cooking pot, consecrated with the weapon mantra and wiped with cow-dung water, / [adding] cow's milk purified by the weapon mantra and consecrated with a hundred repetitions of the prāsāda mantra.

81.s:
tuṇḍalān śyāmakādīnāṃ nikṣipettatra tadyathā /
ekaśiṣyavidhānāya teṣāṃ prasṛtipañcakaṃ //
81.d:
तुण्डलान् श्यामकादीनां निक्षिपेत्तत्र तद्यथा /
एकशिष्यविधानाय तेषां प्रसृतिपञ्चकं //
81.m: There one should cast grains of śyāmāka rice and the like, as follows: / five handfuls of them for the ritual of a single disciple,

81.s:
prasṛtiṃ prasṛtiṃ paścādvardhayed dvyādiṣu kramāt /
kuryāccānalamantreṇa pidhānaṃ kavacāṇunā //
81.d:
प्रसृतिं प्रसृतिं पश्चाद्वर्धयेद् द्व्यादिषु क्रमात् /
कुर्याच्चानलमन्त्रेण पिधानं कवचाणुना //
81.m: and afterwards one should increase it by one handful each in order for two [disciples] and so forth. / One should cover it with the fire mantra and the armour mantra.

81.s:
śivāgnau mūlamantreṇa pūrvāsyaś carukaṃ pacet /
sukhinne tatra taccullyāṃ śruvamāpūrya sarpiṣā //
81.d:
शिवाग्नौ मूलमन्त्रेण पूर्वास्यश् चरुकं पचेत् /
सुखिन्ने तत्र तच्चुल्ल्यां श्रुवमापूर्य सर्पिषा //
81.m: Facing east, one should cook the sacrificial pap in the Śiva-fire with the root mantra. / When it is well-cooked there in that oven, filling the wooden ladle with clarified butter,

81.s:
svāhāntaiḥ saṃhitāmantrair datvā taptābhighāraṇaṃ /
saṃsthāpya maṇḍale sthālīṃ saddarbhe 'strāṇunā kṛte //
81.d:
स्वाहान्तैः संहितामन्त्रैर् दत्वा तप्ताभिघारणं /
संस्थाप्य मण्डले स्थालीं सद्दर्भे ऽस्त्राणुना कृते //
81.m: and performing the hot sprinkling with the saṃhitā mantras ending with "svāhā", / placing the pot on a maṇḍala with fine darbha grass prepared with the weapon mantra,

81.s:
praṇavena pidhāyāsyāṃ taddehalepanaṃ hṛdā /
suśītalo bhavatyevam prāpya śītābhighāraṇaṃ //
81.d:
प्रणवेन पिधायास्यां तद्देहलेपनं हृदा /
सुशीतलो भवत्येवम् प्राप्य शीताभिघारणं //
81.m: covering its mouth with the praṇava, and smearing its body with the heart mantra, / receiving the cool sprinkling, it thus becomes very cool.

81.s:
vidadhyātsaṃhitāmantraiḥ śiṣyaṃ prati sakṛt sakṛt /
dharmādyāsanake hutvā(3) kuṇḍamaṇḍalapaścime //
81.d:
विदध्यात्संहितामन्त्रैः शिष्यं प्रति सकृत् सकृत् /
धर्माद्यासनके हुत्वा(3) कुण्डमण्डलपश्चिमे //
81.m: One should perform [this] with the saṃhitā mantras once for each disciple. / Having offered an oblation onto the seat of virtue and the rest to the west of the fire-pit's maṇḍala,

81.s:
sampātañca srucā hutvā śuddhiṃ saṃhitayā caret /
carukaṃ sakṛdālabhya tayaiva vaṣaḍantayā //
:n
1 dharmādyair āsane iti ka, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 sārdāmbukṛtamaṇḍale iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 dharmādyāsanake dhṛtveti kha, ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 250
81.d:
सम्पातञ्च स्रुचा हुत्वा शुद्धिं संहितया चरेत् /
चरुकं सकृदालभ्य तयैव वषडन्तया //
:न्
1 धर्माद्यैर् आसने इति क, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 सार्दाम्बुकृतमण्डले इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 धर्माद्यासनके धृत्वेति ख, ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 250
81.m:
and offering the residual drops with the ladle, one should perform purification with the saṃhitā mantra; / touching the sacrificial pap once with that same [mantra] ending with "vaṣaṭ",
[Gap in text]
1. "On the seat with dharma and the rest," thus reads the text marked ka.
2. "In a maṇḍala made with moist water," thus reads the text marked kha.
3. "Having held it on the seat of dharma and the rest," thus reads the text marked kha and ga. / p. 250

81.s:
dhenumudrāmṛtībhūtaṃ sthaṇḍileśāntikaṃ nayet(1) /
sājyabhāgaṃ svaśiṣyāṇāṃ bhāgo devāya vahnaye //
81.d:
धेनुमुद्रामृतीभूतं स्थण्डिलेशान्तिकं नयेत्(1) /
साज्यभागं स्वशिष्याणां भागो देवाय वह्नये //
81.m: made into nectar with the cow mudrā, one should bring it near the Lord of the bare ground. / A portion with clarified butter is for one's own disciples, and a portion is for the god [and] the fire.

81.s:
kuryāttu stokapālādeḥ samadhvājyamitidaṃ trayaṃ /
namo 'ntena hṛdā dadyāttenaivācamanīyakaṃ(2) //
81.d:
कुर्यात्तु स्तोकपालादेः समध्वाज्यमितिदं त्रयं /
नमो ऽन्तेन हृदा दद्यात्तेनैवाचमनीयकं(2) //
81.m: One should make these three—honey, clarified butter, and so forth—for the guardian of the drops and the rest. / One should offer them with the heart mantra ending with "namaḥ", and sipping water with that very same [mantra].

81.s:
sājyaṃ mantraśataṃ hutvā dadyāt pūrṇāṃ yathāvidhi /
maṇḍalaṃ kuṇḍataḥ pūrve madhye vā śambhukumbhayoḥ //
81.d:
साज्यं मन्त्रशतं हुत्वा दद्यात् पूर्णां यथाविधि /
मण्डलं कुण्डतः पूर्वे मध्ये वा शम्भुकुम्भयोः //
81.m: Having offered a hundred oblations with ghee accompanied by the mantra, he should offer the final full oblation (pūrṇā) according to rule, / [and prepare] a maṇḍala to the east of the fire-pit, or between Śambhu['s icon] and the water-pitcher.

81.s:
rudramātṛgaṇādīnāṃ nirvartyāntarbaliṃ hṛdā /
śivamadhye 'pyalabdhājño vidhāyaikatvabhāvanaṃ //
81.d:
रुद्रमातृगणादीनां निर्वर्त्यान्तर्बलिं हृदा /
शिवमध्ये ऽप्यलब्धाज्ञो विधायैकत्वभावनं //
81.m: Having performed the interior food-offering (bali) with the heart-mantra to the Rudras, Mothers, and attendants, / and having formed the meditation of oneness even amidst Śiva, although not having obtained [further] command,

81.s:
sarvajñatādiyukto 'haṃ samantāccopari sthitaḥ /
mamāṃśo yojanāsthānamadhiṣṭhāhamadhvare //
81.d:
सर्वज्ञतादियुक्तो ऽहं समन्ताच्चोपरि स्थितः /
ममांशो योजनास्थानमधिष्ठाहमध्वरे //
81.m: “I am endowed with omniscience and other divine qualities; I stand everywhere and above all; / My portion is the place of union; I preside over the sacrifice.”

81.s:
śivo 'hamityahaṅkārī niṣkramed yāgamaṇḍapāt /
nyastapūrvāgrasandharbhe śastrāṇukṛtamaṇḍale //
81.d:
शिवो ऽहमित्यहङ्कारी निष्क्रमेद् यागमण्डपात् /
न्यस्तपूर्वाग्रसन्धर्भे शस्त्राणुकृतमण्डले //
81.m: Bearing the ego-conception “I am Śiva”, he should exit the sacrificial pavilion. / Upon a maṇḍala prepared with the weapon-mantra (astra), where sacrificial grass (darbha) has been laid with tips pointed eastward,

81.s:
praṇavāsanake śiṣyaṃ śuklavastrottarīyakaṃ /
snātañcodaṅmukhaṃ muktyai pūrvavaktrantu bhuktaye //
81.d:
प्रणवासनके शिष्यं शुक्लवस्त्रोत्तरीयकं /
स्नातञ्चोदङ्मुखं मुक्त्यै पूर्ववक्त्रन्तु भुक्तये //
81.m: on a seat made of the praṇava, [he should place] the disciple who has bathed, wearing a white garment and an upper cloth, / facing north for liberation, or facing east for worldly enjoyment.

81.s:
ūrdhvaṃ kāyaṃ samāropya pūrvāsyaṃ pravilokayet /
caraṇādiśikhāṃ yāvanmuktau bhuktau vilomataḥ //
81.d:
ऊर्ध्वं कायं समारोप्य पूर्वास्यं प्रविलोकयेत् /
चरणादिशिखां यावन्मुक्तौ भुक्तौ विलोमतः //
81.m: Raising his own body upward, he should gaze at him facing east, / from the feet up to the tuft of hair for liberation, and in reverse order for worldly enjoyment,

81.s:
cakṣuṣā saprasādena śaivaṃ dhāma vivṛṇvatā /
astrodakena sammokṣya mantrāmbusnānasiddaye //
81.d:
चक्षुषा सप्रसादेन शैवं धाम विवृण्वता /
अस्त्रोदकेन सम्मोक्ष्य मन्त्राम्बुस्नानसिद्दये //
81.m: with a benevolent eye revealing the Śaiva abode. / Having sprinkled him with water consecrated with the weapon-mantra (astra) to achieve the bath with mantric water,

81.s:
bhasmasnānāya vighnānāṃ śāntaye pāpabhittaye(3) /
sṛṣṭisaṃhārayogena tāḍayedastrabhasmanā //
81.d:
भस्मस्नानाय विघ्नानां शान्तये पापभित्तये(3) /
सृष्टिसंहारयोगेन ताडयेदस्त्रभस्मना //
81.m: for the ash-bath, for the pacification of obstacles, and for the breaking of sins (or bonds), / he should strike him with ashes consecrated by the weapon-mantra, in accordance with [the order of] creation and dissolution.

81.s:
punarastrāmbunā prokṣya sakalīkaraṇāya taṃ /
:n
1 sthaṇḍilopāntikaṃ nayediti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 tenaivācamanīyamiti ka, kha, ga, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
3 pāśabhittaye iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 251
nābherūrdhvaṃ kuśāgreṇa mārjanīyāstramuccaran //
81.d:
पुनरस्त्राम्बुना प्रोक्ष्य सकलीकरणाय तं /
:न्
1 स्थण्डिलोपान्तिकं नयेदिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 तेनैवाचमनीयमिति क, ख, ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकत्रयपाठः
3 पाशभित्तये इति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 251
नाभेरूर्ध्वं कुशाग्रेण मार्जनीयास्त्रमुच्चरन् //
81.m:
Having sprinkled him again with weapon-water, for the purpose of his divinisation (sakalīkaraṇa),
[Gap in text]
1. "sthaṇḍilopāntikaṃ nayet" is the variant reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
2. "tenaivācamanīyam" is the reading in the three manuscripts marked ka, kha, and ga.
3. "pāśabhittaye" is the reading in the manuscript marked ga. / Page 251
he should wipe him above the navel with the tip of kuśa grass, reciting the weapon-mantra.

81.s:
tridhā.alabheta tanmūlair aghamarṣāya nābhyadhaḥ /
dvaividhyāya ca pāśānāṃ ālabheta śarāṇunā //
81.d:
त्रिधा.अलभेत तन्मूलैर् अघमर्षाय नाभ्यधः /
द्वैविध्याय च पाशानां आलभेत शराणुना //
81.m: He should touch him thrice below the navel with their roots for the destruction of sins; / and for the twofold nature of bonds he should touch him with the arrow-mantra (śarāṇu).

81.s:
taccharīre śivaṃ sāṅgaṃ sāsanaṃ vinyasettataḥ /
puṣpādipūjitasyāsya netre netreṇa vā hṛdā //
81.d:
तच्छरीरे शिवं साङ्गं सासनं विन्यसेत्ततः /
पुष्पादिपूजितस्यास्य नेत्रे नेत्रेण वा हृदा //
81.m: Then he should deposit Śiva upon his body together with his limbs and his throne. / When he has been worshipped with flowers and the like, [he should bind] his eyes with the eye-mantra or the heart-mantra,

81.s:
badhvāmantritavastreṇa sitena sadaśena ca /.
pradakṣiṇakramādenaṃ praveśya śivadakṣiṇaṃ //
81.d:
बध्वामन्त्रितवस्त्रेण सितेन सदशेन च /.
प्रदक्षिणक्रमादेनं प्रवेश्य शिवदक्षिणं //
81.m: binding them with a consecrated white cloth that has fringes. / Having led him inside by circumambulation to the right side of Śiva,

81.s:
savastramāsanaṃ dadyāt yathāvarṇaṃ(1) nivedayet /
saṃhāramudrayātmānaṃ mūrtyā tasya hṛdambuje //
81.d:
सवस्त्रमासनं दद्यात् यथावर्णं(1) निवेदयेत् /
संहारमुद्रयात्मानं मूर्त्या तस्य हृदम्बुजे //
81.m: he should give him a seat with a cloth, and offer [it] according to his caste. / Confining the self in his heart-lotus by means of the dissolution gesture (saṃhāramudrā) along with [the deity's] form,

81.s:
nirudhya śodhite kāye nyāsaṃ kṛtvā tamarcayet /
pūrvānanasya śiṣyasya mūlamantreṇa mastake //
81.d:
निरुध्य शोधिते काये न्यासं कृत्वा तमर्चयेत् /
पूर्वाननस्य शिष्यस्य मूलमन्त्रेण मस्तके //
81.m: having performed deposition (nyāsa) on the purified body, he should worship him. / On the head of the east-facing disciple, with the root-mantra,

81.s:
śivahastaṃ pradātavyaṃ rudreśapadadāyakaṃ /
śivasevāgrahopāyaṃ dattahastaṃ śivāṇunā(2) //
81.d:
शिवहस्तं प्रदातव्यं रुद्रेशपददायकं /
शिवसेवाग्रहोपायं दत्तहस्तं शिवाणुना(2) //
81.m: the Hand of Śiva (śivahasta), which bestows the station of the Lord of Rudras, should be placed. / Having placed the hand with the Śiva-mantra, which is the means to embrace Śiva's service,

81.s:
śive prakṣepayet puṣpamapanīyārcakantāraṃ(3) /
tatpātrasthānamantrāḍhyaṃ śivadevagaṇānugaṃ //
81.d:
शिवे प्रक्षेपयेत् पुष्पमपनीयार्चकन्तारं(3) /
तत्पात्रस्थानमन्त्राढ्यं शिवदेवगणानुगं //
81.m: he should cast a flower upon Śiva, having removed the blindfold. / Endowed with the mantra of the location of that vessel, following the host of Śiva's deities,

81.s:
viprādīnāṃ kramānnāma kuryādvā svecchayā guruḥ /
praṇatiṃ kumbhavardhanyoḥ kārayitvānalāntikaṃ //
81.d:
विप्रादीनां क्रमान्नाम कुर्याद्वा स्वेच्छया गुरुः /
प्रणतिं कुम्भवर्धन्योः कारयित्वानलान्तिकं //
81.m: the guru should give a name to the Brahmins and others in order, or according to his own wish. / Having made him bow to the pitcher and the Vardhanī jar, near the fire,

81.s:
sadakṣiṇāsane tadvat(4) saumyāsyamupaveśayet /
śiṣyadehaviniṣkrāntāṃ suṣumṇāmiva cintayet //
81.d:
सदक्षिणासने तद्वत्(4) सौम्यास्यमुपवेशयेत् /
शिष्यदेहविनिष्क्रान्तां सुषुम्णामिव चिन्तयेत् //
81.m: he should seat him likewise on a seat to the right, facing north. / He should imagine the suṣumṇā channel emerged from the disciple's body,

81.s:
nijagrahalīnāñca darbhamūlena mantritaṃ /
:n
1 suvarṇañceti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 śivātmaneti kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
3 apanīyādhikāmbaraṃ iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 sadakṣiṇāsana tatreti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 252
darbhāgraṃ dakṣiṇe tasya vidhāya karapallave //
81.d:
निजग्रहलीनाञ्च दर्भमूलेन मन्त्रितं /
:न्
1 सुवर्णञ्चेति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 शिवात्मनेति ख, ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
3 अपनीयाधिकाम्बरं इति घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 सदक्षिणासन तत्रेति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 252
दर्भाग्रं दक्षिणे तस्य विधाय करपल्लवे //
81.m:
merged in his own eclipse (or grasping), consecrated with the root of a darbha grass.
[Gap in text]
1. "suvarṇañca" is the reading in the manuscript marked ga.
2. "śivātmanā" is the reading in the two manuscripts marked kha and ga.
3. "apanīyādhikāmbaraṃ" is the reading in the manuscript marked gha.
4. "sadakṣiṇāsana tatra" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa. / Page 252
Placing the tip of the darbha in his right sprout-like hand,

81.s:
tammūlamātmajaṅghāyāmagrañceti śikhidhvaje /
śiṣyasya hṛdayaṃ gatvā recakena śivāṇunā(1) //
81.d:
तम्मूलमात्मजङ्घायामग्रञ्चेति शिखिध्वजे /
शिष्यस्य हृदयं गत्वा रेचकेन शिवाणुना(1) //
81.m: its root on his own shin and its tip on the fire, / having entered the heart of the disciple through exhalation (recaka) by means of the Śiva-mantra,

81.s:
purakeṇa samāgatya svakīyaṃ hṛdyāntaraṃ /
śivāgninā punaḥ kṛtvā nāḍīsandhānamīdṛśaṃ //
81.d:
पुरकेण समागत्य स्वकीयं हृद्यान्तरं /
शिवाग्निना पुनः कृत्वा नाडीसन्धानमीदृशं //
81.m: and having returned to his own heart's interior through inhalation (pūraka), / having thus again effected the union of the channels (nāḍīsandhāna) through the fire of Śiva,

81.s:
hṛdā tatsannidhānārthañjuhuyādāhutitrayaṃ /
śivahastasthiratvārthaṃ(2) śataṃ mūlena homayet /
itthaṃ samayadīkṣāyāṃ bhavedyogyo bhavārcane //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye samayadīkṣākathanaṃ nāma
ekāśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha dvyaśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
saṃskāradīkṣākathanaṃ
81.d:
हृदा तत्सन्निधानार्थञ्जुहुयादाहुतित्रयं /
शिवहस्तस्थिरत्वार्थं(2) शतं मूलेन होमयेत् /
इत्थं समयदीक्षायां भवेद्योग्यो भवार्चने //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये समयदीक्षाकथनं नाम
एकाशीतितमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ द्व्यशीतितमो ऽध्यायः
संस्कारदीक्षाकथनं
81.m:
he should offer three oblations with the heart-mantra to bring about his presence. / To stabilize the Hand of Śiva, he should offer a hundred oblations with the root-mantra. / Thus, in the probationary initiation (samayadīkṣā), he becomes fit for the worship of Bhava (Śiva).
Thus ends the eighty-first chapter, entitled “The Account of the Probationary Initiation (samayadīkṣā)”, in the venerable and primal Mahāpurāṇa composed by Agni.
Now, the eighty-second chapter:
The exposition of the initiation of purification (saṃskāradīkṣā).

82.s:
īśvara uvāca
vakṣye saṃskāradīkṣāyāṃ vidhānaṃ śṛṇu ṣaṇmukha /
āvāhayenmaheśasya vahnisthasya śiro hṛdi //
82.d:
ईश्वर उवाच
वक्ष्ये संस्कारदीक्षायां विधानं शृणु षण्मुख /
आवाहयेन्महेशस्य वह्निस्थस्य शिरो हृदि //
82.m: The Lord said: / I will proclaim the procedure in the initiation of purification (saṃskāradīkṣā); listen, O Six-faced One (Ṣaṇmukha). / He should invoke the head of the Great Lord residing in the fire into the heart.

82.s:
saṃśliṣṭau tau samabhyarcya santarpya hṛdayātmanā /
tayoḥ sannidhaye dadyāttenaivāhutipañcakaṃ //
82.d:
संश्लिष्टौ तौ समभ्यर्च्य सन्तर्प्य हृदयात्मना /
तयोः सन्निधये दद्यात्तेनैवाहुतिपञ्चकं //
82.m: Having worshipped the two as united, and having propitiated them with the heart-soul-mantra, / he should offer five oblations with that very [mantra] to secure their presence.

82.s:
kusumenāstraliptena(3) tāḍayettaṃ hṛdā śiśuṃ /
prasphurattārakākāraṃ caitanyaṃ tatra bhāvayet //
:n
1 śivātmaneti kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
2 śivahaste ca sthityarthamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 kusumenāṣṭajapteneti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 253
82.d:
कुसुमेनास्त्रलिप्तेन(3) ताडयेत्तं हृदा शिशुं /
प्रस्फुरत्तारकाकारं चैतन्यं तत्र भावयेत् //
:न्
1 शिवात्मनेति ख, ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
2 शिवहस्ते च स्थित्यर्थमिति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 कुसुमेनाष्टजप्तेनेति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 253
82.m:
He should strike that child (the disciple) in the heart with a flower smeared with the weapon-mantra; / and there he should visualize consciousness resembling a glittering star.
[Gap in text]
1. "śivātmanā" is the reading in the two manuscripts marked kha and ga.
2. "śivahaste ca sthityartham" is the reading in the manuscript marked ga.
3. "kusumenāṣṭajaptena" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa. / Page 253

82.s:
praviśya tatra huṅkāramuktaṃ recakayogataḥ /
saṃhāriṇyā tadākṛṣya pūrakeṇa hṛdi nyaset //
82.d:
प्रविश्य तत्र हुङ्कारमुक्तं रेचकयोगतः /
संहारिण्या तदाकृष्य पूरकेण हृदि न्यसेत् //
82.m: Entering there, drawing that [consciousness] released with the syllable hūṃ by means of exhalation / through the Saṃhāriṇī [mudrā], he should deposit it in his heart through inhalation.

82.s:
tato vāgīśvarīyaunau mudrayodbhavasañjñayā /
hṛtsampuṭitamantreṇa(1) recakena vinikṣipet //
oṃ hāṃ hāṃ hāṃ ātmane namaḥ(2)
82.d:
ततो वागीश्वरीयौनौ मुद्रयोद्भवसञ्ज्ञया /
हृत्सम्पुटितमन्त्रेण(1) रेचकेन विनिक्षिपेत् //
ओं हां हां हां आत्मने नमः(2)
82.m:
Then, into the womb of Vāgīśvarī, with the mudrā named Udbhava, / he should project it through exhalation with the mantra enclosed by the heart-syllables:
“Oṃ hāṃ hāṃ hāṃ, salutation to the Self.”

82.s:
jājvalyamāne nirdhūme juhuyādiṣṭasiddhaye /
apravṛddhe sadhūme tu homo vahnau na siddhyati //
82.d:
जाज्वल्यमाने निर्धूमे जुहुयादिष्टसिद्धये /
अप्रवृद्धे सधूमे तु होमो वह्नौ न सिद्ध्यति //
82.m: When [the fire] is blazing brightly without smoke, he should offer oblations for the attainment of the desired result; / but in a fire that is not flared up and is smoky, the fire oblation does not succeed.

82.s:
snigdhaḥ pradakṣiṇāvartaḥ sugandhiḥ śasyate 'nalaḥ /
viparītasphuliṅgī ca bhūmisparśaḥ praśasyate //
82.d:
स्निग्धः प्रदक्षिणावर्तः सुगन्धिः शस्यते ऽनलः /
विपरीतस्फुलिङ्गी च भूमिस्पर्शः प्रशस्यते //
82.m: A fire that is glossy, turning clockwise, and sweet-smelling is commended; / and one having inverted sparks and touching the ground is praised.

82.s:
ityevamādibhiścihnair hutvā śiṣyasya kalmaṣaṃ /
pāpabhakṣaṇahomena(3) dahedvā taṃ bhavātmanā //
82.d:
इत्येवमादिभिश्चिह्नैर् हुत्वा शिष्यस्य कल्मषं /
पापभक्षणहोमेन(3) दहेद्वा तं भवात्मना //
82.m: Having burnt the stain of the disciple with offerings marked by such signs as these, / or he should consume it through the fire oblation of devouring sins, with the essence of Bhava,

82.s:
dvijatvāpādanārthāya tathā rudrāṃśabhāvane /
āhāravījasaṃśuddhau(4) garbhādhānāya saṃsthitau //
82.d:
द्विजत्वापादनार्थाय तथा रुद्रांशभावने /
आहारवीजसंशुद्धौ(4) गर्भाधानाय संस्थितौ //
82.m: for the sake of bringing about the status of the twice-born, and likewise in the realization of being a portion of Rudra, / for the purification of sustenance and semen, for the rite of conception (garbhādhāna) during pregnancy,

82.s:
sīmante janmato nāmakaraṇāya ca homayet /
śatāni pañca mūlena vauṣaḍādidaśāṃśataḥ //
82.d:
सीमन्ते जन्मतो नामकरणाय च होमयेत् /
शतानि पञ्च मूलेन वौषडादिदशांशतः //
82.m: for hair-parting (sīmanta), and for name-giving (nāmakaraṇa) after birth, he should offer oblations: / five hundred [oblations] with the root-mantra, [concluding with] “vauṣaṭ” and other formulas, down to a tenth portion.

82.s:
śithilībhūtabandhasya śaktāvutkarṣaṇaṃ ca yat /
ātmano rudraputtratve garbhādhānaṃ taducyate //
82.d:
शिथिलीभूतबन्धस्य शक्तावुत्कर्षणं च यत् /
आत्मनो रुद्रपुत्त्रत्वे गर्भाधानं तदुच्यते //
82.m: The elevation of the power of the soul whose bonds have been loosened, / into the status of a son of Rudra, is called the rite of conception (garbhādhāna).

82.s:
svāntatryātmaguṇavyaktiriha puṃsavanaṃ mataṃ /
māyātmanorvivekena jñānaṃ sīmantavardhanaṃ //
82.d:
स्वान्तत्र्यात्मगुणव्यक्तिरिह पुंसवनं मतं /
मायात्मनोर्विवेकेन ज्ञानं सीमन्तवर्धनं //
82.m: The manifestation of the soul's own quality of autonomy is regarded here as the rite for producing a male child (puṃsavana); / the knowledge arising from discrimination between Māyā and the Self is the growth of the parted hair (sīmantavardhana);

82.s:
śivāditattvaśuddhestu svīkāro jananaṃ mataṃ /
:n
1 hṛtsampuṭātmamantreṇeti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 oṃ hāṃ hāṃ ātmane nama iti ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / oṃ
hāṃ ātmane nama iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 pāpakṣayeṇa homaneti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 vījasaṃsiddhau iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 254
bodhanaṃ yacchivatvena śivatvārhasya no mataṃ(1) //
82.d:
शिवादितत्त्वशुद्धेस्तु स्वीकारो जननं मतं /
:न्
1 हृत्सम्पुटात्ममन्त्रेणेति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 ओं हां हां आत्मने नम इति ग, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / ओं
हां आत्मने नम इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 पापक्षयेण होमनेति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 वीजसंसिद्धौ इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 254
बोधनं यच्छिवत्वेन शिवत्वार्हस्य नो मतं(1) //
82.m:
and the assumption [of the soul] through the purification of the tattvas from Śiva downwards is regarded as birth.
[Gap in text]
1. "hṛtsampuṭātmamantreṇa" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
2. "oṃ hāṃ hāṃ ātmane namaḥ" is the reading in the manuscripts marked ga and gha; "oṃ hāṃ ātmane namaḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
3. "pāpakṣayeṇa homena" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
4. "vījasaṃsiddhau" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa. / Page 254
The awakening [of the soul] through Śivahood of one worthy of Śivahood is not disapproved.

82.s:
saṃhāramudrayātmānaṃ sphuradvahnikaṇopamaṃ /
vidadhīta samādāya nije hṛdayapaṅkaje //
82.d:
संहारमुद्रयात्मानं स्फुरद्वह्निकणोपमं /
विदधीत समादाय निजे हृदयपङ्कजे //
82.m: Taking the self, resembling a flashing spark of fire, with the dissolution gesture, / he should place it in his own heart-lotus.

82.s:
tataḥ kumbhayogena mūlamantramudīrayet /
kuryāt samavaśībhāvaṃ tadā ca śivayorhṛdi //
82.d:
ततः कुम्भयोगेन मूलमन्त्रमुदीरयेत् /
कुर्यात् समवशीभावं तदा च शिवयोर्हृदि //
82.m: Then, through retention of breath, he should utter the root mantra; / he should then bring about complete unity in the heart of both Śivas.

82.s:
brahmādikāraṇātyāgakramādrecakayogataḥ /
nītvā śivāntamātmānamādāyodbhavamudrayā //
82.d:
ब्रह्मादिकारणात्यागक्रमाद्रेचकयोगतः /
नीत्वा शिवान्तमात्मानमादायोद्भवमुद्रया //
82.m: Through exhalation, leading the self step by step up to Śiva / without abandoning the causal deities beginning with Brahmā, and taking it with the emergence gesture,

82.s:
hṛtsampuṭitamantreṇa recakena vidhānavit /
śiṣyasya hṛdayāmbhojakarṇikāyāṃ vinikṣipet //
82.d:
हृत्सम्पुटितमन्त्रेण रेचकेन विधानवित् /
शिष्यस्य हृदयाम्भोजकर्णिकायां विनिक्षिपेत् //
82.m: the knower of rites, by means of an exhalation / with the mantra enclosed in the heart, should cast it into the pericarp of the disciple's heart-lotus.

82.s:
pūjāṃ śivasya vahneś ca guruḥ kuryāttadocitāṃ /
praṇatiñcātmane śiṣyaṃ samayān śrāvayettathā //
82.d:
पूजां शिवस्य वह्नेश् च गुरुः कुर्यात्तदोचितां /
प्रणतिञ्चात्मने शिष्यं समयान् श्रावयेत्तथा //
82.m: The guru should perform the appropriate worship of Śiva and the fire; / he should have the disciple make prostration to the self and make him hear the probationary pledges:

82.s:
devaṃ na nindecchāstrāṇi nirmālyādi na laṅghayet /
śivāgnigurupūjā ca kartavyā jīvitāvadhi //
82.d:
देवं न निन्देच्छास्त्राणि निर्माल्यादि न लङ्घयेत् /
शिवाग्निगुरुपूजा च कर्तव्या जीवितावधि //
82.m: "He must not revile God or the scriptures, nor step over leftovers [of offerings]; / and worship of Śiva, fire, and guru must be performed as long as life lasts.

82.s:
bālabāliśavṛddhastrībhogabhugvyādhitātmanāṃ /
yathāśakti dadītārthaṃ(2) samarthasya samagrakān //
82.d:
बालबालिशवृद्धस्त्रीभोगभुग्व्याधितात्मनां /
यथाशक्ति ददीतार्थं(2) समर्थस्य समग्रकान् //
82.m: For children, fools, the aged, women, worldly enjoyers, and the sick, / he should give wealth according to ability; for the capable, all of it.

82.s:
bhūtāṅgāni jaṭābhasmadaṇḍakaupīnasaṃyamān /
īśānādyair hṛdādyair vā parijapya yathākramāt //
82.d:
भूताङ्गानि जटाभस्मदण्डकौपीनसंयमान् /
ईशानाद्यैर् हृदाद्यैर् वा परिजप्य यथाक्रमात् //
82.m: Reciting in order with [the mantras] beginning with Īśāna or beginning with the heart / over the ascetic articles: the matted hair, ash, staff, loincloth, and restraints,

82.s:
svāhāntasaṃhitamantraiḥ pātreṣvāropya pūrvavat /
sampāditadrutaṃ hutvā sthaṇḍileśāya darśayet //
82.d:
स्वाहान्तसंहितमन्त्रैः पात्रेष्वारोप्य पूर्ववत् /
सम्पादितद्रुतं हुत्वा स्थण्डिलेशाय दर्शयेत् //
82.m: and placing them into the vessels as before with the saṃhitā mantras ending in svāhā, / having offered melted [ghee] prepared [for oblation], he should show them to the Lord of the altar-ground.

82.s:
rakṣaṇāya ghaṭādhastādāropya kṣaṇamātrakaṃ /
śivādājñāṃ samādāya dadīta yatine guruḥ //
82.d:
रक्षणाय घटाधस्तादारोप्य क्षणमात्रकं /
शिवादाज्ञां समादाय ददीत यतिने गुरुः //
82.m: Having placed them under the jar for just a moment for protection, / and obtaining permission from Śiva, the guru should present them to the ascetic.

82.s:
evaṃ samayadīkṣāyāṃ viśiṣṭāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ /
:n
1 vardhanamiti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 dadītānnamiti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 255
vahnihomāgamajñānayogyaḥ sañjāyate śiśruḥ //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye samayadīkṣākathanaṃ nāma
dvyaśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha tryaśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
nirvāṇadīkṣākathanaṃ
82.d:
एवं समयदीक्षायां विशिष्टायां विशेषतः /
:न्
1 वर्धनमिति घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 ददीतान्नमिति घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 255
वह्निहोमागमज्ञानयोग्यः सञ्जायते शिश्रुः //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये समयदीक्षाकथनं नाम
द्व्यशीतितमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ त्र्यशीतितमो ऽध्यायः
निर्वाणदीक्षाकथनं
82.m:
Thus, when the probationary initiation is accomplished in a distinguished manner,
[Gap in text]
[Variant 1: “vardhanam” in manuscript gha.]
[Variant 2: “dadītānnam” in manuscript gha.]
the child becomes eligible for fire oblation and knowledge of the Āgamas.
Thus ends the eighty-second chapter, named 'The Description of Probationary Initiation', in the ancient Great Purāṇa of Agni.
Now begins the eighty-third chapter.
The Description of Liberating Initiation.

83.s:
īśvara uvāca
atha nirvāṇadīkṣāyāṃ kuryānmūlādidīpanaṃ /
pāśabandhanaśaktyarthaṃ tāḍanādikṛtena vā //
83.d:
ईश्वर उवाच
अथ निर्वाणदीक्षायां कुर्यान्मूलादिदीपनं /
पाशबन्धनशक्त्यर्थं ताडनादिकृतेन वा //
83.m: The Lord said: / Now in liberating initiation, one should perform the kindling of the root and other [mantras], / for the sake of the binding power of the bonds, or by means of striking and other rites.

83.s:
ekaikayā tadāhutyā pratyekaṃ tattrayeṇa vā /
vījagarbhaśikhārdhantu hūṃ phaḍantadhruvādinā //
83.d:
एकैकया तदाहुत्या प्रत्येकं तत्त्रयेण वा /
वीजगर्भशिखार्धन्तु हूं फडन्तध्रुवादिना //
83.m: With a single oblation for each or with three for each, / with the flame-half holding the seed, ending in hūṃ phaṭ, beginning with the fixed [praṇava]—

83.s:
oṃ hrūṃ hrauṃ hauṃ hrūṃ phaḍiti(2) mūlamantrasya dīpanaṃ /
oṃ hrūṃ hauṃ hauṃ hrūṃ phaḍiti(3) hṛdaya evaṃ śiromukhe //
83.d:
