ओं ह्रूं ह्रौं हौं ह्रूं फडिति(2) मूलमन्त्रस्य दीपनं /
ओं ह्रूं हौं हौं ह्रूं फडिति(3) हृदय एवं शिरोमुखे //
83.m: ‘oṃ hrūṃ hrauṃ hauṃ hrūṃ phaṭ’ is the kindling of the root mantra; / ‘oṃ hrūṃ hauṃ hauṃ hrūṃ phaṭ’ in the heart, and likewise at the top of the head.

83.s:
pratyekaṃ dīpanaṃ kuryāt sarvasmin krūrakarmaṇi /
śāntike pauṣṭike cāsya vaṣaḍantādināṇunā(4) //
83.d:
प्रत्येकं दीपनं कुर्यात् सर्वस्मिन् क्रूरकर्मणि /
शान्तिके पौष्टिके चास्य वषडन्तादिनाणुना(4) //
83.m: One should perform the kindling for each in all fierce rites, / but in pacifying and nourishing rites, with this mantra ending in vaṣaṭ and the like.

83.s:
vaṣaḍvauṣaṭsamopetaiḥ sarvakāmyopari sthitaiḥ /
havanaṃ saṃvaraiḥ kuryāt sarvatrāpyāyanādiṣu //
83.d:
वषड्वौषट्समोपेतैः सर्वकाम्योपरि स्थितैः /
हवनं संवरैः कुर्यात् सर्वत्राप्यायनादिषु //
83.m: With mantras accompanied by vaṣaṭ and vauṣaṭ, situated above all desired objects, / one should perform fire oblation with the shields everywhere in rites of nourishment and the like.

83.s:
tataḥ svasavyabhāgasthaṃ maṇḍale śuddhavigrahaṃ /
:n
1 hrīṃ phaḍantadhruvādinā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 oṃ hūṃ hauṃ hauṃ hūṃ phaḍiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ /
oṃ hūṃ hoṃ hūṃ phaḍiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 oṃ hūṃ hāṃ hāṃ hūṃ phaḍiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ /
oṃ hraṃ hrīṃ hraṃ hraṃ phaḍiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 vaṣaḍantādinātmaneti kha, ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 256
śiṣyaṃ sampūjya tat sūtraṃ suṣumṇeti vibhāvitaṃ //
83.d:
ततः स्वसव्यभागस्थं मण्डले शुद्धविग्रहं /
:न्
1 ह्रीं फडन्तध्रुवादिना इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 ओं हूं हौं हौं हूं फडिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः /
ओं हूं हों हूं फडिति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 ओं हूं हां हां हूं फडिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः /
ओं ह्रं ह्रीं ह्रं ह्रं फडिति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 वषडन्तादिनात्मनेति ख, ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 256
शिष्यं सम्पूज्य तत् सूत्रं सुषुम्णेति विभावितं //
83.m:
Then, having worshipped the disciple standing on his own right side / in the maṇḍala, of pure body,
[Gap in text]
[Variant 1: “hrīṃ phaḍantadhruvādinā” in manuscript kha.]
[Variant 2: “oṃ hūṃ hauṃ hauṃ hūṃ phaṭ” in manuscript kha;]
[“oṃ hūṃ hoṃ hūṃ phaṭ” in manuscript ga.]
[Variant 3: “oṃ hūṃ hāṃ hāṃ hūṃ phaṭ” in manuscript kha;]
[“oṃ hraṃ hrīṃ hraṃ hraṃ phaṭ” in manuscript ga.]
[Variant 4: “vaṣaḍantādinātmanā” in manuscripts kha and ga.]
[and] the thread meditated upon as the suṣumṇā channel,

83.s:
mūlena tacchikhābandhaṃ pādāṅguṣṭhāntamānayet /
saṃhāreṇa mumukṣostu badhnīyācchiṣyakāyake //
83.d:
मूलेन तच्छिखाबन्धं पादाङ्गुष्ठान्तमानयेत् /
संहारेण मुमुक्षोस्तु बध्नीयाच्छिष्यकायके //
83.m: he should draw down with the root mantra the binding of the tuft to the tip of the big toe; / with the dissolution [gesture], he should bind it upon the body of the disciple who desires liberation.

83.s:
puṃsastu dakṣiṇe bhāge vāme nāryā niyojayet /
śaktiṃ ca śaktimantreṇa pūjitāntasya mastake //
83.d:
पुंसस्तु दक्षिणे भागे वामे नार्या नियोजयेत् /
शक्तिं च शक्तिमन्त्रेण पूजितान्तस्य मस्तके //
83.m: For a man he should attach it on the right side, for a woman on the left; / and on the head of the disciple, when worship has ended, he should attach the Śakti with the Śakti-mantra.

83.s:
saṃhāramudrayā.adāya sūtraṃ tenaiva yojayet /
nāḍīntvādāya mūlena sūtre nyasya hṛdārcayet //
83.d:
संहारमुद्रया.अदाय सूत्रं तेनैव योजयेत् /
नाडीन्त्वादाय मूलेन सूत्रे न्यस्य हृदार्चयेत् //
83.m: Taking the thread with the dissolution gesture, he should join it with that very [gesture]; / taking the subtle channel with the root mantra, depositing it in the thread, he should worship it with the heart mantra.

83.s:
avaguṇṭhya tu rudreṇa hṛdayenāhutitrayaṃ /
pradadyātsannidhānārthaṃ śaktāvapyevameva hi //
83.d:
अवगुण्ठ्य तु रुद्रेण हृदयेनाहुतित्रयं /
प्रदद्यात्सन्निधानार्थं शक्तावप्येवमेव हि //
83.m: Veiling it with Rudra, he should offer three oblations with the heart mantra / to effect presence; and in the case of the Śakti, it is done in this very manner.

83.s:
oṃ hāṃ varṇādhvane namo hāṃ bhavanādhvane namaḥ /
oṃ hāṃ kālādhvane namaḥ(1) śodhyādhvānaṃ hi sūtrake //
83.d:
ओं हां वर्णाध्वने नमो हां भवनाध्वने नमः /
ओं हां कालाध्वने नमः(1) शोध्याध्वानं हि सूत्रके //
83.m: ‘oṃ hāṃ, obeisance to the course of phonemes; hāṃ, obeisance to the course of worlds; / oṃ hāṃ, obeisance to the course of time’; depositing into the thread the courses to be purified,

83.s:
nyasyāstravāriṇā śiṣyaṃ prokṣyāstramantritena ca /
puṣpeṇa hṛdi santāḍya śiṣyadehe praviśya ca //
83.d:
न्यस्यास्त्रवारिणा शिष्यं प्रोक्ष्यास्त्रमन्त्रितेन च /
पुष्पेण हृदि सन्ताड्य शिष्यदेहे प्रविश्य च //
83.m: sprinkling the disciple with weapon-consecrated water, striking his heart / with a flower consecrated with the weapon-mantra, and entering the disciple's body,

83.s:
guruś ca tatra hūṅkārayuktaṃ recakayogataḥ /
caitanyaṃ haṃsavījasthaṃ viśliṣyedāyudhātmanā //
oṃ hauṃ hūṃ phaṭ(2)
83.d:
गुरुश् च तत्र हूङ्कारयुक्तं रेचकयोगतः /
चैतन्यं हंसवीजस्थं विश्लिष्येदायुधात्मना //
ओं हौं हूं फट्(2)
83.m:
the guru, through exhalation combined with the sound hūṃ, / should detach the consciousness situated in the haṃsa seed with the weapon-self:
‘oṃ hauṃ hūṃ phaṭ’.

83.s:
āchidya śaktisūtreṇa hāṃ haṃ svāheti cāṇunā /
saṃhāramudrayā sūtre nāḍībhūte niyojayet //
83.d:
आछिद्य शक्तिसूत्रेण हां हं स्वाहेति चाणुना /
संहारमुद्रया सूत्रे नाडीभूते नियोजयेत् //
83.m: Cutting it off with the thread of power and with the mantra ‘hāṃ haṃ svāhā’, / he should join it with the dissolution gesture into the thread transformed into the channel:

83.s:
oṃ hāṃ haṃ hāṃ ātmane namaḥ
vyāpakaṃ bhāvayedenaṃ tanutrāṇāvaguṇṭhayet(3) /
:n
1 oṃ dvām padādhvane namaḥ / oṃ hāṃ varṇādhvane namaḥ /
oṃ hāṃ bhavanādhvane namaḥ / oṃ hāṃ kalādhvane namaḥ / iti
ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / oṃ hāṃ padātmane namaḥ / oṃ hāṃ
varṇātmane namaḥ / oṃ hāṃ mantrātmane namaḥ / oṃ hāṃ
kālātmane nama iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 oṃ hāṃ hauṃ hūṃ phaṭ iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 tanmātreṇāvaguṇṭhayediti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 257
āhutitritayaṃ dadyāt hṛdā sannidhihetave //
83.d:
ओं हां हं हां आत्मने नमः
व्यापकं भावयेदेनं तनुत्राणावगुण्ठयेत्(3) /
:न्
1 ओं द्वाम् पदाध्वने नमः / ओं हां वर्णाध्वने नमः /
ओं हां भवनाध्वने नमः / ओं हां कलाध्वने नमः / इति
ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / ओं हां पदात्मने नमः / ओं हां
वर्णात्मने नमः / ओं हां मन्त्रात्मने नमः / ओं हां
कालात्मने नम इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 ओं हां हौं हूं फट् इति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 तन्मात्रेणावगुण्ठयेदिति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 257
आहुतित्रितयं दद्यात् हृदा सन्निधिहेतवे //
83.m:
‘oṃ hāṃ haṃ hāṃ, obeisance to the Self.’ / He should contemplate it as all-pervasive, and veil it with the armour mantra.
[Gap in text]
[Variant 1: “oṃ dvām, obeisance to the course of words; oṃ hāṃ, obeisance to the course of phonemes;
oṃ hāṃ, obeisance to the course of worlds; oṃ hāṃ, obeisance to the course of cosmic capacities” in manuscript ga; “oṃ hāṃ, obeisance to the Self of words; oṃ hāṃ, obeisance to the Self of phonemes; oṃ hāṃ, obeisance to the Self of mantras; oṃ hāṃ, obeisance to the Self of time” in manuscript ṅa.]
[Variant 2: “oṃ hāṃ hauṃ hūṃ phaṭ” in manuscript ga.]
[Variant 3: “tanmātreṇāvaguṇṭhayet” in manuscript ga.]
He should offer three oblations with the heart mantra to cause presence.

83.s:
vidyādehañca vinyasya śāntyatītāvalokanaṃ /
tasyāmitaratattvādyaṃ mantrabhūtaṃ vicintayet //
oṃ hāṃ hauṃ śāntyatītakalāpāśāya(1) nama ity
anenāvalokayet
83.d:
विद्यादेहञ्च विन्यस्य शान्त्यतीतावलोकनं /
तस्यामितरतत्त्वाद्यं मन्त्रभूतं विचिन्तयेत् //
ओं हां हौं शान्त्यतीतकलापाशाय(1) नम इत्य्
अनेनावलोकयेत्
83.m:
Having deposited the body of knowledge and performed the contemplation of Śāntyatīta, / he should contemplate the remaining principles and other elements within it as identical with mantra:
‘oṃ hāṃ hauṃ, obeisance to the bond of the Śāntyatītā cosmic capacity’; / with this [mantra] he should behold it.

83.s:
he tattve mantramapyekaṃ padaṃ varṇāś ca ṣoḍaśa /
tathāṣṭau bhuvanānyasyāṃ vījanāḍīkathadvayaṃ //
83.d:
हे तत्त्वे मन्त्रमप्येकं पदं वर्णाश् च षोडश /
तथाष्टौ भुवनान्यस्यां वीजनाडीकथद्वयं //
83.m: Two principles, one mantra, a word, sixteen phonemes, / and eight worlds in this [capacity]; two seeds, subtle channels, and statements;

83.s:
viṣayañca guṇañcaikaṃ kāraṇaṃ ca sadā śivaṃ /
sitāyāṃ śāntyatītāyāmantarbhāvya prapīḍayet //
oṃ hauṃ śāntyatītakalāpāśāya hūṃ phaṭ
83.d:
विषयञ्च गुणञ्चैकं कारणं च सदा शिवं /
सितायां शान्त्यतीतायामन्तर्भाव्य प्रपीडयेत् //
ओं हौं शान्त्यतीतकलापाशाय हूं फट्
83.m:
one sense object, one quality, and Sadāśiva as the causal deity— / comprehending them within the white Śāntyatītā, he should press it:
‘oṃ hauṃ, to the bond of the Śāntyatītā cosmic capacity, hūṃ phaṭ’.

83.s:
saṃhāramudrayā.adāya vidadhyāt sūtramastake /
pūjayedāhutīṃstisro dadyāt sannidhihetave //
83.d:
संहारमुद्रया.अदाय विदध्यात् सूत्रमस्तके /
पूजयेदाहुतींस्तिस्रो दद्यात् सन्निधिहेतवे //
83.m: Taking it with the dissolution gesture, he should place it at the head of the thread; / he should worship it and offer three oblations to cause presence.

83.s:
tattve dve akṣare dve ca vījanāḍīkathadvayaṃ /
guṇau mantrau tathābjasthamekaṃ kāraṇamīśvaraṃ //
83.d:
तत्त्वे द्वे अक्षरे द्वे च वीजनाडीकथद्वयं /
गुणौ मन्त्रौ तथाब्जस्थमेकं कारणमीश्वरं //
83.m: Two principles, two syllables, two seeds, subtle channels, and statements, / two qualities, two mantras, and the one causal deity Īśvara seated upon a lotus;

83.s:
padāni bhānusaṅkhyāni bhuvanāni daśa sapta ca /
ekañca viṣayaṃ śāntau kṛṣṇāyāmacyutaṃ smaret //
83.d:
पदानि भानुसङ्ख्यानि भुवनानि दश सप्त च /
एकञ्च विषयं शान्तौ कृष्णायामच्युतं स्मरेत् //
83.m: twelve words, seventeen worlds, / and one sense object; in the black Śānti, he should remember Acyuta.

83.s:
tāḍayitvā samādāya mukhasūtre niyojayet /
juhuyānnijavījena sānnidhyāyāhutitrayaṃ //
83.d:
ताडयित्वा समादाय मुखसूत्रे नियोजयेत् /
जुहुयान्निजवीजेन सान्निध्यायाहुतित्रयं //
83.m: Having struck it and taken it, he should attach it to the face-thread; / he should offer three oblations with its own seed for presence.

83.s:
vidyāyāṃ sapta tattvāni pādānāmekaviṃśatiṃ /
ṣaḍ varṇān sañcaraṃ caikaṃ lokānāṃ pañcaviṃśatiṃ //
83.d:
विद्यायां सप्त तत्त्वानि पादानामेकविंशतिं /
षड् वर्णान् सञ्चरं चैकं लोकानां पञ्चविंशतिं //
83.m: In Vidyā, [there are] seven principles, twenty-one words, / six phonemes, one transit, and twenty-five worlds.

83.s:
guṇānāntrayamekañca viṣayaṃ rudrakāraṇaṃ /
antarbhāvyātiriktāyāṃ jīvanāḍīkathadvayaṃ //
83.d:
गुणानान्त्रयमेकञ्च विषयं रुद्रकारणं /
अन्तर्भाव्यातिरिक्तायां जीवनाडीकथद्वयं //
83.m: Having internalized into the additional [kalā] the triad of guṇas, one sense-object, the causal Rudra, / and the pair of discourses on the life-channels,

83.s:
astramādāya dadhyācca padaṃ dvyadhikaviṃśatiṃ /
lokānāñca kalānāñca ṣaṣṭiṃ guṇacatuṣṭayaṃ //
:n
1 oṃ hāṃ hauṃ hoṃ śāntyatītakalāpāśāyeti ga,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 258
83.d:
अस्त्रमादाय दध्याच्च पदं द्व्यधिकविंशतिं /
लोकानाञ्च कलानाञ्च षष्टिं गुणचतुष्टयं //
:न्
1 ओं हां हौं हों शान्त्यतीतकलापाशायेति ग,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 258
83.m:
taking the astra-mantra, he should meditate on the twenty-two words, / the sixty worlds and kalās, the four guṇas,
[Footnote]
1. "oṃ hāṃ hauṃ hoṃ śāntyatītakalāpāśāya" is the reading in the manuscript marked ga. / [Page 258]

83.s:
mantrāṇāṃ trayamekañca viṣayaṃ kāraṇaṃ hariṃ /
antarbhāvya pratiṣṭhāyāṃ śuklayāntāḍanādikaṃ //
83.d:
मन्त्राणां त्रयमेकञ्च विषयं कारणं हरिं /
अन्तर्भाव्य प्रतिष्ठायां शुक्लयान्ताडनादिकं //
83.m: the triad of mantras, one sense-object, the causal Hari; / having internalized [these] in Pratiṣṭhā, which is white, performing striking and the like,

83.s:
vidhāya nābhisūtrasthāṃ sannidhāyāhutīryajet /
hrīṃ bhuvanānāṃ(1) śataṃ sāgraṃpadānāmaṣṭaviṃśatiṃ(2) /
83.d:
विधाय नाभिसूत्रस्थां सन्निधायाहुतीर्यजेत् /
ह्रीं भुवनानां(1) शतं साग्रंपदानामष्टविंशतिं(2) /
83.m: and bringing close [the soul] situated in the navel-thread, he should offer oblations. / "hrīṃ"; [visualizing] more than a hundred worlds, twenty-eight words,

83.s:
vījanāḍīsamīrāṇāṃ dvayorindriyayorapi /
varṇantattvañca viṣayamekaikaṃ guṇapañcakaṃ //
83.d:
वीजनाडीसमीराणां द्वयोरिन्द्रिययोरपि /
वर्णन्तत्त्वञ्च विषयमेकैकं गुणपञ्चकं //
83.m: the seed, the channels, the winds, of both organs, / one letter, one tattva, one sense-object, the five guṇas,

83.s:
hetuṃ brahmāṇḍamantrasthaṃ śambarāṇāṃ catuṣṭayaṃ /
nivṛttau pītavarṇāyāmantarbhāvya pratāḍayet //
83.d:
हेतुं ब्रह्माण्डमन्त्रस्थं शम्बराणां चतुष्टयं /
निवृत्तौ पीतवर्णायामन्तर्भाव्य प्रताडयेत् //
83.m: the cause situated in the cosmic egg mantra, the four Śambaras, / having internalized [them] in Nivṛtti, which is yellow, he should strike.

83.s:
ādau yattattvabhāgānte(3) sūtre vinyasyapūjayet /
juhuyādāhutīstisraḥ sannidhāya pāvake //
83.d:
आदौ यत्तत्त्वभागान्ते(3) सूत्रे विन्यस्यपूजयेत् /
जुहुयादाहुतीस्तिस्रः सन्निधाय पावके //
83.m: Deploying at the beginning [and] at the end of the tattva portions upon the thread, he should worship; / having established the presence [of the deity] in the fire, he should offer three oblations.

83.s:
ityādāya kalāsūtre yojayecchiṣyavigrahāt /
savījāyāntu dīkṣāyāṃ samayācārayāgataḥ //
83.d:
इत्यादाय कलासूत्रे योजयेच्छिष्यविग्रहात् /
सवीजायान्तु दीक्षायां समयाचारयागतः //
83.m: Taking it thus from the body of the disciple, he should join it to the kalā-thread; / but in an initiation with seed (savījādīkṣā), following the conduct of the convention,

83.s:
dehārambhakarakṣārthaṃ mantrasiddhiphalādapi /
iṣṭāpūrtādidharmārthaṃ vyatiriktaṃ prabandhakaṃ //
83.d:
देहारम्भकरक्षार्थं मन्त्रसिद्धिफलादपि /
इष्टापूर्तादिधर्मार्थं व्यतिरिक्तं प्रबन्धकं //
83.m: for the purpose of protecting the body-producer, also for the fruit of mantra-perfection, / and for religious merit such as sacrifices and public works, [the thread is] an additional binder.

83.s:
caitanyabodhakaṃ sūkṣmaṃ kalānāmantare smaret /
amunaiva krameṇātha kuryāttarpaṇadīpane //
83.d:
चैतन्यबोधकं सूक्ष्मं कलानामन्तरे स्मरेत् /
अमुनैव क्रमेणाथ कुर्यात्तर्पणदीपने //
83.m: He should contemplate within the kalās that subtle [presence] which awakens consciousness. / In this very order he should then perform the propitiation and illumination

83.s:
āhutibhiḥ svamantreṇa tisṛbhistisṛbhis tathā /
oṃ hauṃ śāntyatītakalāpāśāya svāhetyāditarpaṇaṃ
oṃ hāṃ haṃ hāṃ(4) śāntyatītakalāpāśāya
hūmphaḍityādidīpanaṃ
tat sūtraṃ vyāptibodhāya kalāsthāneṣu pañcasu //
:n
1 hrīṃ tribhuvanādhipānāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 padānāmūnaviṃśatimiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 ādau satattvabhāveneti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 oṃ hāṃ hauṃ hauṃ iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 259
83.d:
आहुतिभिः स्वमन्त्रेण तिसृभिस्तिसृभिस् तथा /
ओं हौं शान्त्यतीतकलापाशाय स्वाहेत्यादितर्पणं
ओं हां हं हां(4) शान्त्यतीतकलापाशाय
हूम्फडित्यादिदीपनं
तत् सूत्रं व्याप्तिबोधाय कलास्थानेषु पञ्चसु //
:न्
1 ह्रीं त्रिभुवनाधिपानामिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 पदानामूनविंशतिमिति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 आदौ सतत्त्वभावेनेति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 ओं हां हौं हौं इति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 259
83.m:
with three oblations each by means of their own mantras.
“oṃ hauṃ śāntyatītakalāpāśāya svāhā” and so on is the propitiation (tarpaṇa).
“oṃ hāṃ haṃ hāṃ śāntyatītakalāpāśāya hūmphaṭ” and so on is the illumination (dīpana).
For the realization of pervasiveness, that thread in the five seats of kalās
[Footnote]
1. "hrīṃ tribhuvanādhipānām" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
2. "padānāmūnaviṃśatim" is the reading in the manuscript marked ga.
3. "ādau satattvabhāvena" is the reading in the manuscript marked ga.
4. "oṃ hāṃ hauṃ hauṃ" is the reading in the manuscript marked ga. / [Page 259]

83.s:
saṅgṛhya kuṅkumājyena(1) tatra sāṅgaṃ śivaṃ yajet /
hūmphaḍantaiḥ kalāmantrair bhittvā pāśānanukramāt //
83.d:
सङ्गृह्य कुङ्कुमाज्येन(1) तत्र साङ्गं शिवं यजेत् /
हूम्फडन्तैः कलामन्त्रैर् भित्त्वा पाशाननुक्रमात् //
83.m: taking up with saffron-butter, there he should worship Śiva together with his limbs. / Having severed the fetters in order with the kalā-mantras ending in "hūmphaṭ",

83.s:
namo 'ntaiś ca praviśyāntaḥ kuryād grahaṇabandhane /
oṃ hūṃ hāṃ hauṃ hāṃ hūṃ phaṭ śāntyatītakalāṃ
gṛhṇāmi badhnāmi cetyādimantraiḥ kalānāṃ
grahaṇabandhanādiprayogaḥ
pāśādīnāñca svīkāro grahaṇaṃ bandhanaṃ punaḥ //
83.d:
नमो ऽन्तैश् च प्रविश्यान्तः कुर्याद् ग्रहणबन्धने /
ओं हूं हां हौं हां हूं फट् शान्त्यतीतकलां
गृह्णामि बध्नामि चेत्यादिमन्त्रैः कलानां
ग्रहणबन्धनादिप्रयोगः
पाशादीनाञ्च स्वीकारो ग्रहणं बन्धनं पुनः //
83.m:
and entering within [with mantras] ending in "namaḥ", he should perform the seizing and binding:
The ritual application for seizing, binding, and so forth of the kalās is with the mantras: “oṃ hūṃ hāṃ hauṃ hāṃ hūṃ phaṭ śāntyatītakalāṃ gṛhṇāmi badhnāmi ca” and so forth.
The seizing is the taking possession of the fetters and so on, and binding [is done] again

83.s:
puruṣaṃ prati niḥśeṣavyāpārapratipattaye /
upaveśyātha tat sūtraṃ śiṣyaskandhe niveśayet //
83.d:
पुरुषं प्रति निःशेषव्यापारप्रतिपत्तये /
उपवेश्याथ तत् सूत्रं शिष्यस्कन्धे निवेशयेत् //
83.m: for the complete apprehension of activity toward the soul (puruṣa). / Having seated [the disciple], he should then place that thread upon the disciple's shoulder.

83.s:
vistṛtāghapramoṣāya śataṃ mūlena homayet /
śarāvasampuṭe puṃsaḥ striyāś ca praṇitodare //
83.d:
विस्तृताघप्रमोषाय शतं मूलेन होमयेत् /
शरावसम्पुटे पुंसः स्त्रियाश् च प्रणितोदरे //
83.m: To destroy extensive sin, he should offer one hundred fire oblations with the root mantra. / In a dish-casing for a man, and within the praṇītā vessel for a woman,

83.s:
hṛdastrasampuṭaṃ sūtraṃ vidhāyābhyarcayeddhṛdā(2) /
sūtraṃ śivena sāṅgena kṛtvā sampātaśodhitaṃ //
83.d:
हृदस्त्रसम्पुटं सूत्रं विधायाभ्यर्चयेद्धृदा(2) /
सूत्रं शिवेन साङ्गेन कृत्वा सम्पातशोधितं //
83.m: having enclosed the thread between the heart and astra [mantras], he should worship it with the heart [mantra]. / Having made the thread purified by residual oblations with Śiva along with his limbs,

83.s:
nidadhyāt kalaśasyādho rakṣāṃ vijñāpayediti /
śiṣyaṃ puṣpaṃ kare datvā sampūjya kalaśādikaṃ //
83.d:
निदध्यात् कलशस्याधो रक्षां विज्ञापयेदिति /
शिष्यं पुष्पं करे दत्वा सम्पूज्य कलशादिकं //
83.m: he should deposit it beneath the water-jar and announce protection thus. / Placing a flower in the disciple's hand, having thoroughly worshipped the water-jar and other [deities],

83.s:
praṇamayya vahiryāyād yāgamandiramadhyataḥ /
maṇḍalatritayaṃ kṛtvā mumukṣvanuttarānanān //
83.d:
प्रणमय्य वहिर्यायाद् यागमन्दिरमध्यतः /
मण्डलत्रितयं कृत्वा मुमुक्ष्वनुत्तराननान् //
83.m: and making [him] prostrate, he should go outside from the center of the sacrificial hall. / Having made a triad of maṇḍalas, those desiring liberation facing north

83.s:
bhuktaye pūrvavaktrāṃś ca śiṣyāṃstatra niveśayet /
prathame pañcagavyasya prāśayeccullakatrayaṃ //
83.d:
भुक्तये पूर्ववक्त्रांश् च शिष्यांस्तत्र निवेशयेत् /
प्रथमे पञ्चगव्यस्य प्राशयेच्चुल्लकत्रयं //
83.m: and disciples desiring worldly enjoyment facing east, he should seat them there. / In the first, he should make [them] drink three mouthfuls of the five products of the cow (pañcagavya)

83.s:
pāṇinā kuśayuktena arcitānantarāntaraṃ /
caruntatastṛtīye tu grāsatritayasammitaṃ //
83.d:
पाणिना कुशयुक्तेन अर्चितानन्तरान्तरं /
चरुन्ततस्तृतीये तु ग्रासत्रितयसम्मितं //
83.m: with a hand joined with kuśa grass, immediately after the worship. / Then in the third, caru measuring three mouthfuls,

83.s:
aṣṭagrāsapramāṇaṃ vā daśanasparśavarjitaṃ /
pālāśapuṭake muktau bhuktau pippalapatrake //
:n
1 kumbhamājyeneti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 nidadhyān pūrvavaddhṛdā iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 260
83.d:
अष्टग्रासप्रमाणं वा दशनस्पर्शवर्जितं /
पालाशपुटके मुक्तौ भुक्तौ पिप्पलपत्रके //
:न्
1 कुम्भमाज्येनेति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 निदध्यान् पूर्ववद्धृदा इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 260
83.m:
or the measure of eight mouthfuls, without touching the teeth, / in a palāśa-leaf cup for liberation, or in a pippala-leaf cup for worldly enjoyment.
[Footnote]
1. "kumbhamājyena" is the reading in the manuscript marked ga.
2. "nidadhyān pūrvavaddhṛdā" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa. / [Page 260]

83.s:
hṛdā sambhojanaṃ datvā pūtair ācāmayejjalaiḥ /
dantakāṣṭhaṃ hṛdā kṛtvā prakṣipecchobhane śubhaṃ //
83.d:
हृदा सम्भोजनं दत्वा पूतैर् आचामयेज्जलैः /
दन्तकाष्ठं हृदा कृत्वा प्रक्षिपेच्छोभने शुभं //
83.m: Offering the feeding with the heart [mantra], he should make [them] rinse the mouth with pure water. / Having consecrated the tooth-stick with the heart [mantra], he should cast it into an auspicious, beautiful place.

83.s:
nyūnādidoṣamoṣāya mūlenāṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ /
vidhāya sthiṇḍileśāya sarvakarmasamarpaṇaṃ //
83.d:
न्यूनादिदोषमोषाय मूलेनाष्टोत्तरं शतं /
विधाय स्थिण्डिलेशाय सर्वकर्मसमर्पणं //
83.m: To eradicate deficiencies and other faults, having performed one hundred and eight [oblations] with the root mantra, / and dedicating all actions to the Lord of the altar-mound,

83.s:
pūjāvisarjanañcāsya caṇḍeśasya ca pūjanaṃ /
nirmālyamapanīyātha śeṣamagnau yajeccaroḥ //
83.d:
पूजाविसर्जनञ्चास्य चण्डेशस्य च पूजनं /
निर्माल्यमपनीयाथ शेषमग्नौ यजेच्चरोः //
83.m: and dismissing the worship of this [Lord] and the worship of Caṇḍeśa, / removing the floral offerings (nirmālya), he should then offer the remainder of the caru into the fire.

83.s:
kalaśaṃ lokapalāṃś ca pūjayitvā visṛjya ca /
visṛjedgaṇamagniñca rakṣitaṃ yadi vāhyataḥ //
83.d:
कलशं लोकपलांश् च पूजयित्वा विसृज्य च /
विसृजेद्गणमग्निञ्च रक्षितं यदि वाह्यतः //
83.m: Having worshipped the water-jar and the guardians of the directions, and having dismissed [them], / he should dismiss the gaṇas and the fire, if preserved outside.

83.s:
vāhyato lokapālānāṃ datvā saṅkṣepato baliṃ /
bhasmanā śuddhatoyair vā snātvā yā gālayaṃ viśet(1) //
83.d:
वाह्यतो लोकपालानां दत्वा सङ्क्षेपतो बलिं /
भस्मना शुद्धतोयैर् वा स्नात्वा या गालयं विशेत्(1) //
83.m: Having offered a brief food-offering (bali) to the guardians of the directions outside, / bathing with ash or with pure waters, he should enter the sacrificial hall.

83.s:
gṛhasthān darbhaśayyāyāṃ pūrvaśīrṣān surakṣitān /
hṛdā sadbhasmaśayyāyāṃ yatīn dakṣiṇamastakān //
83.d:
गृहस्थान् दर्भशय्यायां पूर्वशीर्षान् सुरक्षितान् /
हृदा सद्भस्मशय्यायां यतीन् दक्षिणमस्तकान् //
83.m: Householders on a bed of darbha grass, with heads to the east, well-protected, / [and] ascetics on a bed of good ash with the heart [mantra], with heads to the south,

83.s:
śikhābaddhasikhānastrasaptamāṇavakānvitān /
vijñāya snāpayecchiṣyāṃstato yāyāt punarvahiḥ //
oṃ hili hili triśūlapāṇaye svāhā
83.d:
शिखाबद्धसिखानस्त्रसप्तमाणवकान्वितान् /
विज्ञाय स्नापयेच्छिष्यांस्ततो यायात् पुनर्वहिः //
ओं हिलि हिलि त्रिशूलपाणये स्वाहा
83.m:
having their topknots bound with the śikhā-mantra, accompanied by the seven disciples [protected by] the astra-mantra— / knowing this, he should bathe the disciples, and then go outside again.
“oṃ hili hili triśūlapāṇaye svāhā”

83.s:
pañcagavyañcaruṃ prāśya gṛhītvā dantadhāvanaṃ /
samācamya śivaṃ dhyātvā śayyāmāsthāya pāvanīṃ(2) //
83.d:
पञ्चगव्यञ्चरुं प्राश्य गृहीत्वा दन्तधावनं /
समाचम्य शिवं ध्यात्वा शय्यामास्थाय पावनीं(2) //
83.m: Having consumed the five products of the cow and the caru, having taken the tooth-stick, / sipping water, meditating upon Śiva, and lying down upon the purifying bed,

83.s:
dīkṣāgataṅkriyākāṇḍaṃ saṃsmaran saṃviśedguruḥ /
iti saṅkṣepataḥ prokto vidhirdīkṣādhivāsane //
:e ity ādimāhāpurāṇe āgneye nirvāṇadīkṣāyāmadhivāsanaṃ
nāma tryaśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 yāgālayaṃ vrajediti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 vidyāmāsthāya pāvanīmiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 261
:ś caturaśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
nirvāṇadīkṣāvidhānaṃ
83.d:
दीक्षागतङ्क्रियाकाण्डं संस्मरन् संविशेद्गुरुः /
इति सङ्क्षेपतः प्रोक्तो विधिर्दीक्षाधिवासने //
:ए इत्य् आदिमाहापुराणे आग्नेये निर्वाणदीक्षायामधिवासनं
नाम त्र्यशीतितमो ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 यागालयं व्रजेदिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 विद्यामास्थाय पावनीमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 261
:श् चतुरशीतितमो ऽध्यायः
निर्वाणदीक्षाविधानं
83.m:
the guru should go to sleep, recollecting the ritual procedures belonging to the initiation. / Thus the rule for preliminary consecration in initiation has been briefly spoken.
Thus ends the eighty-third chapter, named "Preliminary Consecration in Liberating Initiation," in the great and ancient Agni Purāṇa.
[Footnote]
1. "yāgālayaṃ vrajet" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
2. "vidyāmāsthāya pāvanīm" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa. / [Page 261]
Eighty-fourth chapter
Procedure for Liberating Initiation

84.s:
īśvara uvāca
atha prātaḥ samutthāya kṛtasnanādiko guruḥ /
dadhyārdramāṃsamadyādeḥ praśastābhyavahāritā //
84.d:
ईश्वर उवाच
अथ प्रातः समुत्थाय कृतस्ननादिको गुरुः /
दध्यार्द्रमांसमद्यादेः प्रशस्ताभ्यवहारिता //
84.m: The Lord said: / Then, having arisen in the morning and performed bathing and the like, the guru— / the consumption of curds, moist meat, wine, and the like is auspicious;

84.s:
gajāśvarohaṇaṃ svapne śubhaṃ śuklāṃśukādikaṃ(1) /
tailābhyaṅgādikaṃ hīnaṃ homo ghoreṇa śāntaye(2) //
84.d:
गजाश्वरोहणं स्वप्ने शुभं शुक्लांशुकादिकं(1) /
तैलाभ्यङ्गादिकं हीनं होमो घोरेण शान्तये(2) //
84.m: mounting an elephant or a horse, white garments, and the like seen in a dream are auspicious; / anointing with oil and the like is bad, [for which] a fire oblation with the ghora mantra is performed for pacification.

84.s:
nityakarmadvayaṃ kṛtvā praviśya makhamaṇḍapaṃ /
svācānto nityavat karma kuryānnaimittike vidhau //
84.d:
नित्यकर्मद्वयं कृत्वा प्रविश्य मखमण्डपं /
स्वाचान्तो नित्यवत् कर्म कुर्यान्नैमित्तिके विधौ //
84.m: Having performed both daily rites and entered the sacrificial pavilion, / having sipped water, he should perform the rites as if daily in this occasional ritual.

84.s:
tataḥ saṃśodhya cātmānaṃ śivahastaṃ tathātmani /
vinyasya kumbhagaṃ prārcya indrādīnāmanukramāt //
84.d:
ततः संशोध्य चात्मानं शिवहस्तं तथात्मनि /
विन्यस्य कुम्भगं प्रार्च्य इन्द्रादीनामनुक्रमात् //
84.m: Then, having purified himself and placed the Hand of Śiva upon himself, / having worshipped [the deity] in the pot, and Indra and the other [guardians] in order,

84.s:
maṇḍale sthaṇḍile vāpi prakurvīta śivarcanaṃ /
tarpaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ vahneḥ pūrṇāntaṃ mantratarpaṇaṃ //
84.d:
मण्डले स्थण्डिले वापि प्रकुर्वीत शिवर्चनं /
तर्पणं पूजनं वह्नेः पूर्णान्तं मन्त्रतर्पणं //
84.m: he should perform the worship of Śiva on a maṇḍala or on an altar-mound, / the propitiation and worship of the fire, and the propitiation with mantras up to the final oblation.

84.s:
duḥkhapradoṣamoṣāya śastreṇāṣṭādhikaṃ śataṃ /
hutvā hūṃ sampuṭenaiva vidadhyāt mantradīpanaṃ //
84.d:
दुःखप्रदोषमोषाय शस्त्रेणाष्टाधिकं शतं /
हुत्वा हूं सम्पुटेनैव विदध्यात् मन्त्रदीपनं //
84.m: To destroy faults that bestow distress, having offered one hundred and eight [oblations] / with the weapon-mantra, enveloped with "hūṃ", he should perform the illumination of the mantra.

84.s:
antarbalividhānañca madhye sthaṇḍilakumbhayoḥ /
kṛtvā śiṣyapraveśāya labdhānujño vahirvrajet //
84.d:
अन्तर्बलिविधानञ्च मध्ये स्थण्डिलकुम्भयोः /
कृत्वा शिष्यप्रवेशाय लब्धानुज्ञो वहिर्व्रजेत् //
84.m: And having performed the internal bali offering between the altar-mound and the pot, / having obtained permission for the entrance of the disciple, he should go outside.

84.s:
kuryātsamayavattatra maṇḍalāropaṇādikaṃ /
sampātahomaṃ tannāḍīrūpadarbhakarānugaṃ //
84.d:
कुर्यात्समयवत्तत्र मण्डलारोपणादिकं /
सम्पातहोमं तन्नाडीरूपदर्भकरानुगं //
84.m: There he should perform the placement on the maṇḍala and other rites in accordance with the rules, / [and then] the oblation of sacrificial residue following the darbha grass held in hand, which represents the channels [of the body].

84.s:
tatsannidhānāya tistro hutvā mūlāṇunā.ahutīḥ /
kumbhasthaṃ śivamabhyarcya pāśasūtramupāharet(3) //
:n
1 śuklāmbarādikamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 asmallabdhapañcapustakeṣu dadhyārdramāṃsamadyāderityārabhya homo
ghoreṇa śāntaye ity antaḥ pāṭhaḥ pūrveṇānanvita iva
pratibhāti
3 pāśasūtraṃ samāharediti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 262
84.d:
तत्सन्निधानाय तिस्त्रो हुत्वा मूलाणुना.अहुतीः /
कुम्भस्थं शिवमभ्यर्च्य पाशसूत्रमुपाहरेत्(3) //
:न्
1 शुक्लाम्बरादिकमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 अस्मल्लब्धपञ्चपुस्तकेषु दध्यार्द्रमांसमद्यादेरित्यारभ्य होमो
घोरेण शान्तये इत्य् अन्तः पाठः पूर्वेणानन्वित इव
प्रतिभाति
3 पाशसूत्रं समाहरेदिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 262
84.m:
Having offered three oblations with the root mantra for His presence, / [and] having worshipped Śiva residing in the pitcher, he should take up the cord of bondage.
[Footnotes]
1 "śuklāmbarādikam" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
2 In the five manuscripts obtained by us, the reading beginning from "dadhyārdramāṃsamadyādeḥ" and ending with "homo ghoreṇa śāntaye" appears unconnected with what precedes.
3 "pāśasūtraṃ samāharet" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa. / [p. 262]

84.s:
svadakṣiṇordhvakāyasya śiṣyasyābhyarcitasya ca /
tacchikhāyāṃ nibadhnīyāt pādāṅguṣṭhāvalambitaṃ //
84.d:
स्वदक्षिणोर्ध्वकायस्य शिष्यस्याभ्यर्चितस्य च /
तच्छिखायां निबध्नीयात् पादाङ्गुष्ठावलम्बितं //
84.m: The disciple being seated to his own right, facing upwards, and having been worshipped, / he should bind [the cord] to his topknot, hanging down to the big toe of his foot.

84.s:
taṃ niveśya nivṛttestu vyāptimālokya cetasā /
jñeyāni bhuvanānyasyāṃ śatamaṣṭādhikaṃ tataḥ //
84.d:
तं निवेश्य निवृत्तेस्तु व्याप्तिमालोक्य चेतसा /
ज्ञेयानि भुवनान्यस्यां शतमष्टाधिकं ततः //
84.m: Having established him, and having perceived with the mind the pervasive extent of Nivṛtti, / one hundred and eight cosmic realms are then to be known within it:

84.s:
kapālo 'jaś ca buddhaś ca vajradehaḥ pramardanaḥ(1) /
vibhūtiravyayaḥ śāstā pinākī tridaśādhipaḥ //
84.d:
कपालो ऽजश् च बुद्धश् च वज्रदेहः प्रमर्दनः(1) /
विभूतिरव्ययः शास्ता पिनाकी त्रिदशाधिपः //
84.m: Kapāla, Aja, Buddha, Vajradeha, Pramardana, / Vibhūti, Avyaya, Śāstā, Pinākin, and Tridaśādhipa;

84.s:
agnī rudro hutāśo ca piṅgalaḥ khādako haraḥ /
jvalano dahano babhrurbhasmāntakakṣapāntakau //
84.d:
अग्नी रुद्रो हुताशो च पिङ्गलः खादको हरः /
ज्वलनो दहनो बभ्रुर्भस्मान्तकक्षपान्तकौ //
84.m: Agni, Rudra, Hutāśa, Piṅgala, Khādaka, Hara, / Jvalana, Dahana, Babhru, Bhasmāntaka, and Kṣapāntaka;

84.s:
yāmyamṛtyuharo dhātā vidhātā kāryarañjakaḥ /
kālo dharmo 'pyadharmaś ca saṃyoktā ca viyogakaḥ //
84.d:
याम्यमृत्युहरो धाता विधाता कार्यरञ्जकः /
कालो धर्मो ऽप्यधर्मश् च संयोक्ता च वियोगकः //
84.m: Yāmya, Mṛtyuhara, Dhātṛ, Vidhātṛ, Kāryarañjaka, / Kāla, Dharma, Adharma, Saṃyoktṛ, and Viyogaka;

84.s:
nairṛto māraṇo(2) hantā krūradṛṣṭirbhayānakaḥ /
ūrdhvāṃśako virūpākṣo dhūmralohitadaṃṣṭravān //
84.d:
नैरृतो मारणो(2) हन्ता क्रूरदृष्टिर्भयानकः /
ऊर्ध्वांशको विरूपाक्षो धूम्रलोहितदंष्ट्रवान् //
84.m: Nairṛta, Māraṇa, Hantṛ, Krūradṛṣṭi, Bhayānaka, / Ūrdhvāṃśaka, Virūpākṣa, and Dhūmralohitadaṃṣṭravat;

84.s:
balaścātibalaś caiva pāśahasto mahābalaḥ /
śvetaś ca jayabhadraś ca dīrghabāhurjalāntakaḥ(3) //
84.d:
बलश्चातिबलश् चैव पाशहस्तो महाबलः /
श्वेतश् च जयभद्रश् च दीर्घबाहुर्जलान्तकः(3) //
84.m: Bala, Atibala, Pāśahasta, Mahābala, / Śveta, Jayabhadra, Dīrghabāhu, Jalāntaka,

84.s:
vaḍavāsyaś ca bhīmaś ca daśaite vāruṇāḥ smṛtāḥ /
śīghro laghurvāyuvegaḥ sūkṣmastīkṣṇaḥ kṣapāntakaḥ //
84.d:
वडवास्यश् च भीमश् च दशैते वारुणाः स्मृताः /
शीघ्रो लघुर्वायुवेगः सूक्ष्मस्तीक्ष्णः क्षपान्तकः //
84.m: Vaḍavāsya, and Bhīma—these ten are recorded as belonging to Varuṇa. / Śīghra, Laghu, Vāyuvega, Sūkṣma, Tīkṣṇa, Kṣapāntaka,

84.s:
pañcāntakaḥ pañcaśikhaḥ kapardī meghavāhanaḥ /
jaṭāmukuṭadhārī ca nānāratnadharas tathā //
84.d:
पञ्चान्तकः पञ्चशिखः कपर्दी मेघवाहनः /
जटामुकुटधारी च नानारत्नधरस् तथा //
84.m: Pañcāntaka, Pañcaśikha, Kapardin, Meghavāhana, / the bearer of the crown of matted locks, and likewise the bearer of various gems;

84.s:
nidhīśo rūpavān dhanyo saumyadehaḥ prasādakṛt /
prakāśo 'pyatha lakṣmīvān kāmarūpo daśottare //
84.d:
निधीशो रूपवान् धन्यो सौम्यदेहः प्रसादकृत् /
प्रकाशो ऽप्यथ लक्ष्मीवान् कामरूपो दशोत्तरे //
84.m: Nidhīśa, Rūpavat, Dhanya, Saumyadeha, Prasādakṛt, / Prakāśa, Lakṣmīvat, and Kāmarūpa in the north [group of] ten;

84.s:
vidyādharo jñānadharaḥ sarvajño vedapāragaḥ /
mātṛvṛttaś ca piṅgākṣo bhūtapālo balipriyaḥ //
:n
1 pravardhana iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 varuṇa iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 janāntaka iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 263
84.d:
विद्याधरो ज्ञानधरः सर्वज्ञो वेदपारगः /
मातृवृत्तश् च पिङ्गाक्षो भूतपालो बलिप्रियः //
:न्
1 प्रवर्धन इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 वरुण इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 जनान्तक इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 263
84.m:
Vidyādhara, Jñānadhara, Sarvajña, Vedapāraga, / Mātṛvṛtta, Piṅgākṣa, Bhūtapāla, Balipriya,
[Footnotes]
1 "pravardhanaḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
2 "varuṇaḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
3 "janāntakaḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa. / [p. 263]

84.s:
sarvavidyāvidhatā ca sukhaduḥkhaharā daśa /
anantaḥ pālako dhīraḥ(1) pātālādhipatis tathā //
84.d:
सर्वविद्याविधता च सुखदुःखहरा दश /
अनन्तः पालको धीरः(1) पातालाधिपतिस् तथा //
84.m: Sarvavidyāvidhātṛ, and the ten dispellers of pleasure and pain; / Ananta, Pālaka, Dhīra, and the lord of the netherworld;

84.s:
vṛṣo vṛṣadharo vīryo grasanaḥ(2) sarvatomukhaḥ /
lohitaś caiva vijñeyā daśa rudrāḥ phaṇisthitāḥ //
84.d:
वृषो वृषधरो वीर्यो ग्रसनः(2) सर्वतोमुखः /
लोहितश् चैव विज्ञेया दश रुद्राः फणिस्थिताः //
84.m: Vṛṣa, Vṛṣadhara, Vīrya, Grasana, Sarvatomukha, / and Lohita—these are to be known as the ten Rudras residing on the serpent;

84.s:
śambhurvibhurgaṇādhyakṣastryakṣastridaśavanditaḥ /
saṃhāraś ca vihāraś ca lābho lipsurvicakṣaṇaḥ //
84.d:
शम्भुर्विभुर्गणाध्यक्षस्त्र्यक्षस्त्रिदशवन्दितः /
संहारश् च विहारश् च लाभो लिप्सुर्विचक्षणः //
84.m: Śambhu, Vibhu, Gaṇādhyakṣa, Tryakṣa, Tridaśavandita, / Saṃhāra, Vihāra, Lābha, Lipsu, Vicakṣaṇa,

84.s:
attā kuhakakālāgnirudro(3) hāṭaka eva ca /
kuṣmāṇḍaś caiva satyaś ca brahmā viṣṇuś ca saptamaḥ //
84.d:
अत्ता कुहककालाग्निरुद्रो(3) हाटक एव च /
कुष्माण्डश् चैव सत्यश् च ब्रह्मा विष्णुश् च सप्तमः //
84.m: Attṛ, Kuhakakālāgnirudra, and Hāṭaka, / Kuṣmāṇḍa, Satya, Brahmā, and Viṣṇu as the seventh,

84.s:
rudraścāṣṭāvime rudrāḥ kaṭāhābhyantare sthitāḥ /
eteṣāmeva nāmāni bhuvanānāmapi smaret //
84.d:
रुद्रश्चाष्टाविमे रुद्राः कटाहाभ्यन्तरे स्थिताः /
एतेषामेव नामानि भुवनानामपि स्मरेत् //
84.m: and Rudra—these eight are Rudras located within the cosmic shell. / One should contemplate the names of these as the names of the cosmic realms.

84.s:
bhavodbhavaḥ sarvabhūtaḥ sarvabhūtasukhapradaḥ /
sarvasānnidhyakṛd brahmaviṣṇurudraśarārcitaḥ //
saṃstuta pūrvasthita oṃ sākṣin oṃ rudrāntaka oṃ pataṅga oṃ
śabda oṃ sūkṣma oṃ śiva sarvasarvada sarvasānnidhyakara
brahmaviṣṇurudrakara oṃ namaḥ śivāya oṃ namo namaḥ(4)
84.d:
भवोद्भवः सर्वभूतः सर्वभूतसुखप्रदः /
सर्वसान्निध्यकृद् ब्रह्मविष्णुरुद्रशरार्चितः //
संस्तुत पूर्वस्थित ओं साक्षिन् ओं रुद्रान्तक ओं पतङ्ग ओं
शब्द ओं सूक्ष्म ओं शिव सर्वसर्वद सर्वसान्निध्यकर
ब्रह्मविष्णुरुद्रकर ओं नमः शिवाय ओं नमो नमः(4)
84.m:
The Origin of Becoming, Omnipresent Being, Bestower of Happiness on All Beings, / Producer of the Presence of All, Worshipped by the arrows of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Rudra:
"O Praised One, Dwelling in the East, oṃ Witness, oṃ Rudrāntaka, oṃ Sun, oṃ Sound, oṃ Subtle One, oṃ Śiva, Omnipresent Bestower of All, Maker of the Presence of All, Maker of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Rudra, oṃ obeisance to Śiva, oṃ obeisance, obeisance!"

84.s:
aṣṭāviṃśati pādāni vyomavyāpi mano guha /
sadyohṛdastranetrāṇi mantravarṇāṣṭako mataḥ //
:n
1 ghora iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 vīryāprasanna iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 atha śuklakakālāgnirudra iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 anarcita saṃstuta pūrvasthita sākṣin tuṅga 2 pataṅga 2 jñāna 2
śabda sūkṣma śiva sarvada sarvādhyakṣakara brahmaviṣṇurudra oṃ
namaḥ śivāya oṃ namo namaḥ oṃ namaḥ śivāya oṃ namo
namaḥ iti / anarcita saṃstuta pūrvavinda oṃ sākṣiṇa oṃ rudrāntaka
oṃ pataṅga oṃ jñāna oṃ śabda oṃ sūkṣma oṃ śiva oṃ sarva
oṃ sarvada oṃ sarvasānnidhyakara brahmaviṣṇu rudrakara oṃ namaḥ
śivāya oṃ namo nama iti ca, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 264
84.d:
अष्टाविंशति पादानि व्योमव्यापि मनो गुह /
सद्योहृदस्त्रनेत्राणि मन्त्रवर्णाष्टको मतः //
:न्
1 घोर इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 वीर्याप्रसन्न इति ख, ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 अथ शुक्लककालाग्निरुद्र इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 अनर्चित संस्तुत पूर्वस्थित साक्षिन् तुङ्ग 2 पतङ्ग 2 ज्ञान 2
शब्द सूक्ष्म शिव सर्वद सर्वाध्यक्षकर ब्रह्मविष्णुरुद्र ओं
नमः शिवाय ओं नमो नमः ओं नमः शिवाय ओं नमो
नमः इति / अनर्चित संस्तुत पूर्वविन्द ओं साक्षिण ओं रुद्रान्तक
ओं पतङ्ग ओं ज्ञान ओं शब्द ओं सूक्ष्म ओं शिव ओं सर्व
ओं सर्वद ओं सर्वसान्निध्यकर ब्रह्मविष्णु रुद्रकर ओं नमः
शिवाय ओं नमो नम इति च, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 264
84.m:
The twenty-eight feet, Vyomavyāpin, Manas, Guha, / Sadyojāta, Hṛdaya, Astra, and Netra are considered the eightfold mantra syllables.
[Footnotes]
1 "ghoraḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
2 "vīryāprasannaḥ" is the reading in the manuscripts marked kha and ga.
3 "atha śuklakakālāgnirudraḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
4 "anarcita saṃstuta pūrvasthita sākṣin tuṅga 2 pataṅga 2 jñāna 2 śabda sūkṣma śiva sarvada sarvādhyakṣakara brahmaviṣṇurudra oṃ namaḥ śivāya oṃ namo namaḥ oṃ namaḥ śivāya oṃ namo namaḥ" and "anarcita saṃstuta pūrvavinda oṃ sākṣiṇa oṃ rudrāntaka oṃ pataṅga oṃ jñāna oṃ śabda oṃ sūkṣma oṃ śiva oṃ sarva oṃ sarvada oṃ sarvasānnidhyakara brahmaviṣṇu rudrakara oṃ namaḥ śivāya oṃ namo namaḥ" are the readings in the marked manuscripts. / [p. 264]

84.s:
vījākāro makāraś ca(1) nāḍyāviḍāpiṅgalāhvaye /
prāṇāpānāvubhau vāyū ghrāṇopasthau tathendriye //
84.d:
वीजाकारो मकारश् च(1) नाड्याविडापिङ्गलाह्वये /
प्राणापानावुभौ वायू घ्राणोपस्थौ तथेन्द्रिये //
84.m: The seed-form is the letter 'ma', and the two channels are called Iḍā and Piṅgalā; / the two breaths are Prāṇa and Apāna; likewise the two organs of sense and action are the nose and the genitals.

84.s:
gandhastu viṣayaḥ prokto gandhādiguṇapañcake /
pārthivaṃ maṇḍalaṃ pītaṃ vajrāṅgaṃ caturasrakaṃ //
84.d:
गन्धस्तु विषयः प्रोक्तो गन्धादिगुणपञ्चके /
पार्थिवं मण्डलं पीतं वज्राङ्गं चतुरस्रकं //
84.m: Smell is declared to be the sense object among the five qualities of smell and the rest; / the earthly maṇḍala is yellow, marked with a vajra, and four-sided.

84.s:
vistāro yojanānāntu koṭirasya śatāhatā /
atraivāntargatā jñeyā yonayo 'pi caturdaśa //
84.d:
विस्तारो योजनानान्तु कोटिरस्य शताहता /
अत्रैवान्तर्गता ज्ञेया योनयो ऽपि चतुर्दश //
84.m: Its extent in leagues is one hundred times a crore; / and the fourteen wombs of existence should be known to be included right here:

84.s:
prathamā sarvadevānāṃ manvādyā devayonayaḥ /
mṛgapakṣī ca paśavaś caturdhā tu sarīsṛpāḥ //
84.d:
प्रथमा सर्वदेवानां मन्वाद्या देवयोनयः /
मृगपक्षी च पशवश् चतुर्धा तु सरीसृपाः //
84.m: The first of all gods, the wombs of the gods beginning with Manu; / beasts and birds, animals, and reptiles of four kinds;

84.s:
sthāvaraṃ pañcamaṃ sarvaṃ yoniḥ ṣaṣṭhī amānuṣī(2) /
paiśācaṃ rākṣasaṃ yākṣaṃ gāndharvaṃ caindrameva ca //
84.d:
स्थावरं पञ्चमं सर्वं योनिः षष्ठी अमानुषी(2) /
पैशाचं राक्षसं याक्षं गान्धर्वं चैन्द्रमेव च //
84.m: immobile beings form the fifth entirely; the sixth womb is the non-human: / of ghosts, demons, yakṣas, gandharvas, and that of Indra,

84.s:
saumyaṃ prāṇeśvaraṃ(3) brāhmamaṣṭamaṃ parikīrtitaṃ /
aṣṭānāṃ pārthivantattvamadhikārāspadaṃ mataṃ //
84.d:
सौम्यं प्राणेश्वरं(3) ब्राह्ममष्टमं परिकीर्तितं /
अष्टानां पार्थिवन्तत्त्वमधिकारास्पदं मतं //
84.m: of Soma, of the lord of breaths, and that of Brahmā is declared the eighth; / the earthly reality is considered the seat of authority for the eight.

84.s:
layastu prakṛtau buddhau bhogo brahmā ca kāraṇaṃ /
tato jāgradavasthānaiḥ samastair bhuvanādibhiḥ //
84.d:
लयस्तु प्रकृतौ बुद्धौ भोगो ब्रह्मा च कारणं /
ततो जाग्रदवस्थानैः समस्तैर् भुवनादिभिः //
84.m: Absorption is in the primal nature; experience is in the intellect; and Brahmā is the instrumental cause; / then, through the waking state, through all cosmic realms and the rest,

84.s:
nivṛttiṃ garbhitāṃ dhyātvā svamantreṇa niyojya ca /
oṃ hāṃ hrūṃ hāṃ(4) nivṛttikalāpāśāya hūṃ phaṭ tata
oṃ hāṃ hāṃ(5) nivṛttikalāpāśāya
svāhetyanenāṅkuśamudrayā pūrakeṇākṛṣya oṃ hrūṃ
hrāṃ hrūṃ(6) nivṛttikalāpāśāya hūṃ phaḍityanena
saṃhāramudrayā kumbhakenādhaḥ-[!!!]
:n
1 vījoṅkāro makaraśceti ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 yoniḥ ṣaṣṭhī sumānuṣī iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ /
yoniḥ ṣaṣṭīṣu mānuṣī iti ga, ṅa,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 prajeśvaramiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 oṃ hāṃ hūṃ hāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
5 tata oṃ hāṃ hāṃ hāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
6 oṃ hūṃ hrūṃ hūmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 265
84.d:
निवृत्तिं गर्भितां ध्यात्वा स्वमन्त्रेण नियोज्य च /
ओं हां ह्रूं हां(4) निवृत्तिकलापाशाय हूं फट् तत
ओं हां हां(5) निवृत्तिकलापाशाय
स्वाहेत्यनेनाङ्कुशमुद्रया पूरकेणाकृष्य ओं ह्रूं
ह्रां ह्रूं(6) निवृत्तिकलापाशाय हूं फडित्यनेन
संहारमुद्रया कुम्भकेनाधः-[!!!]
:न्
1 वीजोङ्कारो मकरश्चेति ग, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 योनिः षष्ठी सुमानुषी इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः /
योनिः षष्टीषु मानुषी इति ग, ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 प्रजेश्वरमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 ओं हां हूं हामिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
5 तत ओं हां हां हामिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
6 ओं हूं ह्रूं हूमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 265
84.m:
having contemplated Nivṛtti as enclosed within, and having joined it with its own mantra,
with "oṃ hāṃ hrūṃ hāṃ to the cord of Nivṛttikalā hūṃ phaṭ", then drawing it forth by inhalation with the ritual gesture of the elephant hook reciting "oṃ hāṃ hāṃ to the cord of Nivṛttikalā svāhā", [and] with "oṃ hrūṃ hrāṃ hrūṃ to the cord of Nivṛttikalā hūṃ phaṭ", by retention with the gesture of dissolution downwards-[…]
[Footnotes]
1 "vījoṅkāro makaraśceti" is the reading in the manuscripts marked ga and ṅa.
2 "yoniḥ ṣaṣṭhī sumānuṣī" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
"yoniḥ ṣaṣṭīṣu mānuṣī" is the reading in the manuscripts marked ga and ṅa.
3 "prajeśvaram" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
4 "oṃ hāṃ hūṃ hām" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
5 "tata oṃ hāṃ hāṃ hām" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
6 "oṃ hūṃ hrūṃ hūm" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha. / [p. 265]

84.s:
sthānādādāya oṃ oṃ hrāṃ hāṃ(1) nivṛttikalāpāśāya nama
ity anenodbhavamudrayā recakena kumbhe saṃsthāpya oṃ hāṃ
nivṛttikalāpāśāya nama ity anenārghyaṃ datvā sampūjya vimukhenaiva
svāhāntenai sannidhānāyāhutitrayaṃ santarpaṇāhutitrayaṃ ca datvā
oṃ hāṃ brahmaṇe nama iti brahmāṇamāvāhya sampūjya ca
svāhāntena santarpya
brahman tavādhikāre 'smin mumukṣuṃ dokṣyayāmyahaṃ //
84.d:
स्थानादादाय ओं ओं ह्रां हां(1) निवृत्तिकलापाशाय नम
इत्य् अनेनोद्भवमुद्रया रेचकेन कुम्भे संस्थाप्य ओं हां
निवृत्तिकलापाशाय नम इत्य् अनेनार्घ्यं दत्वा सम्पूज्य विमुखेनैव
स्वाहान्तेनै सन्निधानायाहुतित्रयं सन्तर्पणाहुतित्रयं च दत्वा
ओं हां ब्रह्मणे नम इति ब्रह्माणमावाह्य सम्पूज्य च
स्वाहान्तेन सन्तर्प्य
ब्रह्मन् तवाधिकारे ऽस्मिन् मुमुक्षुं दोक्ष्ययाम्यहं //
84.m:
Taking it from its place with “Oṃ oṃ hrāṃ hāṃ, obeisance to the fetter of the sphere of nivṛtti,” having deposited it in the pot by means of the gesture of arising (udbhavamudrā) during exhalation, having offered an arghya with “Oṃ hāṃ, obeisance to the fetter of the sphere of nivṛtti,” having worshipped it, having given three oblations for presence with an aversion [of the face] and ending in svāhā, and three satiating oblations, and having invoked Brahmā with “Oṃ hāṃ, obeisance to Brahmā,” having worshipped him and satiated him with mantras ending in svāhā,
“O Brahmā, in this jurisdiction of yours, I am going to initiate a seeker of liberation.

84.s:
bhāvyaṃ tvayānukūlena vidhiṃ vijñāpayediti /
āvāhayettato devīṃ rakṣāṃ vāgīśvarīṃ hṛdā //
84.d:
भाव्यं त्वयानुकूलेन विधिं विज्ञापयेदिति /
आवाहयेत्ततो देवीं रक्षां वागीश्वरीं हृदा //
84.m: You ought to be favorable.” He should inform the Creator in this way. / Then he should invoke the goddess Vāgīśvarī as protection using the heart mantra.

84.s:
icchājñānakriyārūpāṃ ṣaḍvidhāṃ hy ekakāraṇaṃ /
pūjayettarpayeddevīṃ prakāreṇāmunā tataḥ //
84.d:
इच्छाज्ञानक्रियारूपां षड्विधां ह्य् एककारणं /
पूजयेत्तर्पयेद्देवीं प्रकारेणामुना ततः //
84.m: Having the nature of will, knowledge, and action, sixfold, yet a single cause; / then he should worship and satiate the goddess in this manner.

84.s:
vāgīśvarīṃ viniḥśeṣayonivikṣobhakāraṇaṃ /
hṛtsampuṭārthavījādihūṃ phaḍantaśarāṇunā //
84.d:
वागीश्वरीं विनिःशेषयोनिविक्षोभकारणं /
हृत्सम्पुटार्थवीजादिहूं फडन्तशराणुना //
84.m: Vāgīśvarī, the cause of agitating all wombs without exception; / with the arrow-mantra ending in hūṃ phaṭ, containing the seed-syllables in the enclosure of the heart,

84.s:
tāḍayeddhṛdaye tasya praviśetsa(2) vidhānavit /
tataḥ śiṣyasya caitanyaṃ hṛdi vahnikaṇopamaṃ //
84.d:
ताडयेद्धृदये तस्य प्रविशेत्स(2) विधानवित् /
ततः शिष्यस्य चैतन्यं हृदि वह्निकणोपमं //
84.m: the knower of rites should strike him in the heart and enter [it]. / Then the consciousness of the pupil, resembling a spark of fire in the heart,

84.s:
nivṛttisthaṃ yutaṃ pāśair jyeṣṭhayā vibhajedyathā /
oṃ hāṃ hūṃ haḥ hūṃ phaṭoṃ hāṃ svāhetyanenātha pūrakeṇāṅkuśamudrayā //
84.d:
निवृत्तिस्थं युतं पाशैर् ज्येष्ठया विभजेद्यथा /
ओं हां हूं हः हूं फटों हां स्वाहेत्यनेनाथ पूरकेणाङ्कुशमुद्रया //
84.m: situated in nivṛtti, bound by fetters, he should divide as [prescribed] by Jyeṣṭhā; / then with “Oṃ hāṃ hūṃ haḥ hūṃ phaṭ oṃ hāṃ svāhā,” during inhalation, with the hook gesture (aṅkuśamudrā),

84.s:
tadākṛṣya svamantreṇa gṛhītvā.atmani yojayet /
oṃ hāṃ hrūṃ hāṃ(3) ātmane namaḥ
pitrorvibhāvya saṃyogaṃ caitanyaṃ recakena tat //
84.d:
तदाकृष्य स्वमन्त्रेण गृहीत्वा.अत्मनि योजयेत् /
ओं हां ह्रूं हां(3) आत्मने नमः
पित्रोर्विभाव्य संयोगं चैतन्यं रेचकेन तत् //
84.m:
having drawn it forth, having grasped it with his own mantra, he should unite it with himself:
“Oṃ hāṃ hrūṃ hāṃ, obeisance to the Self.”
Contemplating the union of the parents, that consciousness, by means of exhalation,

84.s:
brahmādikāraṇatyāgakramānnītvā śivāspadaṃ /
:n
1 oṃ hūṃ hrīṃ hāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 praviśyecceti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 oṃ hāṃ hāṃ kṣaṃ hāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 266
garbhādhānārthamādāya yugapat sarvayoniṣu //
84.d:
ब्रह्मादिकारणत्यागक्रमान्नीत्वा शिवास्पदं /
:न्
1 ओं हूं ह्रीं हामिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 प्रविश्येच्चेति ख, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 ओं हां हां क्षं हामिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 266
गर्भाधानार्थमादाय युगपत् सर्वयोनिषु //
84.m:
having led it in sequence through the abandonment of the causal deities beginning with Brahmā to the abode of Śiva,
[Note]
1. In the manuscript marked kha, the reading is “oṃ hūṃ hrīṃ hāṃ”.
2. In the manuscripts marked kha and ṅa, the reading is “praviśyec ca”.
3. In the manuscript marked kha, the reading is “oṃ hāṃ hāṃ kṣaṃ hāṃ”.
taking it for the sake of conception simultaneously in all wombs,

84.s:
kṣipedvāgīśvarīyonau vāmayodbhavamudrayā /
oṃ hāṃ hāṃ hāṃ ātmane namaḥ(1)
pūjayedapyanenaiva tarpayedapi pañcadhā //
84.d:
क्षिपेद्वागीश्वरीयोनौ वामयोद्भवमुद्रया /
ओं हां हां हां आत्मने नमः(1)
पूजयेदप्यनेनैव तर्पयेदपि पञ्चधा //
84.m:
he should deposit it in the womb of Vāgīśvarī by means of the Vāmā and the gesture of arising:
“Oṃ hāṃ hāṃ hāṃ, obeisance to the Self.”
With this very [mantra] he should worship and satiate five times.

84.s:
anyayoniṣu sarvāsu dehaśuddhiṃ hṛdā caret /
nātra puṃsavanaṃ stryādiśarīrasyāpi sambhavāt //
84.d:
अन्ययोनिषु सर्वासु देहशुद्धिं हृदा चरेत् /
नात्र पुंसवनं स्त्र्यादिशरीरस्यापि सम्भवात् //
84.m: In all other wombs, he should perform the purification of the body with the heart-mantra. / Here there is no rite of quickening a male (puṃsavana), since female and other bodies also occur.

84.s:
sīmantonnayanaṃ vāpi daivānyaṅgāni dehavat /
śirasā janma kurvīta jugupsan sarvadehināṃ //
84.d:
सीमन्तोन्नयनं वापि दैवान्यङ्गानि देहवत् /
शिरसा जन्म कुर्वीत जुगुप्सन् सर्वदेहिनां //
84.m: Nor the parting of the hair (sīmantonnayana); the other bodily parts are divine like the body. / He should effect birth with the head-mantra, despising [the births] of all embodied beings.

84.s:
tathaiva bhāvayedeṣāmadhikāraṃ śivāṇunā(2) /
bhogaṃ kavacamantreṇa śastreṇa viṣayātmanā //
84.d:
तथैव भावयेदेषामधिकारं शिवाणुना(2) /
भोगं कवचमन्त्रेण शस्त्रेण विषयात्मना //
84.m: Likewise, he should contemplate their jurisdiction with the Śiva-mantra, / worldly experience with the armor-mantra, and with the weapon-mantra having the nature of sense objects,

84.s:
moharūpamabhedaś ca layasajñaṃ vibhāvayet /
śivena śrotasāṃ śuddhiṃ hṛdā tattvaviśodhanaṃ //
84.d:
मोहरूपमभेदश् च लयसज्ञं विभावयेत् /
शिवेन श्रोतसां शुद्धिं हृदा तत्त्वविशोधनं //
84.m: he should contemplate the state called dissolution as having the form of delusion and non-differentiation; / with the Śiva-mantra, the purification of the channels; and with the heart-mantra, the purification of the cosmic principles.

84.s:
pañca pañcāhutīḥ kuryāt(3) garbhādhānādiṣu kramāt /
māyayā malakarmādipāśabandhanivṛttaye //
84.d:
पञ्च पञ्चाहुतीः कुर्यात्(3) गर्भाधानादिषु क्रमात् /
मायया मलकर्मादिपाशबन्धनिवृत्तये //
84.m: He should offer five oblations each in sequence at the rites of conception and the rest, / for the cessation of the bondage of fetters such as impurity and karma caused by māyā.

84.s:
niṣkṛtyaiva hṛdā paścād yajeta śatamāhutīḥ /
malaśaktinirodhena pāśānāñca viyojanaṃ //
84.d:
निष्कृत्यैव हृदा पश्चाद् यजेत शतमाहुतीः /
मलशक्तिनिरोधेन पाशानाञ्च वियोजनं //
84.m: After this expiation, he should subsequently sacrifice a hundred oblations with the heart-mantra. / By blocking the power of impurity, the detachment of the fetters [is achieved].

84.s:
svāhāntāyudhamantreṇa pañcapañcāhutīryajet /
māyādyantasya pāśasya saptavārāstrajaptayā //
84.d:
स्वाहान्तायुधमन्त्रेण पञ्चपञ्चाहुतीर्यजेत् /
मायाद्यन्तस्य पाशस्य सप्तवारास्त्रजप्तया //
84.m: With the weapon-mantra ending in svāhā, he should sacrifice five oblations each. / For the fetter whose beginning and end are māyā, with [the scissors] consecrated seven times with the weapon-mantra,

84.s:
kartaryā chedanaṃ kuryāt kalpaśastreṇa tadyathā /
oṃ hūṃ nivṛttikalāpāśāya hūṃ phaṭ
:n
1 oṃ haṃ haṃ hāṃ ātmane nama iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 śikhātmane kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 pañcapañcāhutīrdadyāditi ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 267
bandhakatvañca nirvartya hastābhyāñca śarāṇunā(1) //
84.d:
कर्तर्या छेदनं कुर्यात् कल्पशस्त्रेण तद्यथा /
ओं हूं निवृत्तिकलापाशाय हूं फट्
:न्
1 ओं हं हं हां आत्मने नम इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 शिखात्मने ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 पञ्चपञ्चाहुतीर्दद्यादिति ग, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 267
बन्धकत्वञ्च निर्वर्त्य हस्ताभ्याञ्च शराणुना(1) //
84.m:
he should cut it with scissors as the ritual weapon, in this manner:
“Oṃ hūṃ, to the fetter of the sphere of nivṛtti, hūṃ phaṭ.”
[Note]
1. In the manuscript marked kha, the reading is “oṃ haṃ haṃ hāṃ ātmane namaḥ”.
2. In the manuscript marked kha, the reading is “śikhātmanā”.
3. In the manuscripts marked ga and ṅa, the reading is “pañcapañcāhutīr dadyāt”.
And having removed the binding power with both hands and the arrow-mantra,

84.s:
visṛjya vartulīkṛtya ghṛtapūrṇe sruve dharet /
dahedanukalāstreṇa kevalāstreṇa bhasmasāt //
84.d:
विसृज्य वर्तुलीकृत्य घृतपूर्णे स्रुवे धरेत् /
दहेदनुकलास्त्रेण केवलास्त्रेण भस्मसात् //
84.m: having released it and rolled it into a ball, he should place it in a ladle filled with clarified butter. / He should burn it to ashes with the secondary sphere-weapon and with the pure weapon-mantra.

84.s:
kuryāt pañcāhutīrdatvā pāśāṅkuśanivṛttaye /
oṃ haḥ astrāya hūṃ phaṭ
prāyaścittaṃ tataḥ kuryādastrāhutibhiraṣṭabhiḥ //
84.d:
कुर्यात् पञ्चाहुतीर्दत्वा पाशाङ्कुशनिवृत्तये /
ओं हः अस्त्राय हूं फट्
प्रायश्चित्तं ततः कुर्यादस्त्राहुतिभिरष्टभिः //
84.m:
Having offered five oblations for the removal of the goad of fetters, he should do:
“Oṃ haḥ, to the weapon, hūṃ phaṭ.”
Then he should perform expiation with eight oblations of the weapon-mantra.

84.s:
athāvāhya vidhātāraṃ pūjayettarpayettathā /
tata oṃ hāṃ śabdasparśaśuddhabrahman gṛhāṇa
svāhetyāhutitrayeṇādhikāramasya samarpayet
dagdhaniḥśeṣapāpasya(2) brahmannasya paśostvayā //
84.d:
अथावाह्य विधातारं पूजयेत्तर्पयेत्तथा /
तत ओं हां शब्दस्पर्शशुद्धब्रह्मन् गृहाण
स्वाहेत्याहुतित्रयेणाधिकारमस्य समर्पयेत्
दग्धनिःशेषपापस्य(2) ब्रह्मन्नस्य पशोस्त्वया //
84.m:
Then, having invoked the Creator, he should worship and satiate him likewise.
Then, with three oblations, “Oṃ hāṃ, O Brahmā purified of sound and touch, accept, svāhā,” he should surrender his jurisdiction [over the soul]:
“O Brahmā, of this bound soul whose sins have been entirely burnt away,

84.s:
bandhāya na punaḥ stheyaṃ śivājñāṃ śrāvayediti /
tato visṛjya dhātāraṃ nāḍyā dakṣiṇayā śanaiḥ //
84.d:
बन्धाय न पुनः स्थेयं शिवाज्ञां श्रावयेदिति /
ततो विसृज्य धातारं नाड्या दक्षिणया शनैः //
84.m: you must not remain any longer for bondage.” He should announce the command of Śiva in this way. / Then, having dismissed the Creator, slowly through the right channel,

84.s:
saṃhāramudrayātmānaṃ kumbhakena nijātmanā /
rāhuyuktaikadeśena candravimbena sannibhaṃ //
84.d:
संहारमुद्रयात्मानं कुम्भकेन निजात्मना /
राहुयुक्तैकदेशेन चन्द्रविम्बेन सन्निभं //
84.m: with the gesture of dissolution (saṃhāramudrā), during breath retention, with his own self, / [the soul] resembling the disc of the moon partially eclipsed by Rāhu,

84.s:
ādāya yojayet sūtre recakenodbhavākhyayā /
pūjayitvārghyapātrasthatoyavindusudhopamaṃ //
84.d:
आदाय योजयेत् सूत्रे रेचकेनोद्भवाख्यया /
पूजयित्वार्घ्यपात्रस्थतोयविन्दुसुधोपमं //
84.m: having taken it, he should unite it to the cord during exhalation with the gesture called arising. / Having worshipped it, resembling nectar in drops of water in the arghya vessel,

84.s:
visṛjya pitarau dadyādvauṣaḍantaśivāṇunā /
pūraṇāya vidhiḥ pūrṇā nivṛttiriti śodhitā //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye nirvāṇadīkṣāyāṃ
nivṛttikalāśodhanaṃ nāma caturaśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 śivātmaneti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 dagdhaniḥśeṣapāśasya iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 268
:ś atha pañcāśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
pratiṣṭhākalāśodhanoktiḥ
84.d:
विसृज्य पितरौ दद्याद्वौषडन्तशिवाणुना /
पूरणाय विधिः पूर्णा निवृत्तिरिति शोधिता //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये निर्वाणदीक्षायां
निवृत्तिकलाशोधनं नाम चतुरशीतितमो ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 शिवात्मनेति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 दग्धनिःशेषपाशस्य इति ख, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 268
:श् अथ पञ्चाशीतितमो ऽध्यायः
प्रतिष्ठाकलाशोधनोक्तिः
84.m:
having dismissed the parents, he should give [oblations] with the Śiva-mantra ending in vauṣaṭ. / For completion, the rite is completed; thus the sphere of nivṛtti has been purified.
Thus ends the eighty-fourth chapter, entitled “The Purification of the Sphere of Nivṛtti in the Liberating Initiation,” in the venerable and great Āgneya Purāṇa.
[Note]
1. In the manuscript marked kha, the reading is “śivātmanā”.
2. In the manuscripts marked kha and ṅa, the reading is “dagdhaniḥśeṣapāśasya”.
Now, eighty-fifth chapter:
Statement of the purification of the sphere of pratiṣṭhā.

85.s:
īśvara uvāca
tattvayoratha sandhānaṃ kuryācchuddhaviśuddhayoḥ /
hrasvadīrghaprayogeṇa nādanādāntasaṅginā //
85.d:
ईश्वर उवाच
तत्त्वयोरथ सन्धानं कुर्याच्छुद्धविशुद्धयोः /
ह्रस्वदीर्घप्रयोगेण नादनादान्तसङ्गिना //
85.m: The Lord said: / Then one should effect the junction of the two principles, the pure and the purified, / by the use of the short and long [vowels] accompanied by resonance and the end of resonance:

85.s:
oṃ hāṃ hrūṃ hāṃ(1)aptejo vāyurākāśaṃ tanmātrendriyabuddhayaḥ /
guṇatrayamahaṅkāraś caturviṃśaḥ pumāniti //
85.d:
ओं हां ह्रूं हां(1)अप्तेजो वायुराकाशं तन्मात्रेन्द्रियबुद्धयः /
गुणत्रयमहङ्कारश् चतुर्विंशः पुमानिति //
85.m: “Oṃ hāṃ hrūṃ hāṃ.” Water, fire, wind, space, the subtle elements, sense organs, intellect, / the three guṇas, egoity, and the twenty-fourth, the soul—

85.s:
pratiṣṭhāyāṃ niviṣṭhāni tattvānyetāni bhāvayet /
pañcaviṃśatisaṅkhyāni khādiyāntākṣarāṇi ca //
85.d:
प्रतिष्ठायां निविष्ठानि तत्त्वान्येतानि भावयेत् /
पञ्चविंशतिसङ्ख्यानि खादियान्ताक्षराणि च //
85.m: he should contemplate these cosmic principles as deposited in the sphere of pratiṣṭhā, / twenty-five in number, and the letters beginning with kha and ending with ya.

85.s:
pañcāśadadhikā ṣaṣṭirbhuvanaistulyasañjñitāḥ /
tāvanta eva rudrāś ca vijñeyāstatra tadyathā //
85.d:
पञ्चाशदधिका षष्टिर्भुवनैस्तुल्यसञ्ज्ञिताः /
तावन्त एव रुद्राश् च विज्ञेयास्तत्र तद्यथा //
85.m: There are sixty plus fifty [worlds] identically designated with the worlds; / just so many Rudras are to be known there, namely:

85.s:
amareśaḥ prabhāvaś ca nemiṣaḥ puṣkaro 'pi ca /
tathā pādiś ca daṇḍiś ca bhāvabhūtirathāṣṭamaḥ //
85.d:
अमरेशः प्रभावश् च नेमिषः पुष्करो ऽपि च /
तथा पादिश् च दण्डिश् च भावभूतिरथाष्टमः //
85.m: Amareśa, Prabhāva, Nemiṣa, and Puṣkara, / likewise Pādin, Daṇḍin, and Bhāvabhūti as the eighth;

85.s:
nakulīśo hariś candraḥ śrīśailo daśamaḥ smṛtaḥ /
anvīśo 'srātikeśaś ca(2) mahākālo 'tha madhyamaḥ //
85.d:
नकुलीशो हरिश् चन्द्रः श्रीशैलो दशमः स्मृतः /
अन्वीशो ऽस्रातिकेशश् च(2) महाकालो ऽथ मध्यमः //
85.m: Nakulīśa, Hariścandra, and Śrīśaila is recorded as the tenth; / Anvīśa, Asrātikeśa, Mahākāla, then Madhyama;

85.s:
kedāro bhairavaś caiva dvitīyāṣṭakamīritaṃ /
tato gayākurukṣetrakhalānādikanādike //
85.d:
केदारो भैरवश् चैव द्वितीयाष्टकमीरितं /
ततो गयाकुरुक्षेत्रखलानादिकनादिके //
85.m: Kedāra and Bhairava: thus the second group of eight has been declared. / Then Gayā, Kurukṣetra, Khalanādika, Nādika,

85.s:
vimalaścāṭṭahāsaś ca(3) mahendro bhāma eva ca /
vasvāpadaṃ rudrakoṭiraviyukto mahāvantaḥ //
85.d:
विमलश्चाट्टहासश् च(3) महेन्द्रो भाम एव च /
वस्वापदं रुद्रकोटिरवियुक्तो महावन्तः //
85.m: Vimala, Aṭṭahāsa, Mahendra, Bhāma, / Vasvāpada, Rudrakoṭi, Aviyukta, Mahāvant;

85.s:
gokarṇo bhadrakarṇaś ca svarṇākṣaḥ sthāṇureva ca /
ajeśaś caiva sarvajño bhāsvaraḥ sūdanāntaraḥ //
85.d:
गोकर्णो भद्रकर्णश् च स्वर्णाक्षः स्थाणुरेव च /
अजेशश् चैव सर्वज्ञो भास्वरः सूदनान्तरः //
85.m: Gokarṇa, Bhadrakarṇa, Svarṇākṣa, Sthāṇu, / Ajeśa, Sarvajña, Bhāsvara, and Sūdanāntara;

85.s:
subāhurmattarūpī ca viśālo jaṭilas tathā /
:n
1 oṃ hāṃ hūṃ hūṃ hāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 alpīśo bhrāntikeśaśceti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 vimalaś caṇḍahāsaśceti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 269
raudro 'tha piṅgalākṣaś ca kāladaṃṣṭrī bhavettataḥ //
85.d:
सुबाहुर्मत्तरूपी च विशालो जटिलस् तथा /
:न्
1 ओं हां हूं हूं हामिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 अल्पीशो भ्रान्तिकेशश्चेति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 विमलश् चण्डहासश्चेति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 269
रौद्रो ऽथ पिङ्गलाक्षश् च कालदंष्ट्री भवेत्ततः //
85.m:
Subāhu, Mattarūpin, Viśāla, and Jaṭila,
[Gap in text]
[Note:] The reading in manuscript kha is: 'oṃ hāṃ hūṃ hūṃ hām'.
[Note:] The reading in manuscript ṅa is: 'alpīśo bhrāntikeśaśceti'.
[Note:] The reading in manuscript ṅa is: 'vimalaś caṇḍahāsaśceti'.
Raudra, then Piṅgalākṣa, and then Kāladaṃṣṭrin.

85.s:
viduraś caiva ghoraś ca prājāpatyo hutāśanaḥ /
kāmarūpī tathā kālaḥ karṇo 'pyatha bhayānakaḥ //
85.d:
विदुरश् चैव घोरश् च प्राजापत्यो हुताशनः /
कामरूपी तथा कालः कर्णो ऽप्यथ भयानकः //
85.m: Vidura, Ghora, Prājāpatya, Hutāśana, / Kāmarūpin, Kāla, Karṇa, and Bhayānaka,

85.s:
mataṅgaḥ piṅgalaś caiva haro vai dhātṛsajñakaḥ /
śaṅkukarṇo vidhānaś ca śrīkaṇṭhaś candraśekharaḥ //
85.d:
मतङ्गः पिङ्गलश् चैव हरो वै धातृसज्ञकः /
शङ्कुकर्णो विधानश् च श्रीकण्ठश् चन्द्रशेखरः //
85.m: Mataṅga, Piṅgala, Hara known as Dhātṛ, / Śaṅkukarṇa, Vidhāna, Śrīkaṇṭha, and Candraśekhara:

85.s:
sahaitena ca paryantāḥ kathyante 'tha padānyapi /
vyāpin oṃ arūpa oṃ pramatha oṃ tejaḥ oṃ jyotiḥ oṃ puruṣa
oṃ agne oṃ adhūma oṃ abhasma oṃ anādi oṃ nānā oṃ dhūdhū
oṃ bhūḥ oṃ bhuvaḥ oṃ svaḥ anidhana nidhanodbhava śiva śarva
paramātman maheśvara mahādeva sadbhāveśvara mahātejaḥ
yogādhipataye muñca prathama sarva sarvesarveti dvātriṃśat padāni
vījabhāve trayo mantrā vāmadevaḥ śivaḥ śikhā //
85.d:
सहैतेन च पर्यन्ताः कथ्यन्ते ऽथ पदान्यपि /
व्यापिन् ओं अरूप ओं प्रमथ ओं तेजः ओं ज्योतिः ओं पुरुष
ओं अग्ने ओं अधूम ओं अभस्म ओं अनादि ओं नाना ओं धूधू
ओं भूः ओं भुवः ओं स्वः अनिधन निधनोद्भव शिव शर्व
परमात्मन् महेश्वर महादेव सद्भावेश्वर महातेजः
योगाधिपतये मुञ्च प्रथम सर्व सर्वेसर्वेति द्वात्रिंशत् पदानि
वीजभावे त्रयो मन्त्रा वामदेवः शिवः शिखा //
85.m:
these, ending with this one, are mentioned. Now also the words:
'vyāpin oṃ, arūpa oṃ, pramatha oṃ, tejaḥ oṃ, jyotiḥ oṃ, puruṣa oṃ, agne oṃ, adhūma oṃ, abhasma oṃ, anādi oṃ, nānā oṃ, dhūdhū oṃ, bhūḥ oṃ, bhuvaḥ oṃ, svaḥ, anidhana, nidhanodbhava, śiva, śarva, paramātman, maheśvara, mahādeva, sadbhāveśvara, mahātejaḥ, yogādhipataye muñca prathama sarva sarvesarva'—thus are the thirty-two words.
When in the form of seed-syllables, there are three mantras: Vāmadeva, Śiva, and Śikhā.

85.s:
/
gāndhārī ca suṣumṇā ca nāḍyau dvau mārutau tathā /
/
samānodānanāmānau rasanāpāyurindriye //
85.d:
/
गान्धारी च सुषुम्णा च नाड्यौ द्वौ मारुतौ तथा /
/
समानोदाननामानौ रसनापायुरिन्द्रिये //
85.m: The two channels are Gāndhārī and Suṣumṇā; likewise the two winds / are named Samāna and Udāna; the two sense faculties are tongue and anus.

85.s:
/
rasastu viṣayo rūpaśabdasparśarasā guṇāḥ /
/
maṇḍalaṃ vartulaṃ tacca puṇḍarīkāṅkitaṃ sitaṃ //
85.d:
/
रसस्तु विषयो रूपशब्दस्पर्शरसा गुणाः /
/
मण्डलं वर्तुलं तच्च पुण्डरीकाङ्कितं सितं //
85.m: Taste is the sensory object; form, sound, touch, and taste are the qualities. / The maṇḍala is circular, white, and marked with a lotus.

85.s:
/
svapnāvasthāpratiṣṭhāyāṃ kāraṇaṃ garuḍadhvajaṃ /
/
pratiṣṭhāntakṛtaṃ sarvaṃ sañcintya bhuvanādikaṃ //
85.d:
/
स्वप्नावस्थाप्रतिष्ठायां कारणं गरुडध्वजं /
/
प्रतिष्ठान्तकृतं सर्वं सञ्चिन्त्य भुवनादिकं //
85.m: In the Pratiṣṭhā[-kalā], the state is dream; the causal deity is Garuḍadhvaja (Viṣṇu). / Contemplating everything up to Pratiṣṭhā, the worlds and so forth,

85.s:
/
sūtraṃ dehe svamantreṇa praviśyaināṃ viyojayet /
/
oṃ hāṃ khīṃ hāṃ pratiṣṭhākalāpāśāya oṃ phaṭ
svāhāntenānainaiva pūrakeṇāṅkuśamudrayā samākarṣet tataḥ
oṃ hāṃ hrūṃ hrāṃ hrūṃ(1) pratiṣṭhā kalāpāśāya
hrūṃ phaḍityanena saṃhāramudrayā kumbhakena hṛdayādadho
nāḍī-[!!!]
:n
1 oṃ hrīṃ hraṃ hāṃ hūṃ iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 270
sūtrādādāya oṃ hāṃ hrūṃ hrāṃ hāṃ(1)
pratiṣṭhākalāpāśāya nama ity anenodbhavamudrayā recakena kumbhe
samāropayet oṃ hāṃ hrīṃ pratiṣṭhākalāpāśāya nama ity
anenārcayitvā sampūjya svāhāntenāhutīnāṃ trayeṇa sannidhāya
tataḥ oṃ hāṃ viṣṇave nama iti viṣṇumāvāhya sampūjya
santarpya
viṣṇo tavādhikāre 'smin mumukṣuṃ dīkṣayāmyahaṃ //
85.d:
/
सूत्रं देहे स्वमन्त्रेण प्रविश्यैनां वियोजयेत् /
/
ओं हां खीं हां प्रतिष्ठाकलापाशाय ओं फट्
स्वाहान्तेनानैनैव पूरकेणाङ्कुशमुद्रया समाकर्षेत् ततः
ओं हां ह्रूं ह्रां ह्रूं(1) प्रतिष्ठा कलापाशाय
ह्रूं फडित्यनेन संहारमुद्रया कुम्भकेन हृदयादधो
नाडी-[!!!]
:न्
1 ओं ह्रीं ह्रं हां हूं इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 270
सूत्रादादाय ओं हां ह्रूं ह्रां हां(1)
प्रतिष्ठाकलापाशाय नम इत्य् अनेनोद्भवमुद्रया रेचकेन कुम्भे
समारोपयेत् ओं हां ह्रीं प्रतिष्ठाकलापाशाय नम इत्य्
अनेनार्चयित्वा सम्पूज्य स्वाहान्तेनाहुतीनां त्रयेण सन्निधाय
ततः ओं हां विष्णवे नम इति विष्णुमावाह्य सम्पूज्य
सन्तर्प्य
विष्णो तवाधिकारे ऽस्मिन् मुमुक्षुं दीक्षयाम्यहं //
85.m:
one should enter the thread into the body with its own mantra and detach it.
With 'oṃ hāṃ khīṃ hāṃ pratiṣṭhākalāpāśāya oṃ phaṭ svāhā', one should draw [it] in by inhalation with the elephant-goad gesture. Then, with 'oṃ hāṃ hrūṃ hrāṃ hrūṃ pratiṣṭhākalāpāśāya hrūṃ phaṭ', by retention of breath with the dissolution gesture, taking it from below the heart [through the] channel- […]
[Gap in text]
[Note:] The reading in manuscript kha is: 'oṃ hrīṃ hraṃ hāṃ hūṃ iti'.
taking it from the thread with 'oṃ hāṃ hrūṃ hrāṃ hāṃ pratiṣṭhākalāpāśāya namaḥ', one should deposit it into the pot by exhalation with the manifestation gesture. Having worshipped it with 'oṃ hāṃ hrīṃ pratiṣṭhākalāpāśāya namaḥ', having venerated it, and having brought it into presence with three oblations ending in svāhā; then having invoked Viṣṇu with 'oṃ hāṃ viṣṇave namaḥ', having worshipped him and gratified him:
'O Viṣṇu, in this jurisdiction of yours, I initiate the seeker of liberation.

85.s:
bhāvyaṃ tvayānukūlena viṣṇuṃ vijñāpayediti /
tato vāgīśvarīṃ devīṃ vāgīśamapi pūrvavat //
85.d:
भाव्यं त्वयानुकूलेन विष्णुं विज्ञापयेदिति /
ततो वागीश्वरीं देवीं वागीशमपि पूर्ववत् //
85.m: You must be favorable'—thus one should address Viṣṇu. / Then [having invoked] the goddess Vāgīśvarī and also Vāgīśa as before,

85.s:
āvāhyābhyarcya santarpya śiṣyaṃ vakṣasi tāḍayet /
oṃ hāṃ hāṃ haṃ phaṭ(2)praviśedapyanenaiva caitanyaṃ vibhajettataḥ //
85.d:
आवाह्याभ्यर्च्य सन्तर्प्य शिष्यं वक्षसि ताडयेत् /
ओं हां हां हं फट्(2)प्रविशेदप्यनेनैव चैतन्यं विभजेत्ततः //
85.m: having invoked, worshipped, and gratified them, one should strike the disciple on the chest. / With 'oṃ hāṃ hāṃ haṃ phaṭ' one should enter, and then divide consciousness.

85.s:
śastreṇa pāśasaṃyuktaṃ jyeṣṭayāṅkuśamudrayā /
oṃ hāṃ haṃ hoṃ hrūṃ phaṭ(3)
svāhāntena hṛdākṛṣya tenaiva puṭitātmanā //
85.d:
शस्त्रेण पाशसंयुक्तं ज्येष्टयाङ्कुशमुद्रया /
ओं हां हं हों ह्रूं फट्(3)
स्वाहान्तेन हृदाकृष्य तेनैव पुटितात्मना //
85.m:
With the weapon [mantra], accompanied by bonds, with the foremost elephant-goad gesture,
'oṃ hāṃ haṃ hoṃ hrūṃ phaṭ'—
having drawn it out with the heart [mantra] ending in svāhā, with the soul enclosed by it,

85.s:
gṛhītvā taṃ namontena nijātmani niyojayet(4) /
oṃ hāṃ haṃ hoṃ (5) ātmane namaḥ
pūrvavat pitṛsaṃyogaṃ bhāvayitvodbhavākhyayā(6) //
85.d:
गृहीत्वा तं नमोन्तेन निजात्मनि नियोजयेत्(4) /
ओं हां हं हों (5) आत्मने नमः
पूर्ववत् पितृसंयोगं भावयित्वोद्भवाख्यया(6) //
85.m:
having taken it, one should unite it with one's own soul with [the mantra] ending in namaḥ:
'oṃ hāṃ haṃ hoṃ ātmane namaḥ'.
Having visualized the union of the parents as before, with the [gesture] called manifestation,

85.s:
vāmayā tadanenaiva devīgarbhe vinikṣipet /
oṃ hāṃ haṃ hāṃ ātmane namaḥ
dehotpattau hṛdā hy evaṃ śirasā janmanā tathā //
:n
1 oṃ hūṃ hrāṃ hāṃ iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 oṃ hāṃ haṃ hāṃ haḥ phaṭ iti kha, ṅa,
cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
3 oṃ hāṃ haṃ hāṃ hūṃ phaṭ iti kha,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 nivedayediti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
5 oṃ hāṃ haṃ hāṃ iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
6 bhāvayitvā tu dakṣayeti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 271
85.d:
वामया तदनेनैव देवीगर्भे विनिक्षिपेत् /
ओं हां हं हां आत्मने नमः
देहोत्पत्तौ हृदा ह्य् एवं शिरसा जन्मना तथा //
:न्
1 ओं हूं ह्रां हां इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 ओं हां हं हां हः फट् इति ख, ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
3 ओं हां हं हां हूं फट् इति ख,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 निवेदयेदिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
5 ओं हां हं हां इति ख, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
6 भावयित्वा तु दक्षयेति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 271
85.m:
one should deposit it into the womb of the goddess with the left [hand] using this [mantra]:
'oṃ hāṃ haṃ hāṃ ātmane namaḥ'.
For the production of the body, [one offers] thus with the heart [mantra]; likewise for birth, with the head [mantra];
[Gap in text]
[Note:] The reading in manuscript kha is: 'oṃ hūṃ hrāṃ hām'.
[Note:] The reading in the two manuscripts kha and ṅa is: 'oṃ hāṃ haṃ hāṃ haḥ phaṭ'.
[Note:] The reading in manuscript kha is: 'oṃ hāṃ haṃ hāṃ hūṃ phaṭ'.
[Note:] The reading in manuscript kha is: 'nivedayediti'.
[Note:] The reading in the manuscripts kha and ṅa is: 'oṃ hāṃ haṃ hām'.
[Note:] The reading in manuscript kha is: 'bhāvayitvā tu dakṣayā'.

85.s:
śikhayā vādhikārāya bhogāya kavacāṇunā /
tattvaśuddhau hṛdā hy evaṃ garbhādhānāya pūrvavat //
85.d:
शिखया वाधिकाराय भोगाय कवचाणुना /
तत्त्वशुद्धौ हृदा ह्य् एवं गर्भाधानाय पूर्ववत् //
85.m: with the crest [mantra] for qualification; for experience, with the armour mantra; / for purification of principles, with the heart [mantra]; likewise for insemination as before;

85.s:
śirasā pāśaśaithilye niṣkṛtyaivaṃ śataṃ japet /
evaṃ pāśaviyoge 'pi tataḥ śāstrajaptayā //
85.d:
शिरसा पाशशैथिल्ये निष्कृत्यैवं शतं जपेत् /
एवं पाशवियोगे ऽपि ततः शास्त्रजप्तया //
85.m: with the head [mantra] for loosening the bonds; having made expiation thus, one should recite a hundred times. / Thus also at the severance of bonds, with [the scissors] consecrated by the weapon [mantra],

85.s:
chindyādastreṇa kartaryā kalāvījavatā yathā /
oṃ hrīṃ pratiṣṭhākalāpāśāya haḥ phaṭ
visṛjya vartulīkṛtya(1) pāśamantreṇa pūrvavat //
85.d:
छिन्द्यादस्त्रेण कर्तर्या कलावीजवता यथा /
ओं ह्रीं प्रतिष्ठाकलापाशाय हः फट्
विसृज्य वर्तुलीकृत्य(1) पाशमन्त्रेण पूर्ववत् //
85.m:
one should cut with scissors through the weapon [mantra] possessed of the kalā seed-syllable, as [prescribed]:
'oṃ hrīṃ pratiṣṭhākalāpāśāya haḥ phaṭ'.
Having discarded it and made it into a ball, with the bond mantra as before,

85.s:
ghṛtapūrṇe śrave datvā kalāstreṇaiva homayet /
astreṇa juhuyāt pañca pāśāṅkuranivṛttaye //
85.d:
घृतपूर्णे श्रवे दत्वा कलास्त्रेणैव होमयेत् /
अस्त्रेण जुहुयात् पञ्च पाशाङ्कुरनिवृत्तये //
85.m: placing it on a ladle full of clarified butter, one should offer it into the fire with the weapon mantra of the kalā. / One should offer five [oblations] with the weapon [mantra] to eradicate the sprout of the bonds.

85.s:
prāyaścittaniṣedhārthaṃ dadyādaṣṭāhutīstataḥ /
oṃ haḥ astrāya hrūṃ phaṭhṛdāvāhya hṛṣīkeśaṃ kṛtvā pūjatarpaṇe //
85.d:
प्रायश्चित्तनिषेधार्थं दद्यादष्टाहुतीस्ततः /
ओं हः अस्त्राय ह्रूं फठृदावाह्य हृषीकेशं कृत्वा पूजतर्पणे //
85.m: Then, to ward off expiation, one should offer eight oblations. / Having invoked Hṛṣīkeśa (Viṣṇu) into the heart with 'oṃ haḥ astrāya hrūṃ phaṭ', having performed worship and gratifications,

85.s:
pūrvoktavidhinā kuryādadhikārasamarpaṇaṃ /
oṃ hāṃ rasaśulkaṃ gṛhāṇa svāhā
niḥśeṣadagdhapāśasya paśorasya hare tvayā //
85.d:
पूर्वोक्तविधिना कुर्यादधिकारसमर्पणं /
ओं हां रसशुल्कं गृहाण स्वाहा
निःशेषदग्धपाशस्य पशोरस्य हरे त्वया //
85.m:
one should surrender authority according to the prescribed procedure:
'oṃ hāṃ receive the fee of taste, svāhā'.
'For this bound soul whose bonds are completely burned away, O Hari,

85.s:
na stheyaṃ bandhakatvena śivājñāṃ śrāvayediti /
tato visṛjya govindaṃ vidyātmānaṃ niyojya ca //
85.d:
न स्थेयं बन्धकत्वेन शिवाज्ञां श्रावयेदिति /
ततो विसृज्य गोविन्दं विद्यात्मानं नियोज्य च //
85.m: you must not remain as a binder'—thus one should proclaim Śiva's command. / Then, dismissing Govinda and joining the conscious self (vidyātman),

85.s:
bāhumuktārdhadṛśyena candravimbena sannibhaṃ /
saṃhāramudrayā svasthaṃ(2) vidhāyodbhavamudrayā //
85.d:
बाहुमुक्तार्धदृश्येन चन्द्रविम्बेन सन्निभं /
संहारमुद्रया स्वस्थं(2) विधायोद्भवमुद्रया //
85.m: resembling the moon's disc visible as half released by a cloud, / having placed it in itself with the dissolution gesture, and with the manifestation gesture

85.s:
sūtre saṃyojya vinyasya toyavinduṃ yathā purā /
visṛjya pitarau vahneḥ pūjitau kusumādibhiḥ /
:n
1 vardhanīkṛtyeti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 saṃhāramadrayātmasthaṃ iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 272
dadyāt pūrṇāṃ vidhānena pratiṣṭhāpi viśodhitā //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye nirvāṇadīkṣāyāṃ
pratiṣṭhākalāśodhanaṃ nāma pañcāśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha ṣaḍaśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
vidyāviśodhanavidhānaṃ
85.d:
सूत्रे संयोज्य विन्यस्य तोयविन्दुं यथा पुरा /
विसृज्य पितरौ वह्नेः पूजितौ कुसुमादिभिः /
:न्
1 वर्धनीकृत्येति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 संहारमद्रयात्मस्थं इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 272
दद्यात् पूर्णां विधानेन प्रतिष्ठापि विशोधिता //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये निर्वाणदीक्षायां
प्रतिष्ठाकलाशोधनं नाम पञ्चाशीतितमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ षडशीतितमो ऽध्यायः
विद्याविशोधनविधानं
85.m:
uniting it to the thread, having deposited a drop of water as before, / having dismissed the parents of the fire worshipped with flowers and other offerings,
[Gap in text]
[Note:] The reading in manuscript kha is: 'vardhanīkṛtyeti'.
[Note:] The reading in manuscript kha is: 'saṃhāramudrayātmasthaṃ'.
one should offer the full oblation according to rule; and the Pratiṣṭhā[-kalā] is purified.
Thus ends the eighty-fifth chapter, entitled 'Purification of the Pratiṣṭhā-kalā in Liberating Initiation', in the glorious Mahāpurāṇa composed by Agni.
Now the eighty-sixth chapter:
The Procedure for the Purification of Vidyā

86.s:
īśvara uvāca
sandhānamatha vidyāyāḥ prācīnakalayā saha /
kurvīta pūrvavat kṛtvā(1) tattvaṃ varṇaya tadyathā //
oṃ hoṃ kṣīmiti sandhānaṃ
86.d:
ईश्वर उवाच
सन्धानमथ विद्यायाः प्राचीनकलया सह /
कुर्वीत पूर्ववत् कृत्वा(1) तत्त्वं वर्णय तद्यथा //
ओं हों क्षीमिति सन्धानं
86.m:
The Lord said: / Then one should perform the conjunction of Vidyā with the preceding kalā / having done as before. Describe the principles, namely as follows:
'oṃ hoṃ kṣīm'—this is the conjunction.

86.s:
rāgś ca śuddhavidyā ca niyatiḥ kalayā saha /
kālo mayā tathāvidyā tattvānāmiti saptakaṃ //
86.d:
राग्श् च शुद्धविद्या च नियतिः कलया सह /
कालो मया तथाविद्या तत्त्वानामिति सप्तकं //
86.m: Rāga, Śuddhavidyā, Niyati together with Kalā, / Kāla, Māyā, and likewise Avidyā: this is the group of seven principles.

86.s:
ralavāḥ śaṣasāḥ varṇāḥ ṣaḍ vidyāyāṃ prakīrtitāḥ /
padāni praṇavādīni ekaviṃśatisaṅkhyayā //
oṃ namaḥ śivāya sarvaprabhave haṃ śivāya(2) īśānamūrdhāya
tatpuruṣavaktrāya aghorahṛdayāya vāmadevaguhyāya(3)
sadyojātamūrtaye(4) oṃ namo namo guhyātiguhyāya goptre anidhāya
sarvādhipāya(5) jyotirūpāya prameśvārāya bhavena oṃ vyoma
:n
1 pūrvavat dhṛtveti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 iṃ śivāya iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 vacoguhyāya iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 sadyojātāya mūrtaye iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
5 atha nidhāya sarvādhipataya iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 273
86.d:
रलवाः शषसाः वर्णाः षड् विद्यायां प्रकीर्तिताः /
पदानि प्रणवादीनि एकविंशतिसङ्ख्यया //
ओं नमः शिवाय सर्वप्रभवे हं शिवाय(2) ईशानमूर्धाय
तत्पुरुषवक्त्राय अघोरहृदयाय वामदेवगुह्याय(3)
सद्योजातमूर्तये(4) ओं नमो नमो गुह्यातिगुह्याय गोप्त्रे अनिधाय
सर्वाधिपाय(5) ज्योतिरूपाय प्रमेश्वाराय भवेन ओं व्योम
:न्
1 पूर्ववत् धृत्वेति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 इं शिवाय इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 वचोगुह्याय इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 सद्योजाताय मूर्तये इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
5 अथ निधाय सर्वाधिपतय इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 273
86.m:
The six letters *ra*, *la*, *va*, *śa*, *ṣa*, and *sa* are declared to belong to Vidyā [Kalā]. / The words beginning with the Praṇava (oṃ) are twenty-one in number:
“Oṃ namaḥ śivāya, to the all-sovereign, haṃ to Śiva, to the one whose head is Īśāna, / whose face is Tatpuruṣa, whose heart is Aghora, whose secret part is Vāmadeva, / whose form is Sadyojāta; oṃ homage, homage to the most secret of secrets, to the protector, to the boundless one, / to the ruler of all, whose nature is light, to the supreme lord, by Bhava, oṃ vyoma-…”
[Gap in text]
1. "Holding as before" is the reading of the book marked kha.
2. "iṃ śivāya" is the reading of the book marked kha.
3. "vacoguhyāya" is the reading of the book marked kha.
4. "sadyojātāya mūrtaye" is the reading of the book marked kha.
5. "atha nidhāya sarvādhipataye" is the reading of the book marked kha. / [p. 273]

86.s:
oṃ rudrāṇāṃ bhuvanānāñca svarūpamatha kaśyape /
prathamo vāmadevaḥ syāttataḥ sarvabhavodbhavaḥ //
86.d:
ओं रुद्राणां भुवनानाञ्च स्वरूपमथ कश्यपे /
प्रथमो वामदेवः स्यात्ततः सर्वभवोद्भवः //
86.m: Now, O Kaśyapa, regarding the true nature of the Rudras and worlds: / The first is Vāmadeva, and then Sarvabhavodbhava,

86.s:
vajradehaḥ prabhurdhātā kravikramasuprabhāḥ /
vaṭuḥ(1) praśāntanāmā ca paramākṣarasañjñakaḥ //
86.d:
वज्रदेहः प्रभुर्धाता क्रविक्रमसुप्रभाः /
वटुः(1) प्रशान्तनामा च परमाक्षरसञ्ज्ञकः //
86.m: Vajradeha, Prabhu, Dhātṛ, Kravikrama, Suprabha, / Vaṭu, Praśānta by name, and the one designated Paramākṣara,

86.s:
śivaś ca saśivo babhrurakṣayaḥ śambhureva ca /
adṛṣṭarūpanāmānau tathānyo rūpavardhanaḥ //
86.d:
शिवश् च सशिवो बभ्रुरक्षयः शम्भुरेव च /
अदृष्टरूपनामानौ तथान्यो रूपवर्धनः //
86.m: Śiva, Saśiva, Babhru, Akṣaya, Śambhu, / Adṛṣṭarūpa, [Adṛṣṭa]nāman, and another, Rūpavardhana,

86.s:
manonmano mahāvīryaścitrāṅgastadanantaraṃ /
kalyāṇa iti vijñeyāḥ pañcaviṃśatisaṅkhyayā //
86.d:
मनोन्मनो महावीर्यश्चित्राङ्गस्तदनन्तरं /
कल्याण इति विज्ञेयाः पञ्चविंशतिसङ्ख्यया //
86.m: Manonmana, Mahāvīrya, Citrāṅga, and after him / Kalyāṇa; these should be known to be twenty-five in number.

86.s:
mantro ghorāmarau vīje nāḍyau dve tatra te yathā /
pūṣā ca hastijihvā ca vyānanāgau prabhañjanau //
86.d:
मन्त्रो घोरामरौ वीजे नाड्यौ द्वे तत्र ते यथा /
पूषा च हस्तिजिह्वा च व्याननागौ प्रभञ्जनौ //
86.m: The mantras are Aghora and Amara; there are two seed-syllables; the two channels there are likewise / Pūṣā and Hastijihvā; the two winds are Vyāna and Nāga.

86.s:
viṣayo rūpamevaikamindriye pādacakṣuṣī /
śabdaḥ sparśaś ca rūpañca traya ete guṇāḥ smṛtāḥ //
86.d:
विषयो रूपमेवैकमिन्द्रिये पादचक्षुषी /
शब्दः स्पर्शश् च रूपञ्च त्रय एते गुणाः स्मृताः //
86.m: The sense-object is form alone; the sense-organs are the foot and the eye; / sound, touch, and form—these three are remembered as the qualities.

86.s:
avasthātra ṣuptiś ca rudro devastu kāraṇaṃ /
vidyāmadhyagataṃ sarvaṃ bhāvayedbhavanādikaṃ //
86.d:
अवस्थात्र षुप्तिश् च रुद्रो देवस्तु कारणं /
विद्यामध्यगतं सर्वं भावयेद्भवनादिकं //
86.m: The state here is deep sleep; the presiding deity is Rudra; / one should visualize all that belongs to Vidyā, such as the worlds.

86.s:
tāḍanaṃ chedanaṃ tatra praveśañcāpi yojanaṃ /
ākṛṣya grahaṇaṃ kuryādvidyayā hṛtpradeśataḥ //
86.d:
ताडनं छेदनं तत्र प्रवेशञ्चापि योजनं /
आकृष्य ग्रहणं कुर्याद्विद्यया हृत्प्रदेशतः //
86.m: Thereupon one should perform striking, severing, entry, and unlinking; / drawing [the soul] out from the region of the heart, one should seize it by means of Vidyā.

86.s:
ātmanyāropya saṅgṛhya kalāṃ kuṇḍe niveśayet /
rudraṃ kāraṇamāvāhya vijñāpya ca śiśuṃ prati //
86.d:
आत्मन्यारोप्य सङ्गृह्य कलां कुण्डे निवेशयेत् /
रुद्रं कारणमावाह्य विज्ञाप्य च शिशुं प्रति //
86.m: Imposing it upon oneself and grasping the Kalā, one should place it in the fire-pit. / Invoking Rudra as the cause and petitioning [him] concerning the child [initiate],

86.s:
pitrorāvahanaṃ kṛtvā(2) hṛdaye tāḍayecchiśuṃ /
praviśya pūrvamantreṇa tadātmani niyojayet //
86.d:
पित्रोरावहनं कृत्वा(2) हृदये ताडयेच्छिशुं /
प्रविश्य पूर्वमन्त्रेण तदात्मनि नियोजयेत् //
86.m: and invoking the parents, one should strike the child in the heart; / entering with the previous mantra, one should unite it with one's own self.

86.s:
ākṛṣyādāya pūrvoktavidhinā.atmani yojayet /
vāmayā yojayet yonau gṛhītvā dvādaśāntataḥ //
:n
1 buddha iti gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 āvāhanaṃ kuryāditi ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 274
86.d:
आकृष्यादाय पूर्वोक्तविधिना.अत्मनि योजयेत् /
वामया योजयेत् योनौ गृहीत्वा द्वादशान्ततः //
:न्
1 बुद्ध इति घ, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 आवाहनं कुर्यादिति ग, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 274
86.m:
Drawing it out and taking it according to the rule declared before, one should join it to oneself; / taking it from the dvādaśānta, one should unite it with the womb by means of Vāmā.
[Gap in text]
1. "buddha" is the reading of the books marked gha and ṅa.
2. "āvāhanaṃ kuryāt" is the reading of the books marked ga and gha. / [p. 274]

86.s:
kurvīta dehasampattiṃ janmādhikārameva ca /
bhogaṃ layantathā śrotaḥśuddhitattvaviśodhanaṃ //
86.d:
कुर्वीत देहसम्पत्तिं जन्माधिकारमेव च /
भोगं लयन्तथा श्रोतःशुद्धितत्त्वविशोधनं //
86.m: One should effect the acquisition of a body, birth, qualification, / experience, dissolution, purification of the current [of faculties], and purification of the cosmic principles,

86.s:
niḥśeṣamalakarmādipāśabandhanivṛttaye /
niṣkṛtyaiva vidhānena yajeta śatamāhutīḥ //
86.d:
निःशेषमलकर्मादिपाशबन्धनिवृत्तये /
निष्कृत्यैव विधानेन यजेत शतमाहुतीः //
86.m: for the cessation of all bonds such as impurity and karma. / For expiation according to the rule, one should offer a hundred oblations into the fire.

86.s:
astreṇa pāśaśaithilyaṃ malaśaktiṃ tirohitāṃ /
chedanaṃ mardanaṃ teṣāṃ vartulīkaraṇaṃ tathā(1) //
86.d:
अस्त्रेण पाशशैथिल्यं मलशक्तिं तिरोहितां /
छेदनं मर्दनं तेषां वर्तुलीकरणं तथा(1) //
86.m: By means of the Astra [mantra], loosening of the fetter, concealment of the power of impurity, / severing and crushing of them, as well as rolling them into a ball,

86.s:
dāhaṃ tadakṣarābhāvaṃ prāyaścittamathoditaṃ /
rudrāṇyāvāhanaṃ pūjā rūpagandhasamarpaṇaṃ //
oṃ hrīṃ rūpagandhau śulkaṃ rudra gṛhāṇa svāhā
86.d:
दाहं तदक्षराभावं प्रायश्चित्तमथोदितं /
रुद्राण्यावाहनं पूजा रूपगन्धसमर्पणं //
ओं ह्रीं रूपगन्धौ शुल्कं रुद्र गृहाण स्वाहा
86.m:
burning, non-existence of their syllables, and then the expiation are declared; / invocation of Rudrāṇī, worship, and offering of form and fragrance.
“Oṃ hrīṃ, form and fragrance are the fee; O Rudra, accept it, svāhā.”

86.s:
saṃśrāvya śāmbhavīmājñāṃ rudraṃ visṛjya kāraṇaṃ /
vidhāyātmani caitanyaṃ pāśasūtre niveśayet //
86.d:
संश्राव्य शाम्भवीमाज्ञां रुद्रं विसृज्य कारणं /
विधायात्मनि चैतन्यं पाशसूत्रे निवेशयेत् //
86.m: Proclaiming the command of Śiva and dismissing the cause, Rudra, / having established consciousness in oneself, one should place it on the thread of bonds.
