86.s:
vinduṃ śirasi vinyasya visṛjet pitarau tataḥ /
dadyāt pūrṇāṃ vidhānena samastavidhipūraṇīṃ //
86.d:
विन्दुं शिरसि विन्यस्य विसृजेत् पितरौ ततः /
दद्यात् पूर्णां विधानेन समस्तविधिपूरणीं //
86.m: Having placed the bindu on the head, one should then dismiss the parents; / one should offer the full oblation according to rule, fulfilling all procedures.

86.s:
pūrvoktavidhinā kāryaṃ vidyāyāṃ tāḍanādikaṃ /
svavījantu viśeṣaḥ syāditi vidyā viśodhitā //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye nirvāṇadīkṣāyāṃ
vidyāviśodhanaṃ nāma ṣaḍaśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha saptāśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
śāntiśodhanakathanaṃ
86.d:
पूर्वोक्तविधिना कार्यं विद्यायां ताडनादिकं /
स्ववीजन्तु विशेषः स्यादिति विद्या विशोधिता //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये निर्वाणदीक्षायां
विद्याविशोधनं नाम षडशीतितमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ सप्ताशीतितमो ऽध्यायः
शान्तिशोधनकथनं
86.m:
Striking and the rest should be performed in Vidyā according to the rule declared before; / the distinction, however, is its own seed-syllable. Thus Vidyā is purified.
Thus ends the eighty-sixth chapter, entitled “The Purification of Vidyā,” in the liberating initiation of the venerable and primeval Agni Purāṇa.
Now, the eighty-seventh chapter.
The account of the purification of Śānti [Kalā].

87.s:
īśvara uvāca
sandadhyādadhunā vidyāṃ śāntyā sārdhaṃ yathāvidhi /
śāntau tattvadvayaṃ līnaṃ bhāveśvarasadāśivau //
:n
1 chedanaṃ bhedanaṃ teṣāṃ bahulīkaraṇantathā iti ga,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 275
87.d:
ईश्वर उवाच
सन्दध्यादधुना विद्यां शान्त्या सार्धं यथाविधि /
शान्तौ तत्त्वद्वयं लीनं भावेश्वरसदाशिवौ //
:न्
1 छेदनं भेदनं तेषां बहुलीकरणन्तथा इति ग,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 275
87.m:
The Lord said: / One should now combine Vidyā with Śānti according to rule; / in Śānti two cosmic principles are dissolved: Īśvara and Sadāśiva.
[Gap in text]
1. "severing, splitting, and multiplying them" is the reading of the book marked ga. / [p. 275]

87.s:
hakāraś ca kṣakāraś ca dvau varṇau parikīrtitau /
rudrāḥ samānanāmāno bhuvanaiḥ saha tadyathā //
87.d:
हकारश् च क्षकारश् च द्वौ वर्णौ परिकीर्तितौ /
रुद्राः समाननामानो भुवनैः सह तद्यथा //
87.m: The two letters *ha* and *kṣa* are proclaimed; / the Rudras have the same names as the worlds, as follows:

87.s:
prabhavaḥ samayaḥ kṣudro vimalaḥ śiva ity api /
ghanau nirañjanākārau svaśivau dīptikāraṇau //
87.d:
प्रभवः समयः क्षुद्रो विमलः शिव इत्य् अपि /
घनौ निरञ्जनाकारौ स्वशिवौ दीप्तिकारणौ //
87.m: Prabhava, Samaya, Kṣudra, Vimala, and Śiva, / Ghana, Nirañjanākāra, Svaśiva, Dīptikāraṇa,

87.s:
tridaśeśvaranāmā ca tridaśaḥ kālasajjñakaḥ /
sūkṣmāmbujeśvaraśceti(1) rudrāḥ śāntau pratiṣṭhitāḥ //
vyomavyāpine vyomavyāpyarūpāya(2) sarvavyāpine śivāya anantāya
anāthāya anāśritāya dhruvāya śāśvatāya yogapīṭhasaṃsthitāya
nityayogine dhyānāhārāyeti(3) dvādaśapādāni
87.d:
त्रिदशेश्वरनामा च त्रिदशः कालसज्ज्ञकः /
सूक्ष्माम्बुजेश्वरश्चेति(1) रुद्राः शान्तौ प्रतिष्ठिताः //
व्योमव्यापिने व्योमव्याप्यरूपाय(2) सर्वव्यापिने शिवाय अनन्ताय
अनाथाय अनाश्रिताय ध्रुवाय शाश्वताय योगपीठसंस्थिताय
नित्ययोगिने ध्यानाहारायेति(3) द्वादशपादानि
87.m:
the one named Tridaśeśvara, Tridaśa, the one designated Kāla, / and Sūkṣmāmbujeśvara; these Rudras are established in Śānti.
“To the one who pervades space, whose form pervades space, to the all-pervading Śiva, to the endless, / to the lordless, to the unconditioned, to the firm, to the eternal, to the one seated upon the yogic throne, / to the eternal yogin, to the one whose sustenance is meditation”—these are twelve words.

87.s:
puruṣaḥ kavacau mantrau vīje vindūpakārakau /
alambuṣāyasānāḍyau vāyū kṛkarakarmakau //
87.d:
पुरुषः कवचौ मन्त्रौ वीजे विन्दूपकारकौ /
अलम्बुषायसानाड्यौ वायू कृकरकर्मकौ //
87.m: The Puruṣa and Kavaca are the two mantras; the two seed-syllables are those ending in bindu; / the two channels are Alambuṣā and Yasas; the two vital winds are Kṛkara and Kūrma.

87.s:
indriye tvakkarāvasyā sparśastu viṣayo mataḥ /
guṇau sparśaninādau dvāvekaḥ kāraṇamīśvaraḥ //
87.d:
इन्द्रिये त्वक्करावस्या स्पर्शस्तु विषयो मतः /
गुणौ स्पर्शनिनादौ द्वावेकः कारणमीश्वरः //
87.m: Its two sense-organs are the skin and the hand; touch is considered its sense-object; / the two qualities are touch and sound; the single causal deity is Īśvara.

87.s:
turmyāvastheti śāntisthaṃ sambhāvya bhuvanādikaṃ /
vidadhyāttāḍanaṃ bhedaṃ praveśañca viyojanaṃ //
87.d:
तुर्म्यावस्थेति शान्तिस्थं सम्भाव्य भुवनादिकं /
विदध्यात्ताडनं भेदं प्रवेशञ्च वियोजनं //
87.m: The fourth state (turīya) is its state. Visualizing the worlds and the rest residing in Śānti, / one should carry out striking, splitting, entering, and unlinking.

87.s:
ākṛṣya grahaṇaṃ kuryācchāntervadanasūtrataḥ /
ātmanyāropya saṅgṛhya kalāṃ kuṇḍe niveśayet //
87.d:
आकृष्य ग्रहणं कुर्याच्छान्तेर्वदनसूत्रतः /
आत्मन्यारोप्य सङ्गृह्य कलां कुण्डे निवेशयेत् //
87.m: Drawing [the soul] out, one should grasp it from the thread of Śānti's mouth; / imposing it upon oneself and grasping the Kalā, one should place it in the fire-pit.

87.s:
īśaṃ tavādhikāre 'smin mumukṣuṃ dīkṣayāmyahaṃ /
bhavyaṃ tvayānukūlena(4) kuryāt vijñāpanāmiti //
87.d:
ईशं तवाधिकारे ऽस्मिन् मुमुक्षुं दीक्षयाम्यहं /
भव्यं त्वयानुकूलेन(4) कुर्यात् विज्ञापनामिति //
87.m: “O Lord, in this jurisdiction of yours I initiate one desiring liberation; / you must be favorably disposed towards him”—thus one should make petition.

87.s:
āvāhanādikaṃ pitroḥ śiṣyasya tāḍanādikaṃ /
:n
1 sūkṣmāsūkṣmeśvaraś caiva iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 vyomavyāpakarūpāya iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / vyomarūpāyeti
ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 dhyāyaparāyeti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / vyānāhārāyeti ga,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 bhāvyaṃ tvayā ca śuddhena iti ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 276
vidhāyādāya caitanyaṃ vidhinā.atmani yojayet //
87.d:
आवाहनादिकं पित्रोः शिष्यस्य ताडनादिकं /
:न्
1 सूक्ष्मासूक्ष्मेश्वरश् चैव इति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 व्योमव्यापकरूपाय इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / व्योमरूपायेति
ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 ध्यायपरायेति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / व्यानाहारायेति ग,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 भाव्यं त्वया च शुद्धेन इति ग, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 276
विधायादाय चैतन्यं विधिना.अत्मनि योजयेत् //
87.m:
The invocation and other rites of the parents, the striking and other rites of the disciple,
[Gap in text]
1. "sūkṣmāsūkṣmeśvaraś caiva" is the reading of the book marked ga.
2. "vyomavyāpakarūpāya" is the reading of the book marked kha; "vyomarūpāya" is the reading of the book marked ga.
3. "dhyānaparāya" is the reading of the book marked kha; "vyānāhārāya" is the reading of the book marked ga.
4. "bhāvyaṃ tvayā ca śuddhena" is the reading of the books marked ga and ṅa. / [p. 276]
having performed, and taking consciousness, one should unite it with oneself according to rule.

87.s:
pūrvavat pitṛsaṃyogaṃ bhāvayitvodbhavākhyayā /
hṛtsampuṭātmavījena devīgarbhe niyojayet //
87.d:
पूर्ववत् पितृसंयोगं भावयित्वोद्भवाख्यया /
हृत्सम्पुटात्मवीजेन देवीगर्भे नियोजयेत् //
87.m: Visualizing the union of the parents as before by means of the [mantra] named Udbhava, / one should place it in the womb of the goddess with one's own seed-syllable enclosed by the Hṛd [mantra].

87.s:
dehotpattau hṛdā pañca śirasā janmahetave /
śikhayā vādhikārāya bhogāya kavacāṇunā //
87.d:
देहोत्पत्तौ हृदा पञ्च शिरसा जन्महेतवे /
शिखया वाधिकाराय भोगाय कवचाणुना //
87.m: For the production of the body, [five oblations] with the Hṛd mantra; five with the Śiras for the sake of birth; / with the Śikhā for qualification; for experience with the Kavaca mantra;

87.s:
layāya śastramantreṇa śrotaḥśuddhau śivena ca /
tattvaśuddhau hṛdā hy evaṃ garbhādhānādi pūrvavat //
87.d:
लयाय शस्त्रमन्त्रेण श्रोतःशुद्धौ शिवेन च /
तत्त्वशुद्धौ हृदा ह्य् एवं गर्भाधानादि पूर्ववत् //
87.m: for dissolution with the Śastra (Astra) mantra; for purification of the faculties with Śiva; / and for purification of the cosmic principles with the Hṛd mantra. Thus the impregnation and other rites are as before.

87.s:
varmaṇā pāśaśaithilyaṃ niṣkṛtyaivaṃ śataṃ japet /
malaśaktitirodhane śastreṇāhutipañcakaṃ //
87.d:
वर्मणा पाशशैथिल्यं निष्कृत्यैवं शतं जपेत् /
मलशक्तितिरोधने शस्त्रेणाहुतिपञ्चकं //
87.m: For loosening the bonds, one should repeat [the mantra] with the Varma (Kavaca) a hundred times for expiation; / for concealing the power of impurity, five oblations with the weapon (Astra) mantra.

87.s:
evaṃ pāśaviyoge 'pi(1) tataḥ saptāstrajaptayā /
chindyādastreṇa kartaryā pāśānvījavatā yathā //
oṃ hauṃ(2) śāntikalāpāśāya haḥ hūṃ phaṭ
87.d:
एवं पाशवियोगे ऽपि(1) ततः सप्तास्त्रजप्तया /
छिन्द्यादस्त्रेण कर्तर्या पाशान्वीजवता यथा //
ओं हौं(2) शान्तिकलापाशाय हः हूं फट्
87.m:
Likewise, in unlinking the bonds, one should then, with the Astra recited seven times, / cut the bonds by means of the Astra as a pair of scissors, endowed with the seed-syllable.
"Oṃ hauṃ, to the bond of the Śānti-kalā: haḥ hūṃ phaṭ!"

87.s:
visṛjya vartulīkṛtya pāśamantreṇa pūrvavat /
ghṛtapūrṇe śruve datvā kalāstreṇaiva homayet //
87.d:
विसृज्य वर्तुलीकृत्य पाशमन्त्रेण पूर्ववत् /
घृतपूर्णे श्रुवे दत्वा कलास्त्रेणैव होमयेत् //
87.m: Having released [the bonds] and rolled them into a ball, as before, with the bond mantra, / placing them in a ladle filled with ghee, he should offer them into the fire with the weapon mantra of the [Śānti]-kalā.

87.s:
astreṇa juhuyāt pañca pāśāṅkuśanivṛttaye /
prāyaścittaniṣedhāya dadyādaṣṭāhutīratha //
oṃ haḥ astrāya hūṃ phaṭ
87.d:
अस्त्रेण जुहुयात् पञ्च पाशाङ्कुशनिवृत्तये /
प्रायश्चित्तनिषेधाय दद्यादष्टाहुतीरथ //
ओं हः अस्त्राय हूं फट्
87.m:
He should offer five oblations with the weapon [mantra] to remove the bond-goad; / then he should offer eight oblations to counteract [any need for] expiation.
"Oṃ haḥ to the weapon: hūṃ phaṭ!"

87.s:
hṛdeśvaraṃ samāvāhya kṛtvā pūjanatarpaṇe /
vidadhīta vidhānena tasmai śulkasamarpaṇaṃ //
oṃ hāṃ īśvara buddhyahaṅkārau śulkaṃ gṛhāṇa
svāhā
87.d:
हृदेश्वरं समावाह्य कृत्वा पूजनतर्पणे /
विदधीत विधानेन तस्मै शुल्कसमर्पणं //
ओं हां ईश्वर बुद्ध्यहङ्कारौ शुल्कं गृहाण
स्वाहा
87.m:
Having invoked Īśvara with the heart [mantra] and performed worship and libation, / he should duly present the toll to him according to rule:
"Oṃ hāṃ, Īśvara, accept the intellect and ego as your toll, svāhā!"

87.s:
niḥśeṣadagdhapāśasya paśorasyeśvara tvayā /
na stheyaṃ bandhakatvena śivājñāṃ śrāvayediti //
:n
1 ekaṃ pāśaviyogārthamiti ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 oṃ hy aimiti ka, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / oṃ omiti ga,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / oṃ yaimiti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 277
87.d:
निःशेषदग्धपाशस्य पशोरस्येश्वर त्वया /
न स्थेयं बन्धकत्वेन शिवाज्ञां श्रावयेदिति //
:न्
1 एकं पाशवियोगार्थमिति ग, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 ओं ह्य् ऐमिति क, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / ओं ओमिति ग,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / ओं यैमिति घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 277
87.m:
"O Īśvara, of this bound soul whose bonds are completely burned away, / you must not remain as a binder!" Thus he should proclaim Śiva's command.
[Notes]
1 "ekaṃ pāśaviyogārtham" is the reading in the books marked ga and gha.
2 "oṃ hy aim" is the reading in the books marked ka and ṅa; "oṃ om" is the reading in ga; "oṃ yaim" is the reading in gha. / [p. 277]

87.s:
visṛjedīśvarandevaṃ raudrātmānaṃ niyojayet /
īṣaccandramivātmānaṃ vidhinā.atmani yojayet //
87.d:
विसृजेदीश्वरन्देवं रौद्रात्मानं नियोजयेत् /
ईषच्चन्द्रमिवात्मानं विधिना.अत्मनि योजयेत् //
87.m: He should dismiss the god Īśvara and apply his Rudra nature; / he should duly unite the soul, shining slightly like the moon, into his own soul.

87.s:
sūtre saṃyojayedenaṃ śuddhayodbhavamudrayā /
dadyāt mūlena śiṣyasya śirasyamṛtavindukaṃ //
87.d:
सूत्रे संयोजयेदेनं शुद्धयोद्भवमुद्रया /
दद्यात् मूलेन शिष्यस्य शिरस्यमृतविन्दुकं //
87.m: He should unite this [soul] into the cord with the pure Udvhava-mudrā; / with the root mantra, he should place a drop of nectar upon the disciple's head.

87.s:
visṛjya pitarau vahneḥ pūjitau kusumādibhiḥ /
dadyāt pūrṇāṃ vidhānajño niḥśeṣavidhipūraṇīṃ //
87.d:
विसृज्य पितरौ वह्नेः पूजितौ कुसुमादिभिः /
दद्यात् पूर्णां विधानज्ञो निःशेषविधिपूरणीं //
87.m: Having dismissed the parents of the fire after worshipping them with flowers and other offerings, / the knower of the ritual should offer the full oblation that completes every rite without remainder.

87.s:
asyāmapi vidhātavyaṃ pūrvavattāḍanādiakaṃ /
svavījantu viśeṣaḥ syācchuddhiḥ śānterapīḍitā //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye nirvāṇadīkṣāyāṃ
śāntiśodhanaṃ nāma saptaśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś athāṣṭāśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
nirvāṇadīkṣākathanaṃ
87.d:
अस्यामपि विधातव्यं पूर्ववत्ताडनादिअकं /
स्ववीजन्तु विशेषः स्याच्छुद्धिः शान्तेरपीडिता //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये निर्वाणदीक्षायां
शान्तिशोधनं नाम सप्तशीतितमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथाष्टाशीतितमो ऽध्यायः
निर्वाणदीक्षाकथनं
87.m:
In this [kalā] also, striking and the other rites should be performed as before; / the distinction lies in its own seed-syllable, and the purification of Śānti is thus accomplished.
Thus ends the eighty-seventh chapter, entitled "Purification of Śānti in the Liberating Initiation," in the great and ancient Agni Purāṇa.
Now begins the eighty-eighth chapter:
Instruction on Liberating Initiation.
